jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Associate Product Manager (Audit & Compliance)**

**Experience: 2-4 Years**

**Location: Bengaluru, KR (Hybrid)**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager (APM) who operates with an "owner’s mindset." This role is for a problem solver who can analyze complex requirements, manage tough stakeholders (especially Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams), and unblock engineering teams independently. You will be responsible for participating and playing a vital role in critical regulatory compliance audits, and ensuring that product/data delivery happens on time, everytime. We need someone comfortable with high visibility, data precision, and driving execution without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Specification & Delivery:**
Translate customer/business requirements into clear, detailed product specifications, one-pagers, and user stories. You will work with your manager to write effective specs and ensure functionality is described in sufficient detail. You are someone who understands an engineer’s language and ensures that your engineering peers are clear about what you ask for. Specifications you write are clear enough that AI can read from it and write working code.

**End-to-End Ownership:**
Take full independent ownership of your pod to drive the product roadmap and execution pace without requiring constant intervention or supervision.

**Stakeholder Management:**
Proactively engage with stakeholders across the organization to gather feedback and ensure everyone is on the same page regarding the sequence of execution. You will act as the primary Point of Contact (POC)—specifically for the Risk, Compliance, and Audit teams—building strong rapport while managing their expectations firmly. Your stakeholders feel comfort in being heard and feel obliged to give you business outcomes.

**Operational Visibility & Presence:**
Maintain high visibility and availability in the office to facilitate real-time coordination with cross-functional teams. You must be present during critical tasks (e.g., audits, scrutinies) to unblock dependencies immediately.

**Data & Requirement Precision:**
Deeply understand data complexities to streamline requirements for the engineering team. Ensure all necessary data is gathered from stakeholders
*before*
handing off to developers to avoid redundant work or delays.

**Data-Informed Decisions:**
Define success metrics for your features, ensure proper data instrumentation is in place, and analyze post-launch results to measure impact and recommend the next steps. Your ‘why’ to every problem has an analytical benefit line-of-sight.

**Proactive Communication:**
Providing accurate, transparent updates on roadmap progress. Ensure "firm" follow-ups with stakeholders to keep projects moving, rather than acting solely as a messenger.

**Qualification:**

An ideal candidate would have:

* **Experience:**
  BTech/BE from a top engineering school strongly preferred
* Graduate with 1-3 years of experience and at least 1 year of Product Management experience in the fintech industry (lending industry experience preferred)
* **High Agency:**
  Thrives in pressure; does not just survive it. Demonstrated ability to solve problems autonomously and manage complex personalities or stakeholders in a high-speed setting.
* **Constructive Pushback:**
  Acts as a quality gatekeeper capable of saying "no" to noise and rejecting incomplete requirements and demanding stakeholder clarity to protect engineering bandwidth.
* **Technical/Data Aptitude:**
  Comfortable defining complex logic for data-heavy requirements (e.g., accounting ledgers, reconciliations) and analyzing data dependencies to effectively support the engineering team.
* Should be adept in using Gen AI to unlock productivity for yourself and others
* Can quickly make no-code prototypes on Lovable/any other prototyping software
* Working knowledge of SQL & Excel and basic knowledge of APIs
* Structured thinking & problem solving
* Strong communication (both verbal & written) - Should be able to individually lead mini projects
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast paced environment
* Clearly demonstrable impact in past roles
* Intellectual curiosity/agility
* A great attitude

jobs.title: Product Associate
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Join J.P. Morgan's Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 team to transform how organizational data is managed, governed, and leveraged. Drive innovative, AI-enabled data solutions that enhance accuracy, operational efficiency, and business decision-making.
  
  
As a Product Associate within the Corporate & Investment Bank Client 360 (C360) team, you will be responsible for driving product strategy and execution across entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration. You will develop scalable, governed data solutions that improve accuracy, transparency, and operational efficiency. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you will leverage advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI-enabled capabilities to enhance data quality and usability. You will also drive product innovation, stakeholder alignment, and measurable business outcomes across interconnected platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution for entity resolution, organizational profiles, and third-party data integration.
* Develop scalable entity resolution capabilities integrating internal and external data sources into a unified, governed organizational dataset.
* Drive AI- and machine learning-enabled solutions to improve matching accuracy, processing efficiency, and operational scalability.
* Design governed challenge-and-override workflows to support data accuracy, feedback management, and consistent decision-making across systems.
* Build diagnostic and explainability capabilities to enhance transparency, identify data quality issues, and support operational decisions.
* Lead organizational profile arbitration, ensuring accurate attribute selection, data lineage, auditability, and governance.
* Drive vendor data integration and data model evolution while maintaining architectural standards and operational controls.
* Establish data quality frameworks, documentation standards, and performance metrics to improve data reliability and usability.
* Evaluate third-party data capabilities and prioritize integrations based on business value, feasibility, and operational readiness.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Data Science, Architecture, Data Governance, and business stakeholders to deliver integrated product solutions.
* Define success metrics, manage dependencies, and communicate product priorities, delivery progress, and risks to senior stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Demonstrated product management experience delivering complex, scalable data products or platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into product strategies, roadmaps, and actionable delivery plans.
* Hands-on experience with entity resolution, identity matching, data mastering, or organizational data management.
* Strong understanding of deterministic matching, machine learning-assisted classification, and high-volume data processing.
* Knowledge of data quality management, entity modeling, metadata, data lineage, and attribute arbitration.
* Ability to evaluate algorithmic performance using precision, recall, processing efficiency, and explainability metrics.
* Experience designing governed data workflows, feedback mechanisms, and operational controls.
* Understanding of data architecture principles, schema management, and third-party data integration.
* Experience collaborating with Engineering, Data Science, and AI/ML teams on data-driven product solutions.
* Strong product execution capabilities, including roadmap prioritization, backlog management, and dependency resolution.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills And Capabilities**

* Experience delivering data products within financial services, particularly Corporate & Investment Banking.
* Exposure to enterprise-wide data platforms supporting multiple business lines and interconnected systems.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled or agent-based capabilities within production data environments.
* Familiarity with human-in-the-loop AI workflows, model evaluation, and AI governance frameworks.
* Knowledge of third-party data vendor evaluation, selection, and commercial engagement processes.
* Experience with vendor data normalization, automated onboarding, and scalable integration frameworks.
* Familiarity with organizational reference data and its applications in client onboarding, risk management, and analytics.

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Product Lead
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Senior Product Lead
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.
  
  
You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.
  
  
**Impact & contribution:**
As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.
  
  
**Reporting lines:**
Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**
We’re interested in hearing from people who:
  
  

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
* Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams

**Years of Experience:**
11+
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.
  
  
**Qualifications:**
B.Tech
  
  
If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.
  
  
We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.
  
  
Advertising End Date: 29/11/2026

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager  – Digital Assets
jobs.description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own stablecoin-funded card products — physical and virtual cards funded from or settled in stablecoins (USDC and equivalents). Define the product, get it through compliance, ship it
* Build digital asset support into Nium’s multi-currency wallet — hold, convert, and send stablecoins alongside fiat currencies. This is a wallet extension, not a new product line
* Design and ship on/off-ramp flows — fiat-to-digital and digital-to-fiat conversion, including rate logic, settlement timing, and failure handling. Own the full customer experience
* Drive stablecoin-based cross-border settlement — payin and payout flows that clear on digital rails. Work with network and settlement teams to make these production-grade
* Evaluate and integrate custodians, exchanges, and blockchain infrastructure — as infrastructure decisions with integration timelines and SLAs, not as partnership strategy
* Own compliance product design for digital assets — MiCA, VASP frameworks, travel rule, FinCEN requirements. These get built into the product spec, not handed off to legal

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in product management. Fintech, crypto infrastructure, or payments required
* You’ve shipped at least one digital asset product in production — a stablecoin wallet, a crypto card, an on/off-ramp, or a digital settlement rail. Not a prototype. Not a strategy deck
* Strong payments foundation — cross-border flows, FX, wallets, settlement mechanics. Digital assets are an extension of this, not a departure from it
* Regulatory fluency as a product skill — you know what MiCA, travel rule, VASP registration, and FinCEN MSB requirements mean for your spec, your launch sequence, and your go/no-go decisions
* Experience working with custodians, blockchain infrastructure, or card networks — enough to evaluate integration tradeoffs and write requirements that engineering can build against
* Comfortable operating in high-ambiguity, high-compliance environments — you know when to move and when to wait for legal sign-off

**How We’ll Measure Success**

* Volume settled on digital rails (stablecoin payins + payouts) — tracked quarterly against target
* Card activation rate and spend volume for stablecoin-funded card products
* On/off-ramp conversion rate and time-to-settlement
* Time-to-integration for new custodian or blockchain network partners
* Regulatory coverage: number of markets with compliant, live digital asset product

**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
**The Role**

Having built strong foundations in India, we now operate across multiple international markets and are expanding into new ones. International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay’s products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work — on top of a platform and systems layer that has to be rebuilt for each market’s rails, currency, regulation and settlement cycle. Much of this is 0 to 1 work. You will be deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself and because a new market means new rails, you will also own the systems underneath — machinery that every downstream product depends on.

**What you will own**

* Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.
* Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.
* Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.
* Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.
* Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.
* Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist
* Business focus: Build business strategy around ecosystem product that would define the success for the Razorpay and the Ecosystem players

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* You understand technology, but love customer-first & business-first thinking.
* You are comfortable working hands-on in a fast-paced start-up environment.
* You are curious about metrics, execution processes, macro trends.
* Problem-solving and detail orientation come naturally to you.
* You have an analytical and data-driven approach in day-to-day work. Energetic self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* You are entrepreneurial and have the hunger to solve problems end-to-end.
* You have at least 4 years of experience in Product Management.

jobs.title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms
jobs.description:
**Job Title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms**

* Wealth and Personal Banking serves millions of customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative distribution channels.
* As the Product Manager - VOC Platforms, you will act as a product owner and expert for our VOC platforms. You will manage and govern the development and utilisation of the platforms such as Medallia and MMX (complaints platfrom). You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will ensure the platforms deliver value to the business and are used effectively. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. You will manage the relationship with platform suppliers to maximise value to IWPB by driving the implementation and adoption of new functionality and ensuring the rapid and effective response to our required fixes and CRs.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage the full product lifecycle to ensure that, over time, the needs of the platform users continue to be met
* As platform SME, work closely with Technology, Transformation, D&A and market teams to ensure the VOC platforms change agenda is delivered on time and in budget. Be hands-on and remove delivery blockers through appropriate action and escalation
* Operationalise the voice of the customer platform at its full potential across users, securing ROI and value to business and customers

**Platform management (BAU)**

* Manage the integrity of the platforms and all aspects of the of business-as-usual platform operation
* Improve platform functionality, eg. Text Analytics evolution, Topic creation, AI, rules, process, triggers, surveys
* Monitor the performance of the platform to optimise value to the local and global change agenda
* Ensure platforms updates are implemented, assessed and used
* Contribute to achievement of objectives and key results across the VOC Product and use data to inform prioritisation and decision making. Maintain a focus on ROI to ensure priorities align to areas of greatest impact
* Create and manage a standard process and ways of working to respond to requests for changes

jobs.description:
**About the Role :**

At Juspay, Associate Product managers take end to end product ownership, juggling between building the product, managing operations and evangelizing our creation with our customers.

**Being a Creator**
:

Can PMs become TRUE creators? Can they CODE? Can they Design? Can they analyze data programmatically?

Yes they do it here! We offer unique opportunities for PMs to upskill themselves and overlap with Devs and Designers. We believe PMs should participate in the creation process and make product specifications that is close to implementation.

**They Should :**

* Own the vision of the organization
* Develop and foster a deep understanding of
* *Domain*
  - Payments
* *Technology*
  - Purescript/Haskell
* *Design*
  - Mobile UX/UI (Tools: Sketch, Flinto)
* *Data*
  - Payments user journey and conversions (Tools: SQL, Tableau & data science programming)
* Deliver impactful and time-bound results by getting hands on with all aspects of product development and leading by example
* Develop framework solutions that solve problems fundamentally
* Enable, Collaborate & Coordinate with various stakeholders to craft the optimal product
* *Internal*
  - Technical Product Analysts (TPAs), Developers, Designers, Business Development and Senior Management
* *External*
  - CxOs, Sr. Executives, PMs and Devs of Merchants, Banks and Vendors
* Improve & optimise product development processes continuously

**Apply if you have :**

1. Aspiration for value creation
2. Aspiration for quality
3. Genuine user empathy
4. Openness and patience to learn harder things
5. Systematic approach to problem solving
6. Attitude and ability to get-things-done
7. Effectively balance big picture / details
8. Self-motivated and driven
9. Persuasive without being forceful
10. The Giver attitude

**Preferred Qualifications And Skills**

* MBA with 1-3 years of professional experience in Product Management.
* Strong strategic mindset along with exceptional execution capabilities and rigor.
* Proven expertise in stakeholder management
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to plan, coordinate and execute assigned tasks via collaboration with multiple cross functional teams

**Why work in Juspay?**

***Payments.. big deal?***

Yes, it is a big deal. The wind is strongly blowing in favor of electronic payments - India wants to buy/order everything online, go cashless (regulation) and can’t have enough of using smartphones! Startups and internet businesses currently see a payment’ success rate of 60% ( 40 out of 100 people fail during the payments process!). These businesses that will define our future are absolutely dependent on solving digital payments. Big industry with bigger problems to solve!

***How can Engineering solve this?***

Payments is a complex ecosystem involving banks, RBI regulations, payment networks, telecom infrastructure, online and offline merchants. There is no way to align all these stars without radical engineering innovation. Talk to us about it.

***What does Juspay offer?***

You get the opportunity to work in a free liberal environment with some of the best engineers and entrepreneurs. We live & breathe the art of building amazing products with impeccable design and engineering. We want more innovators and a little bit of madness to take it further. For us office is like home with everything needed to make us comfortably code all day and chill out too. We have a full size piano, drums and a Shruti box if you are into music :) Lots of books, pictionary and interesting people to talk to about varied subjects - art, philosophy and of course about how to do the highest feats of engineering/design. We take an active interest in helping people reach their highest potential.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Card Fraud, Payments & Authentication
jobs.description:
****Job Summary****
Synechron is seeking an experienced
**Product Designer**
to join its Card Fraud squad and shape capabilities that protect customers from card fraud while supporting secure and seamless payment experiences.
  
  
The role will focus on owning the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities, understanding the end-to-end card payment lifecycle, and translating customer, fraud, regulatory, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
  
  
The successful candidate will work across Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams to identify opportunities for fraud detection and prevention across authentication, authorisation, and clearing flows.
  
  
The role will contribute to business objectives by improving fraud prevention, supporting secure payment experiences, reducing customer and business risk, enabling regulatory and scheme readiness, and delivering measurable improvements across card-payment capabilities.
  
  
****Software Requirements****
**Required Software Skills**

* Product management and ownership tools: Experience using tools and practices to manage roadmaps, priorities, backlogs, requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, risks, and delivery outcomes.
* Payment and fraud platforms: Understanding of systems supporting card payments, fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication controls, and fraud prevention.
* Card payment lifecycle: Strong knowledge of authentication, authorisation, and clearing processes.
* Card scheme processes: Strong knowledge of Mastercard and Visa card-scheme payment flows and operating requirements.
* Requirements management: Ability to document product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, process flows, and success measures.
* Roadmap and backlog management: Ability to define, prioritize, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps and delivery priorities.
* Data and reporting: Ability to use product, payment, fraud, operational, and performance information to support prioritization and decision-making.
* Stakeholder collaboration: Experience working with business, technology, operations, architecture, fraud, cards, scheme, and vendor stakeholders.

****Preferred Software Skills****

* Experience with Discover/Diners Club card-scheme payment flows.
* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring, fraud rules, fraud strategies, authentication controls, or fraud platforms.
* Familiarity with Agile product-management and delivery tools.
* Experience with analytics, dashboards, product-performance reporting, and fraud-related metrics.
* Exposure to regulatory, scheme, and payment-transformation delivery tools and processes.

****Version And Experience Guidance****

* Specific software versions are not mandated in the requirements.
* Candidates should have experience with current product-management, payment, fraud, reporting, and collaboration tools.
* Candidates should be able to assess changes across card-payment systems, scheme requirements, fraud controls, operational processes, and technology dependencies.
* Experience should include practical ownership of product outcomes, roadmap priorities, requirements, delivery decisions, and production optimization.

****Overall Responsibilities****

* Own and drive the product roadmap and priorities for Card Fraud capabilities.
* Translate customer, fraud, regulatory, scheme, operational, and technology requirements into clear product outcomes.
* Define product goals, outcomes, priorities, delivery milestones, acceptance criteria, and success measures.
* Partner closely with Fraud, Cards, Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and external scheme or vendor teams.
* Understand end-to-end card transaction flows and identify where fraud detection and prevention controls can be effectively applied.
* Lead discovery and requirements definition for new fraud capabilities, scheme changes, and card-payment initiatives.
* Define product requirements, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and delivery priorities.
* Manage dependencies, risks, assumptions, constraints, and trade-offs across multiple initiatives and stakeholder groups.
* Assess the impact of authentication, authorisation, and clearing changes on card fraud controls and customer payment experiences.
* Support the design and delivery of fraud detection, fraud decisioning, transaction monitoring, authentication, and prevention capabilities.
* Support production readiness, implementation, rollout, incident response, and ongoing optimization of fraud capabilities.
* Monitor product performance and use evidence to recommend improvements to fraud controls, payment journeys, operational processes, and customer outcomes.
* Coordinate scheme, regulatory, and payment-transformation initiatives where applicable.
* Ensure product decisions consider security, privacy, customer experience, operational feasibility, sustainability, and business value.
* Contribute to measurable outcomes, including improved fraud detection, reduced fraud losses, reduced false positives, improved payment approval rates, improved customer experience, and timely delivery of scheme or regulatory changes.

****Technical Skills (By Category)****
**Programming Languages**
****Essential****

* Ability to understand technical concepts, system behavior, APIs, data flows, integrations, and application dependencies.
* Ability to review technical requirements, solution options, acceptance criteria, and implementation impacts.
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, analysts, fraud specialists, and technology teams.
* Ability to interpret payment, fraud, operational, and product data to support decisions.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to SQL, data analysis, or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with scripting or automation used in product analysis, reporting, or validation.
* Understanding of technical concepts related to real-time transaction processing and fraud decisioning.

**Databases/Data Management**
****Essential****

* Understanding of card-transaction, customer, payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and settlement data.
* Ability to assess data requirements for fraud controls, decisioning, transaction monitoring, reporting, and product measurement.
* Understanding of data quality, lineage, access control, protection, retention, and governance.
* Ability to use data and performance measures to assess product outcomes and prioritize improvements.
* Understanding of the impact of data availability, latency, accuracy, and completeness on fraud decisions and payment processing.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to real-time transaction monitoring data and fraud analytics.
* Familiarity with fraud rules, strategies, decision attributes, customer profiles, transaction patterns, and risk indicators.
* Experience with dashboards, data models, reporting tools, and analytical platforms.
* Knowledge of data requirements for card schemes, regulatory reporting, and payment transformation.

**Cloud Technologies**
****Essential****

* Understanding of technology environments that support card payments, fraud platforms, transaction processing, and customer-facing services.
* Ability to consider scalability, availability, security, latency, resilience, monitoring, and operational support in product decisions.
* Understanding of system dependencies across payment, fraud, authentication, authorisation, clearing, and operational platforms.

****Preferred****

* Exposure to cloud-based payment, fraud, analytics, or transaction-monitoring platforms.
* Familiarity with cloud-native services, APIs, real-time processing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
* Understanding of cloud cost management, resource efficiency, and sustainable technology operations.

**Frameworks and Libraries**
****Essential****

* Product management and product ownership frameworks.
* Agil

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an ambitious, systems-thinking, and highly analytical Product Manager to take ownership of our foundational cash management, treasury, and settlement ecosystem. As our transaction volume scales, the complexity of moving money efficiently, securely, and reliably becomes paramount.
  
  
In this role, you will be the driving force behind the core systems that govern optimal liquidity, power seamless financial operations, and establish direct integrations with central payment networks. You will navigate complex regulatory and technical landscapes, starting with optimizing our daily liquidity and settlement operations. Over time, you will spearhead the evolution of this function from an operational backbone into a highly strategic, value-generating engine that optimizes our working capital and financial intelligence.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Drive Core Treasury Platforms: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our treasury and liquidity management platforms, translating complex financial workflows into scalable, automated product architectures.
* Optimize Money Movement: Design and launch scalable products that automate fund flows, optimize merchant payouts, and ensure seamless money movement across our internal and external ecosystems.
* Build for System Resilience: Develop highly fault-tolerant platform capabilities that guarantee business continuity, intelligent transaction routing, and systemic resilience against external network or banking outages.
* Enable Financial Intelligence: Create product features and tools that empower our finance and treasury teams with advanced cash flow forecasting, real-time visibility, and strategic capital optimization.
* Manage Complex Integrations: Lead the product strategy for secure and robust API integrations with key financial networks and banking partners to expand our foundational operational capabilities.
* Embed Compliance & Controls: Ensure all treasury products are built with a compliance-first mindset, incorporating automated reconciliation, rigorous financial controls, and seamless auditability.

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in Product Management, successfully taking complex, backend-heavy products from conception to launch.
* Domain Preference: Prior experience in Fintech, Banking, Payments, or building highly scalable backend platform products is highly preferred (though not a strict requirement for a fast learner with strong fundamentals).
* Technical Acumen: Ability to deeply understand and orchestrate complex transaction flows, messaging architectures, and secure API integrations between internal ledgers and external financial institutions.
* Analytical Rigor: Exceptional data-driven problem-solving skills. You should be comfortable navigating complex financial workflows, large-scale reconciliations, and designing solutions for intricate edge cases.
* Strategic Execution: A strong bias for action with the ability to balance immediate operational requirements with long-term, highly scalable platform architecture.
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. You will need to collaborate seamlessly with and influence engineering, finance, treasury operations, and legal/compliance teams.

jobs.title: Product Owner, SME Banking Digital
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to lead the transformation of ideas into seamless, intuitive product experiences. The ideal candidate excels in planning, designing, scaling, and commercializing products, with a proven ability to test, validate, and optimize throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
This role requires a strong client focus and business acumen to effectively prioritize and deliver on competing demands. You will inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve positive outcomes with executional excellence. If you are a creative problem solver who thrives on tackling complex challenges and building products from inception to scale, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
Key responsibilities include product management, governance, and commercialization activities to support client channel onboarding and the development of scalable digital solutions. Additionally, you will serve as a key point of contact for education, thought leadership, and product expertise related to client channel onboarding.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives, addressing key strategic issues and functional architecture in close collaboration with business, operations, and technology teams, with a focus on shaping and executing the client channel onboarding strategy to achieve business objectives.
* Ensure alignment of channel onboarding product goals with overall business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Drive the implementation of digital solutions across the channel onboarding domain and operations, fostering ongoing partnerships with internal stakeholders and clients.
* Facilitate business change management and process design by developing and reviewing detailed software/functional requirements and process flow diagrams.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, communicating project progress to Senior Sponsors, Business Sponsors, Steering Committees, and the Program Management Office as appropriate.
* Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for S2B channel onboarding to senior stakeholders and team members.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices within the channel onboarding domain.
* Leverage innovative solutions to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction

**Business**

* As the product owner, responsible for crafting the product’s vision, roadmap, and maximizing the delivery of business value in SME CADM.
* Collaborate closely with channel operations team, business units, product owners and IT resources throughout all stages of project life cycle - including investigation, analysis, design, development, testing, and implementations - to ensure business requirements are successfully implemented.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of various initiatives
* Institutionalize innovative ideas to accelerate the Bank’s digital footprint.

**Processes**

* Manage the Book of Work, ensuring effective prioritization and alignment with stakeholder timelines.
* Oversee and streamline processes related to information controls, productivity, and regional/country enhancements, including workflows and procedures.
* Manage the product backlog and collaborate with technology teams to digitize client and internal operational workflows for onboarding.
* Review and approve use case scenarios and test cases; coordinate and support user acceptance testing and production verification.
* Ensure governance and compliance with all bank risk assessments and policies.
* Own and approve CADM data usage and define/manage data access for CADM users; strategize and implement identity and access management applications, ensuring no toxic access.

* Collect and analyze data to inform product direction and define enhancements to attract new clients.
* Deliver the digital strategy for client channel onboarding, ensuring global scalability while accommodating local requirements.
* Act as a people influencer and product owner to deliver proof of concepts and execute incubation ideas across business lines and locations, ensuring governance and controls.
* Develop and implement plans to increase awareness of digital transformation within client channel onboarding.
* Define and drive training programs to enhance digital automation capabilities among channel operations staff and stakeholders.
* Identify and address inefficiencies in channel operations, proposing workflow optimizations.
* Leverage data analysis to inform decisions and improve operational metrics.
* Identify and mitigate risks in channel operations.
* Partner with operations and business units to streamline processes, mitigate risks, and drive efficiencies.
* Measure and evaluate outcomes of change initiatives post-implementation.
* Assess the impact of process changes to ensure no additional manual touchpoints are introduced.

**People & Talent**
The role is not a people leader role however the role involves coordination between multiple parties
  
  

* Work Closely with channel operations team, business teams, peer product owners, engineering lead, architects to define and implement Solutions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams for successful implementation and deployment of client channel onboarding capabilities
* Engage actively with legal and compliance to raise awareness of new product features and secure acceptance of the changes.

**Risk Management**

* Act as the risk control owner under the Group’s risk management framework at the appropriate level.
* Ensure that bank is not exposed to risks due to client channel onboarding data management by enforcing role-based access control, embed market specific data localization as part of the product design.

**Governance**

* Oversee & track implementation timelines, resolve impediments / blockers, ensure change communication & transition
* Good understanding of change management and project management
* Identify, analyse, prepare risk mitigation tactics and manage anticipated resistances
* Good understanding of ADO dashboard, key metrices and functions

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* IAM team
* Business Stakeholders across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets
* Channel product owners across Cash, Trade, Financial Markets

* DCS management team

**Skills And Experience**

* Product Owner experience
* Understanding of product development lifecycle
* Strong project management and planning skills, including organizational & time management skills
* Clarity of communication style and ability to face off against senior stakeholders

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in banking, with a strong focus on managing digital channels; experience in Fintech environments is highly desirable.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience in identity and access management or channel onboar

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week

jobs.title: Senior Manager-Digital Product Management
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Global Merchant & Network Services brings together American Express' merchant and network-related businesses, including relationships with merchants, issuers, acquirers, processors, and strategic partners globally.
  
  
The Network Product team develops and delivers secure, resilient, and scalable payment network capabilities. This includes Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations that support market expansion, regulatory requirements, and global interoperability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Network Product professional to drive the development and delivery of strategic payment network capabilities. The role requires strong knowledge of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, transaction processing, and digital payments, along with the ability to translate business and partner needs into clear product requirements and executable delivery plans.
  
  
Strong project management, communication, and stakeholder management skills are critical. The individual will coordinate cross-functional workstreams, manage risks and dependencies, drive governance, and communicate progress and decisions effectively to senior leaders, internal teams, and external partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute product roadmaps for payment network capabilities aligned with enterprise priorities, market needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of capabilities across Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, and Network-to-Network integrations.
* Translate business, customer, partner, and regulatory needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Apply strong understanding of payment networks, issuing, acquiring, processing, transaction flows, and network specifications to guide product decisions.
* Ensure solutions meet intended business outcomes and consider scalability, security, resilience, operational readiness, and interoperability.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality Assurance teams across solution design, development, testing, implementation, and post-launch readiness.
* Maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Coordinate execution across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and external partner teams.
* Proactively identify delivery risks and blockers, drive mitigation, and escalate matters requiring leadership attention.
* Prepare concise executive updates, dashboards, roadmaps, and governance materials, translating complex topics for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Build trusted relationships and influence decisions across global, cross-functional, and highly matrixed teams.

**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Management, or related field.
* Relevant experience in payment network products, digital payments, product management, network delivery, or payment technology.
* Strong understanding of the payment's ecosystem, including networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, and digital payment providers.
* Knowledge of payment transaction flows and capabilities such as authorization, authentication, tokenization, clearing, and settlement.
* Experience delivering products or capabilities through requirements, development, testing, implementation, and operational readiness.
* Demonstrated project or program management experience across multiple teams, workstreams, risks, and dependencies.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear product and technical deliverables.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, executive communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience working with payment networks, issuers, acquirers, processors, digital wallet providers, or network capability modernization programs is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Authorization, Tokenization, Authentication, SafeKey, Digital Wallets, Local Network solutions, or Network-to-Network integrations.
* Knowledge of card processing, payment message flows, network specifications, and payment operations.
* Experience delivering complex modernization, migration, regulatory, or market-enablement initiatives.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience with Agile or SAFe delivery methodologies and knowledge of Rally, JIRA, Confluence, or similar tools.
* Experience engaging with external network partners, processors, vendors, or payment ecosystem participants.

**About Us**
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
  
  
As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
  
  
**About The Team**
We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
  
  

* Competitive base salaries

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Part Of**
Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.
  
  
****What you'll be responsible for****
You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.
  
  
****What you'll work on****

* Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.
* Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.
* Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.
* Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.
* Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.
* Lead complex cross-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high-impact investments.
* Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.

****What you'll bring to Circle****
****Core requirements****

* 10+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.
* Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer-facing capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.
* Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.
* Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long-term platform investments.
* Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain-based financial infrastructure.
* Experience with enterprise API products, two-sided networks, and compliance-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

jobs.title: Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

1. Join RENSAR hardware team utilizing your board level design skills to develop digital and analog circuits.

2. Be involved in all phases of board level hardware development in small self-motivated teams.

3. Perform design documentation, component selection, schematic edits, DFMEA, DFM, DFT etc. to ensure that your design is meeting the requirements, is competitive, production friendly and highly reliable.

4. Work with the board layout designers and support the layout by providing design constraints, rules, guidelines and reviews.

5. Validate your design using simulation tools and perform functional quality analysis of your design.

6. Make technical presentations on the details of your design and project status.

7. Interface with customers and field engineers on an as needed basis, helping to resolve field problems while learning more about applications and user habits.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**

1. ME / M. tech., BE / B Tech. Electronics & Communication Engineering or equivalent.

2. 3-6 years of thorough hands-on experience of designing boards using 8 / 32-bit boards using MCUs like MSP 430, TMS320, STM32 etc. and analog mixed signal circuits.

3. Strong component engineering knowledge and exposure to semiconductor markets.

4. Strong knowledge of communication protocols like SPI, I2C, Ethernet, RS-232, RS-485 etc.

5. Must have worked with PWB designers to review the board designs for signal integrity, EMI/EMC compliance etc. Should be well versed with DFM / DFT using Cadence development tools.

6. Thorough knowledge of EMC standards like IEC6100, IEC 61526, CISPR 11 etc. and their practical application through out the design life cycle.

7. Hardcore board bring-up & debugging experience using instruments like Logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and in-circuit emulators.

8. Ability to interact and work with external test & certification labs to validate the product compliance.

9. Excellent verbal & written communication in Hindi & English.

10. Ready to travel across the country for gaining field and application knowledge as well as trouble shooting.

11. Should have hands on experience of board Box-up using enclosures made of polymer, sheet metal and castings, enclosures.

12. Strong linguistic skill for documentation of the development efforts.

  

**Desired**

  

1. DSP based design experience.

2. Proven track record with both Analog and high-speed digital designs.

3. Experience with low level analog signal design techniques.

4. Experience designing with programmable logic devices.

5. Software experience to generate diagnostic code (C, C++, and/or assembly language).

**Job Title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms**

* Wealth and Personal Banking serves millions of customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative distribution channels.

You will manage and govern the development and utilisation of the platforms such as Medallia and MMX (complaints platfrom). You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. **Job Title:**
Principal UX Designer

**About Backbase**

Backbase is a leading provider of digital banking solutions. Our mission is to help banks create seamless and engaging customer experiences. We are a global company with a strong presence across the globe in Europe, Asia, Africa, Middle East and the Americas. We value innovation, collaboration, and customer focus. Our team is passionate about making a difference in the financial industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior UX Designer to join our Services Middle East team in our Hyderabad office. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping the user experience for our innovative digital banking products. You will be involved in the entire design process, from ideation to prototyping and testing. You will work closely with cross-functional client-facing teams, including Backbase team members: project managers, business analysts, solution architects and engineers. Externally, you will work closely with senior and leadership-level client stakeholders to deliver user-centered design solutions that meet their business goals. This is a hybrid position, requiring a mix of in-office and remote work, while being flexible for client travel.

As a client-facing UX Designer, you will be a key point of contact for our clients, leading workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting design solutions. This requires excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build rapport and work effectively with clients from diverse backgrounds.

**Responsibilities:**

* Create user flows, wireframes, and prototypes to communicate design concepts.
* Design high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
* Conduct usability testing to validate design decisions and iterate on designs.
* Lead client workshops to gather requirements and present design solutions.
* Confidently present and explain design decisions to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Build strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest UX design trends and best practices.
* Support development and QA teams regarding designs.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience as a UX Designer, with experience in a client-facing role.
* A strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design solutions.
* Proficiency in Figma.
* Solid understanding of UX research methodologies and usability testing principles.
* Experience working with design systems.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Experience leading and facilitating workshops.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in UX Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to effectively convey design specifications and rationale to the technical members of the team.

**Bonus Points:**

* Experience working in the financial, consultancy or technology industry.
* Experience with Agile development methodologies.

**Please note:**

* We are looking for someone who is passionate about user-centered design and has a strong understanding of UX principles.
* Your portfolio should showcase your design process and demonstrate your ability to solve real-world problems.
* We are particularly interested in seeing examples of your work that demonstrate your skills in interaction design.
* We are looking for someone who is a team player and has excellent communication skills.
