Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.

Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

**Position Summary**
Senior Delivery Product Owner - Hyderabad
  
  
If you are energized by solving complex business problems through technology and want to help shape the future of global tax delivery, consider joining the US Tax Transformation technology team. This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in Deloitte’s digital transformation by helping bring innovative products, capabilities, and experiences to life for our tax professionals and stakeholders around the world. You will work at the intersection of business, technology, and execution—partnering across teams to support high-impact initiatives that improve how we operate, serve clients, and create value at scale.
  
  
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.
  
  
we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
As a Delivery Product Owner Lead, you will play an important role in advancing product priorities across Deloitte Tax & Legal’s technology transformation portfolio. You will collaborate closely with Delivery Product Owners, product leadership, business stakeholders, and technology teams to help translate business needs into delivery-ready features, validate quality through detailed review and testing, and support the successful rollout of product capabilities. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the full product lifecycle—from requirements refinement and acceptance criteria review to prioritization support, deployment readiness, process documentation, and end-user enablement. The required candidate is highly detail-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized by working across teams and domains in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Additional responsibilities include:
  
  

* Collaborate with Delivery Product Owners and development teams to help refine feature priorities, requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected business outcomes.
* Support prioritization discussions by organizing inputs, surfacing dependencies, and helping evaluate business value, risk, and readiness.
* Collaborate with the Technical Product Owners and broader team on scope, sequencing, sprint planning, feature readiness, deployment preparation, and progress tracking.
* Help build and apply cross-domain knowledge to work effectively across functional areas, connect related impacts and dependencies, and help sustain continuity as priorities evolve.
* Review bugs, support tickets, and business requests in depth to assess impact, clarify issues, and help prepare recommendations for prioritization and resolution.

jobs.title: Digital Solution Designer
jobs.description:
**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About Divami**

Divami is a design partner to product companies working on hard, high-stakes problems in AI-first platforms, enterprise SaaS, financial products, and category-defining tools. Our clients do not come to us because their designs need polish. They come to us because their product needs to become a decision engine rather than a well-styled interface, and we turn strategy into shipped work with the frameworks to make it repeatable.

**The role**

You would own the design solution across a client engagement end-to-end. That work starts before the brief, in the effort of framing what the actual problem is. It runs through information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, and the invisible logic tying them together. And it continues past the handover into the health of the client relationship itself. You would be the person clients trust to sharpen their thinking rather than just deliver against it, and you would produce frameworks other people at Divami reuse without rework.

**What you’ll own**

* **Client success, not just deliverables.**
  You measure your work by renewal, expansion, and satisfaction rather than by whether the file was handed off on time. Accounts grow because of your ownership.
* **The problem before the solution.**
  You proactively close gaps in user or business understanding before anyone flags them. If something is fuzzy, you name it and go after it, rather than waiting for the brief to catch up.
* **The whole solution, not just the screens.**
  Information architecture, key decision moments, edge cases, empty states, and the invisible logic tying them together.
* **Direction, not just execution.**
  You shape client or product direction through design thinking and innovation judgment. When the situation calls for it, you push for disruptive or category-defining solutions rather than defending against safe defaults.
* **Design rationale others can rely on.**
  You document trade-offs, decisions, and the reasoning behind them so the next person on the account is not starting from zero.
* **Reusable IP.**
  You produce frameworks, patterns, and playbooks that other designers at Divami pick up and use as they are. Your work compounds beyond your own engagements.
* **The room.**
  You handle direct client pushback with reasoning rather than defensiveness. You walk into leadership presentations without a safety net and walk out with alignment.
* **The bench.**
  You coach other designers in business-first thinking, disruptive versus incremental framing, and client handling. Designers around you level up because you are on the account.

**How you’ll think**

* **Problems get sharpened before they get solved.**
  You find the 20 percent that drives 80 percent of the value, and you name it clearly enough that everyone on the account can see the same problem.
* **Outcomes are visible at the moment of decision.**
  Every screen should tell the user and the business what happens next, and why. If the outcome is invisible, the design is not done.
* **Reasoning is portable.**
  Trade-offs get documented, decisions get explained, and the thinking behind a call is captured so the next person picks up where you left off.
* **Disruptive or incremental is a choice, not a default.**
  You know when to push for the category-defining answer and when the safe one is genuinely the right call. You can defend both.
* **Client success is a design metric.**
  Renewal, expansion, and satisfaction sit inside how you measure your own work, not outside it.
* **Multiplication over addition.**
  Your best work compounds through the frameworks others use, not through the individual files you personally shipped.

**The craft**

* **UX and product design mastery.**
  Information architecture, interaction patterns, decision flows, edge cases, and design systems. Craft you can defend on principle rather than just on intuition.
* **Business fluency.**
  Reading the shape of a business, sizing an opportunity, and sizing the risk of a design choice. You can talk to a CXO in their language, not just yours.
* **Facilitation.**
  Workshops, alignment sessions, and co-creation with clients. You can hold a room when the room disagrees.
* **Executive presence.**
  Walking a leadership team through a hard call without breaking rapport, and reframing the conversation when the reasoning holds up.
* **Framework thinking.**
  Turning specific learnings from one engagement into reusable IP that helps the whole practice get better.
* **Written and visual communication that lands.**
  Strategy docs, decision memos, walkthroughs, and slides that carry an argument on their own.

**Signals we look for**

These are patterns we watch for in how you talk about past work rather than items to tick off a checklist.

* **You describe a project by its client outcome.**
  The deliverable list is the least interesting part of the story you tell.
* **You can point to a moment you disagreed with a client.**
  You held the line with reasoning, and it changed the direction of the work.
* **You have produced something others still use.**
  A framework, a playbook, a decision pattern, or a system that other designers pick up without rework.
* **When you describe ambiguity, you describe how you closed it,**
  not how you flagged it.
* **You have a view on when to build the incremental thing**
  and when to push for the disruptive one. You can defend both calls.
* **You measure your work by what happened after it shipped,**
  not by how it looked at handoff.

**Qualifications**

* **4 to 8 years**
  designing digital products across SaaS, enterprise, fintech, or platforms with real complexity. Meaningful time in senior IC or lead roles.
* **A portfolio of decisions, not just artifacts.**
  Case studies that show how you moved from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution, and where you traded off.
* **Evidence of account ownership.**
  Concrete examples of relationships you grew, renewed, or expanded because of how you showed up, not just because of what you shipped.
* **Executive-room confidence.**
  You can present to a CXO, hear a hard pushback, and respond with reasoning that reframes the conversation without getting defensive.

**Why this role**

* **Ownership that is real.**
  You own the account, the outcome, and the direction, not just a Figma file.
* **A new domain every quarter.**
  AI-first platforms, enterprise tools, financial products, and industry-defining software. Range that compresses years of learning.
* **Frameworks that are actually used.**
  Divami’s methodology (VEDA), empathy-led frameworks, and outcome-driven approaches we have validated across real client work.
* **Room to shape how we work,**
  not just what we ship. If you have opinions about how design should be practiced, we want them on the table.
* **A bench of people**
  who take craft and business seriously in equal measure.

jobs.description:
**Our Company**

We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high-performance data infrastructure means that customers - from banks to theme parks - can focus on achieving the incredible with data.

If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate - and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team - and who get excited about making a real-world impact with data.

  

**Location- Hyderabad/ Hybrid.**

**Shift- 24/7 shift**

  

**Meet Our Team**

The Cyber Dfense team is responsible for protecting Hitachi Vantara from cybersecurity threats through continuous monitoring, incident detection, investigation, containment, and recovery activities. Operating within a global Follow-the-Sun model, the team plays a critical role in protecting the organization's systems, data, intellectual property, and business operations from cyberattacks and advanced threats.

We are looking for a highly motivated cybersecurity professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex security challenges, and is passionate about strengthening the organization's cyber resilience.

**What You'll Be Doing**

As a Senior Cyber Security Incident Responder, you will lead the investigation and response to cybersecurity incidents across enterprise environments. You will serve as a technical leader during security incidents, coordinating containment, eradication, and recovery efforts while minimizing business impact.

Key responsibilities include:

* Investigate and respond to complex cybersecurity incidents, including malware, ransomware, phishing, business email compromise, account compromise, insider threats, data exfiltration, and others.
* Perform advanced threat hunting and forensic analysis to identify indicators of compromise and determine incident scope and impact.
* Analyze alerts generated by security monitoring platforms and perform triage, investigation, and escalation activities.
* Coordinate incident response activities with IT, Legal, Privacy, HR, Communications, and business stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, procedures, and operational documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve detection capabilities and collaborate with engineering teams to implement new monitoring use cases.
* Lead post-incident reviews and lessons learned exercises to strengthen security operations and response effectiveness.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior analysts and incident responders.
* Support a global 24x7 Follow-the-Sun Cyber Defense operating model through effective collaboration and incident handoff processes.

  

**What You Bring**

* 5 years in Experience in cybersecurity incident response, security operations, digital forensics, or threat hunting.
* Strong understanding of attack techniques, threat actor tactics, and incident response methodologies.
* Experience investigating cloud(AWS, azure or GCP any cloud), identity, endpoint, network, and email security incidents.
* Should have of security frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST 800-61, MITRE ATTCK, and Cyber Kill Chain.
* Experience with SIEM (Splunk), EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, and security monitoring technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* TTPS- security - Mandatory

  

**About us**

We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data-driven leaders that can a make positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.

**#LI-RS1**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

**? Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**? Azure API Management depth,** including policy expressions, reusable policy fragments and the AI or LLM policy set.

**? Microsoft Entra ID experience,** including managed identity, app registrations and conditional access.

**? Experience with reliability engineering for AI or machine learning systems,** including quality regression detection, drift monitoring or evaluation-driven alerting.

**? Familiarity with emerging agent identity models** and how agent-to-service authentication differs from conventional service-to-service patterns.

**? Experience implementing chargeback or showback** for a shared platform service.

**? Enterprise workflow integration,** such as ServiceNow APIs for approval-driven provisioning.

**? Experience in financial services or another regulated industry,** where security review governs the pace of change.

**? Familiarity with agent frameworks** and how agents consume model endpoints, tools and memory.

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.
  
  
**Your Role in Our Mission**
As a Senior Product Manager at NEXT Ventures, you will shape product strategy and drive the development of impactful solutions across our fintech ecosystem. You will identify opportunities for improvement, translate customer and business needs into product priorities, and help evolve products across areas such as proprietary trading, payment solutions, and mobile application user experiences. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will ensure our products are customer-focused, scalable, and aligned with our business goals.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**
**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Own and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for key areas of the trading and brokerage ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer experiences, operational efficiency, and commercial performance through market research, competitor analysis, and customer insights.
* Translate business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory considerations into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes.

**Product Ownership & Execution**

* Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Own and prioritise the product backlog, developing clear product requirement documents, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Work closely with Engineering, Design, QA, and Operations teams to ensure effective planning, high-quality delivery, and timely releases.
* Oversee integrations and enhancements across trading platforms, CRM systems, client portals, and internal back-office solutions.
* Drive improvements across critical customer journeys, including registration, KYC, account opening, deposits, withdrawals, and Introducing Broker (IB) operations.
* Lead internal rollouts, stakeholder alignment, and training to ensure successful adoption of new products and features.

**Product Performance & Optimisation**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, using data, customer feedback, and business insights to guide product decisions.
* Identify friction points across the customer journey and drive initiatives to improve onboarding, activation, transaction success, and retention.
* Drive measurable improvements in customer sign-up time and operational turnaround across the brokerage ecosystem.
* Apply prioritisation frameworks such as RICE, Kano, and impact-effort analysis to balance customer value, business impact, and engineering capacity.
* Establish feedback loops and continuous improvement practices to ensure products remain competitive, reliable, and scalable.

**Technical, Risk & Regulatory Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Engineering teams on APIs, database structures, system architecture, and third-party integrations.
* Work with Compliance, Risk, and Operations to ensure product requirements align with applicable regulatory obligations and internal controls.
* Evaluate technical solutions and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities and agentic workflows, to identify practical opportunities for product innovation.
* Balance product usability, technical feasibility, security, scalability, and regulatory requirements throughout the development lifecycle.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning complex products and shaping product strategy in fintech, technology, or digital-first environments.
* Experience driving product vision, domain roadmaps, and strategic initiatives beyond day-to-day feature delivery.
* Strong expertise in at least one of the following areas:

+ Proprietary Trading & Brokerage: Experience with prop trading platforms, CFD/forex brokerage products, trading ecosystems, or related financial products.
+ Payments & Financial Products: Experience with payment gateways, payment processing, acquiring, issuing, digital wallets, transaction infrastructure, or financial workflows.
+ Mobile Applications & User Experience: Experience shaping mobile product strategy, improving app usability, optimising customer journeys, and driving mobile engagement and adoption.

* Strong commercial acumen and the ability to evaluate opportunities based on business value, customer impact, and long-term growth.
* Analytical and strategic thinking skills, with experience using product data, customer insights, and market research to guide decisions.
* Technical fluency to engage in discussions around APIs, integrations, system architecture, databases, and platform capabilities.
* Sufficient AI literacy to evaluate AI technologies, agent frameworks, and emerging applications from a product perspective.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and aligning cross-functional teams around a shared product vision.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related field.

**Your X-Factor**

* Strategic Product Thinking: You see beyond individual features and connect product decisions to broader business outcomes.
* Domain Depth: You bring meaningful expertise in payments or prop trading products.
* Commercial Mindset: You understand how product decisions influence revenue, customer acquisition, retention, and operational efficiency.
* Ownership & Influence: You navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and influence senior stakeholders.
* Customer-First Innovation: You combine customer empathy with commercial and technical understanding.
* Future-Focused Perspective: You translate emerging technologies into practical product opportunities.

**Your Journey after Applying**

* 30 minute HR interview with the Talent Acquisition team member
* 45 minute Problem Solving Interview
* 60-minute Bar Raiser Interview

**Why Join NEXT**
At NEXT Ventures, we believe the right talent fuels breakthrough innovation. If you're driven to connect great minds with big ideas and want to shape the future of fintech, we’d love to meet you. Join our team of bold thinkers where technology meets transformation.
  
  
Apply now and be part of our journey — the future is calling, and it starts with you.

jobs.description:
**About Us**

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior product leader to lead our Internal Platform Product organization and build the systems that enable our financial and digital-asset businesses to operate efficiently, reliably, and at scale.

You will own the product strategy, architecture, roadmap, and team development for internal platform products spanning payments and assets, user and security systems, CRM, customer engagement, and multi-jurisdiction compliance infrastructure. Your mandate is to turn fragmented business requirements into coherent, reusable capabilities and move the organization from requirement-taking and feature delivery to end-to-end ownership of business outcomes.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a senior product leader who combines technical product judgment, financial-services knowledge, and commercialization experience to turn existing financial and digital-asset technology capabilities into enterprise products for external customers.

Financial Cloud aims to provide digital-asset and Web3 technology infrastructure to traditional financial institutions and other enterprise customers. Starting with customer needs, you will determine which capabilities, including trading technology, wallets, and custody-related technology, should be productized first. You will establish a focused product proposition, a viable commercial model, and a repeatable delivery approach, progressing from customer validation toward sustainable growth.

**What You Will Own**

* **Target customers and initial use cases.**
  Conduct customer discovery and market validation to identify priority customer segments, critical problems, buying motivations, and decision-makers. Select a focused initial product and use case rather than commercializing every available capability at once.
* **Financial Cloud product strategy.**
  Turn underlying technology into products that customers can evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use over time. Define the product portfolio, module catalog, value proposition, functional boundaries, API contracts, and roadmap.
* **Enterprise productization.**
  Partner with technical teams to define tenant and data isolation, access controls, configuration, auditability, APIs and SDKs, customer-facing management interfaces, monitoring, and operational requirements. Choose appropriate hosted, private, or other deployment models based on validated customer needs.
* **Commercial models.**
  Work with sales, finance, and relevant teams on product packaging, pricing, and billing. Validate willingness to pay, implementation economics, and ongoing service costs. Support presales, pilots, and the definition of product scope and commitments in customer contracts.
* **First-customer adoption.**
  Partner with sales, solution, and delivery teams to move customers through proof of concept, pilot, acceptance, and production use. Define clear success criteria and turn customer learning into product improvements without allowing customization to expand without limits.
* **Repeatable delivery.**
  Establish the boundary between standard products and customization. Improve documentation, onboarding, implementation standards, version compatibility, and lifecycle management to reduce per-customer delivery effort and improve the customer experience.
* **Technology-provider boundaries.**
  Work with legal, compliance, security, and architecture teams to clarify service scope, data and access responsibilities, key-control responsibilities, customer regulatory obligations, and service commitments. Ensure product design and commercial representations remain consistent with approved activities.
* **Team and investment priorities.**
  Build a product team suited to the zero-to-one stage and lead cross-functional execution. Align with the Internal Platform product leader on capability reuse, engineering dependencies, and priorities, avoiding customer-specific duplication of core systems.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Senior enterprise product experience, with end-to-end ownership of product definition, delivery, and commercialization from zero to one. You can explain how you selected customers, established product boundaries, and validated paid demand.
* Experience building platform or technical products such as financial infrastructure, developer platforms, API products, enterprise SaaS, financial cloud, payment infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure.
* A track record commercializing products for external enterprise customers, with an understanding of procurement, security reviews, pilots, contracts, deployment, acceptance, and ongoing service requirements.
* The ability to translate complex technology into customer value and engage deeply with engineering on architecture boundaries, APIs, data isolation, deployment models, and non-functional requirements.
* Strong judgment in pricing, packaging, implementation economics, and standardization, including explicit trade-offs between customer customization and the long-term product roadmap.
* An understanding of regulatory constraints in financial services and digital assets. You can identify matters requiring legal or compliance review and translate confirmed boundaries into product and delivery requirements.
* Cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to make progress with a lean team while the product proposition and market are still being validated.
* Professional working proficiency in English for product discussions with international customers and partners. Mandarin language skill is a big plus.

**Strongly Preferred**

* Experience turning internal technology capabilities into standardized external products with paying customers.
* Experience serving banks, brokerages, payment institutions, asset managers, or other regulated financial institutions.
* Experience with trading technology, wallets, MPC, custody-related technology, digital-asset infrastructure, or asset tokenization.
* Experience with multi-tenant products, private or hybrid deployments, international delivery, or channel and ecosystem partnerships.
* A track record turning pilots or custom implementations into repeatable products and delivery models, demonstrated through adoption, revenue, or cost improvements.

**Leadership Profile**

You understand technology and actively engage with customers to test demand. You can select the most valuable initial product from a broad set of capabilities, make evidence-based decisions, and decline customization that undermines the product direction. You distinguish validated customer needs from assumptions and explain both clearly.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A validated target customer segment, priority use case, and value proposition translate into concrete purchasing or paid-use behavior.
* Initial customers integrate and use

**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to lead design for Krak and help us build a neobank people trust with their everyday money.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role with responsibility for design across the product. You’ll set the direction for the Krak experience, influence product strategy, and stay close to the details through execution.
  
  
We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.

You’ll help make those experiences clear and reliable, bringing the same care to everyday interactions as you do to the overall product vision.

jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Payward Services is an enterprise infrastructure platform that enables companies to seamlessly integrate trading, payments, funding, and digital asset services through a single unified system. It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
  
  
Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.
  
  
The team is looking for a product manager to shape the future of this platform, from the architecture underneath to the API layer internal clients build on. At the center is Payward's in-house PSP: a scalable, multi-tenant payments backend with hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs, so any Payward business can plug in and reach pay-in and payout rails worldwide.

* Own the product vision and roadmap for the Payward payments platform, covering both the shared backend and the integration surfaces internal clients build on (hosted pages, SDKs, embedded components and direct APIs)
* Map requirements across internal clients and use them to evolve the platform's vision and capabilities so it serves a growing range of use cases
* Partner with engineering to turn the target vision into a sequenced, high-impact roadmap, with milestones every client team can plan against
* Prioritize across competing client needs, make the trade-offs visible, and say no with a clear rationale
* Shape the client experience end to end, from first conversation to go-live, so teams can adopt the platform without heavy hand-holding
* Work with the banking and partnerships teams so each new PSP or bank integration is built once on the platform and reaches every Payward business
* Bring compliance, risk and legal requirements across Payward's entities and jurisdictions into the roadmap early, before they become launch blockers
* Set and track platform success metrics, such as time to launch a rail for an existing client, time for a new client to go live, share of rails available through the platform, and payment success rates

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in a platform, API or infrastructure role where your customers were other internal teams or developers
* Working knowledge of payments: pay-ins and payouts, PSPs and acquirers, bank rails (ACH, SEPA, Faster Payments, SWIFT and local methods), and how money flows between them
* Strong technical fluency. You can read an RFC, challenge an architecture decision, and write an API spec that engineers respect
* Experience shipping developer-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or embeddable UI components

* Skill at managing many stakeholders with different priorities, and building alignment without direct authority
* Comfort working with data to set goals and measure platform adoption and performance

* Experience at a PSP, payment orchestrator or payments infrastructure company, or building one in-house
* Background with multi-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms

* Experience working across multiple regulated legal entities or licensing regimes

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

jobs.title: Associate Product Specialist, Launch Program 2027 – Dubai, UAE (UAE National Preferred)
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Associate Product Specialist, Launch Program 2027 – Dubai, UAE (UAE National Preferred)
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company behind the world’s fastest payments processing network. We are a vehicle for commerce, a connection to financial systems for the previously excluded, a technology innovation lab, and the home of Priceless®. We ensure every employee has the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and to change lives. We believe as our company grows, so should you. We believe in connecting everyone to endless, priceless possibilities.
  
  
Our Purpose
  
  
We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
  
  
Why join Mastercard’s Launch Program?
  
  
Over the course of this 18-month program, you'll build specialized expertise through hands-on experience, structured learning, and mentorship from industry leaders. You'll work on real business challenges, applying your skills to projects that create meaningful impact. Along the way, you'll deepen your knowledge of Mastercard's business, collaborate with teams across the organization, and develop the technical, analytical, and professional capabilities needed to accelerate your career. By the end of the program, you’ll have a strong foundation in your chosen field and the confidence to continue to grow here at Mastercard.
  
  
Product Management
  
  
You will have the chance to learn how to develop business cases for new product opportunities, develop scalable customer-centric products, and see those projects through to go-to-market. When joining one of our highly collaborative product teams, you will have the opportunity to build and manage great products. We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for developing scalable customer-centric products with agility and excellence.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**As An Associate Product Specialist, Product Management, You Will**
Identify and measure product and business metrics to increase adoption and understand customers’ ongoing needs
  
  
Conduct iterative experiments to identify and prioritise key features for inclusion with product releases and product roadmap
  
  
Assist customers to resolve operational issues that have been escalated
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, with an anticipated graduation date between March 2026 and August 2027
  
  
Available to start on 1st March or 1st September 2027
  
  
Analytical and problem-solving skills
  
  
Strong strategic and conceptual aptitude
  
  
High-energy, can-do attitude, very strong sense of ownership
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Consumer Platforms, CEMEA
jobs.description:

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa is evolving its consumer-facing platforms to create stronger customer value propositions, enable new product solutions, and support sustainable growth across CEMEA.
  
  
The Senior Manager, Consumer Platforms CEMEA will support the strategic evolution of Visa's consumer-facing and backend platforms, helping shape the products, propositions, customer experiences, and solutions that can be built through them in the future.

* Shape the CEMEA consumer platform strategy across internal and external platforms, defining how capabilities should evolve to support future products, propositions and customer experiences.
* Structure complex and ambiguous business problems, evaluate strategic options and translate insights into clear recommendations, business cases and executable solutions.

* Develop investment recommendations and performance frameworks to assess platform health, customer outcomes, adoption, commercial impact, cost and return on investment.
* Lead cross-functional and cross regional strategic discussions and develop executive-ready recommendations to align regional and global stakeholders, resolve trade-offs and support senior leadership decisions.
* Act as a strategic thought partner to Consumer Solutions leadership, bringing external perspectives from digital commerce, marketplaces, mobility, travel, fintech and emerging consumer technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, P2P & Local Transfers
jobs.description:
**Department:**
B2C Debit, Product
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Lev Novak
  
  
**Description**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager located (or ready for relocation) in the UAE to lead the development and growth of our P2P and local transfer products in Tabby Cash. Since our vision is to become a financial service for daily use, we need a passionate, driven individual to make sending money to friends and family a daily habit for millions of Tabby customers.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
* Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
* Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).
  
  
If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Marketing & Product Content Specialist – Fintech & Banking (MEA)
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven Marketing & Product Content Specialist with 5 to 7 years of regional experience to drive brand awareness, lead generation, and market expansion across the Middle East and Africa (MEA).

This is a hybrid role. Half of the position covers core B2B marketing: market research, LinkedIn and digital marketing, event participation, and website and social media improvement. The other half is a product marketing and content function: working directly with product owners and innovation teams to understand the mobile banking and fintech products being developed for banks and financial institutions, and turning them into clear, compelling sales material that the Sales and Business Development teams can use in the field.

The ideal candidate blends creative storytelling with analytical rigor, can speak confidently with technical and product teams, and translates complex financial products into compelling market propositions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Marketing & Product Content Development**

* Meet regularly with product owners, solution architects, and innovation teams to learn about mobile banking and fintech products being developed, including their features, use cases, differentiators, and roadmap.

* Create and maintain a library of sales-ready product material: product profiles, product presentations, product flyers, one-pagers, solution briefs, and demo storylines.

* Translate technical product capabilities into clear business benefits for banks and financial institutions, tailored by segment and region.

* Partner with Sales and Business Development to understand customer objections and information needs, and update product material accordingly.

* Keep all product collateral accurate, version-controlled, and aligned with product releases and brand guidelines.

* Support proposals, RFP responses, and customer presentations with product messaging and supporting content.

**Lead Generation & Market Research**

* Run LinkedIn-based lead generation, including targeted outreach, content-led campaigns, and LinkedIn Campaign Manager activity, to build a qualified pipeline for the sales team.

* Use market research, AI tools, and other data and enrichment platforms to identify target banks, financial institutions, decision makers, and emerging opportunities across MEA.

* Conduct continuous competitor benchmarking and market analysis to identify regulatory updates, regional banking trends, and emerging customer demands.

**Strategy & Campaign Management**

* Plan, manage, and optimize multi-channel campaigns spanning digital, direct, email, and partner channels to meet pipeline targets.

* Manage and allocate the regional marketing budget, monitoring return on investment (ROI) and cost-per-acquisition across all channels.

**Events & Exhibitions**

* Support event marketing and physical presence at key regional fintech and banking expos (e.g., Dubai Fintech Summit, Seamless Middle East & Africa, GITEX Global).

* Manage event execution, including booth design, collateral production, speaker placements, pre-event outreach, and on-site lead-capture workflows.

* Coordinate with event organizers, stand builders, and regional suppliers, ensuring delivery against deadlines.

**Digital Marketing, SEO & Web**

* Own the company's regional digital footprint across display and social media platforms, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and Google marketing.

* Manage and improve website content, ensuring strong user experience, conversion-rate optimization, and mobile responsiveness, including dedicated product pages built from the new product material.

* Execute technical and on-page SEO strategies to maintain visibility for high-intent fintech search queries.

* Track, evaluate, and report channel performance using Google Analytics (GA4), HubSpot/CRM dashboards, and search consoles.

**Brand & Content**

* Safeguard brand identity and governance across all regional touchpoints, presentations, and product collateral.

* Produce tailored B2B content including whitepapers, case studies, press releases, newsletters, and executive thought-leadership articles.

**Candidate Qualifications**

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline from an accredited university (e.g., American University in Dubai, University of Wollongong in Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, Heriot-Watt University Dubai, or equivalent).

**Professional Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with a proven track record within fintech, banking, or financial software.

* Demonstrated experience in product marketing or product content creation, such as product profiles, presentations, and sales enablement material.

* Demonstrated experience managing regional campaigns and exhibitions across Middle East and African markets.

* Proven experience generating B2B leads through LinkedIn and research-driven outreach.

**Technical & Platform Skills**

* Hands-on mastery of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and SEO audit tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Moz).

* Proficient in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, search platforms, and email automation and CRM tools (HubSpot, Marketo, or similar).

* Practical experience using AI and research tools for market research, lead identification, and content drafting.

* Experience with website CMS platforms (WordPress, Webflow) and a basic understanding of HTML/CSS.

* Strong presentation and design skills (PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) for product decks, flyers, and social media creative.

**Competencies & Language**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic or French proficiency is an advantage for North and West African market coverage.

* Ability to understand technical banking and mobile banking products and explain them simply to business audiences.

* Strong stakeholder skills, with the confidence to work with product owners, innovation teams, and senior sales leaders.

* Strong numerical aptitude with experience tracking customer journey metrics, attribution models, and marketing budgets.

* Outstanding project management and vendor negotiation skills.

Work Location: In person
