jobs.title: Delivery Program Director
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.

Education

* Develop and enhance AED spot, forward, and derivatives market-making capabilities.
* Execute transactions across approved asset classes within authorized limits.
* Build and maintain relationships with external pricing providers to secure optimal transaction pricing.

* Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, compliance, and AML requirements.
* Provide coaching, development, and on-the-job training to junior team members.
* Develop innovative solutions and trading ideas to support client requirements.
* Manage and hedge foreign exchange flow business exposures.
* Ensure product programs are established and maintained for all relevant products.
* Ensure appropriate trading and counterparty documentation is maintained, including ISDA, CSA, and Islamic agreements.
* Maintain adequate counterparty limits to facilitate effective risk management and hedging activities.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or a related discipline.
* Strong computer literacy.
* Minimum 10 years of experience within a bank treasury environment.
* Demonstrated experience in both flow and principal trading activities.
* Experience across Foreign Exchange (spot, forwards and options), Interest Rate Derivatives (IRS, FRA, IRO, futures), Commodity Hedging, and Structured Products.
* Proven people leadership experience managing trading teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, planning, and organizational skills.

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.

jobs.title: Business Head - BFSI
jobs.description:
Business Head – BFSI | OTPless

Bengaluru or Mumbai · On-site · 8–12 years

**ABOUT OTPLESS**

OTPless builds the authentication, identity and trust infrastructure for digital businesses. We power login and user journeys for Zepto, Meesho, Ixigo and ShareChat, we run 300Mn+ silent verifications a month, and we're backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. We were founded by the founding team at BharatPe.

Authentication is where we started — Smart Auth is live across some of India's largest consumer and financial businesses. Our next growth engine is OTPless Watch, a device and risk intelligence platform that combines device fingerprinting, app protection, telecom and IP signals, and identity data to help businesses spot suspicious activity and make better risk decisions. Watch sits right next to Smart Auth, so businesses get authentication and fraud intelligence from one place.

**THE ROLE**

We're hiring a Business Head to own the entire OTPless BFSI business — the full vertical, end to end, across Smart Auth, Watch and everything we take to market in financial services.

You'll own the BFSI P&L outright: the strategy, the revenue, the customers and the roadmap. That means growing and deepening our existing Smart Auth footprint in BFSI, and opening the next frontier with Watch — starting with fintechs and NBFCs, then banks and insurance. You'll find the market, prove the products, carry the number, and build the business.

You won't be starting from zero. Smart Auth is already live in production with Navi, Paytm and Bajaj, which gives you relationships, reference customers and a running start to expand across the vertical and pull Watch into live accounts.

This is a hands-on ownership role — you'll lead the biggest deals yourself and work directly with the CBO and the founders, with real influence over product, pricing and strategy.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* The business. The full BFSI P&L — strategy, revenue growth and ownership across the vertical. You decide which fintechs, NBFCs, banks and insurers to go after, grow the accounts we already have, build the relationships that matter across Product, Risk, Fraud and Business teams, and set the pricing and commercial models that make the motion repeatable.

* The market fit. Run discovery with real buyers, find the use cases where OTPless wins, and work directly with the Product and Engineering teams to turn what you hear into roadmap. Use our live Smart Auth relationships to expand accounts and pull Watch into them.

* The deals. Lead consultative engagements end to end — discovery, solution design, technical evaluation, POC, commercial close and expansion — across the full OTPless stack. Prove measurable outcomes, not demos.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

Above all, someone who can own and grow a BFSI business — a builder who carries revenue, closes senior deals and can be trusted with the full vertical. Beyond that, we're looking for:

Domain & experience

* 8–12 years across product, growth, strategy or business roles, with real ownership of revenue or outcomes
* Deep experience in fintech, payments, UPI, digital lending, NBFCs, banking or insurance, and a real grasp of the Indian BFSI ecosystem
* A track record on products or deals involving fraud, risk, trust and safety, identity, authentication or digital onboarding
* Live relationships inside fintechs and NBFCs; connections into banks and insurers are a plus

Product & technical depth

* You don't have to code, but you're technically credible — you can sit with an engineer, understand how it works, and shape what gets built
* Comfort with APIs, SDKs, device intelligence, fingerprinting, SIM binding, risk scoring and digital onboarding flows
* You can translate what a customer needs into product requirements, and work with Product and Engineering to get it built

Business & growth instinct

* You turn market opportunities into revenue — hunting new logos and growing the accounts you already have
* Strong consultative selling, senior stakeholder management and commercial negotiation
* An entrepreneurial streak — you can operate alone, build from nothing, and own the outcome end to end

**STRONG SIGNALS**

This is likely to fit people coming from:

* Payments & fintech: Juspay, Razorpay, PhonePe, Paytm, Cashfree, CRED
* Lending & NBFCs: Navi, KreditBee, Fibe, Lendingkart and other tech-led lenders
* Fraud, risk & identity: Bureau, SHIELD, Signzy, HyperVerge, IDfy, GoKwik
* Banks & financial institutions: product, digital banking, payments and fraud-risk leaders

We're especially keen on product, growth and strategy people who've worked close to business, tech and risk teams and now want to own a business, not a backlog.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 6 MONTHS)**

* A clear BFSI strategy and target-account universe across the full OTPless portfolio
* Existing Smart Auth accounts grown and deepened, with measurable revenue
* 5–10 lighthouse fintech/NBFC wins across Smart Auth and Watch, with banks and insurers seeded in the pipeline
* A repeatable business development and account-growth motion
* Validated high-value use cases that have moved the product roadmap
* Real cross-sell between Smart Auth and Watch

**WHY OTPLESS**

You'll own an entire vertical with real P&L responsibility, at the intersection of payments, identity and fraud — three of the spaces moving fastest in Indian financial services. You build on top of an authentication platform and customer base that already exist, not a blank page.

You'll work directly with the CBO and the founders — the founding team behind BharatPe — backed by General Catalyst, FJ Labs, SIDBI, Amrish Rau and Kunal Shah. It's early enough that you shape the business, the product and the commercial model, with the autonomy and ownership of a founder and the backing of a company that's already at scale.

If you're ready to move past managing a product and own a business, let's talk.

 Respond quickly to call-back requests and ensure all leads are handled within defined SLAs Log, update, and follow up with customers in the CRM until the journey is completed or closed

Experience: 1-3 years of experience in inbound telesales, or customer success, or any direct customer facing role; preferably in tech or financial services.

Embark on a transformative journey as a Business Analyst-VP, where you’ll primarily responsible for Requirement analysis and specification through to data analysis co-relating client, business and colleagues (operations) impact and experience. The delivery focused role will work closely with the project and business stakeholders to ensure smooth change management.
  
  
**To be successful in this role, you should have experience with:**

* Own and manage requirement related aspects of the change delivery life cycle from inception, solution design through to implementation and post implementation support.
* Provision of subject matter expertise to support the collaboration between the product owner and the technical side of product development.
* Work in-line with overall Barclays strategy across Technology delivery and Business operations change.
* Identify, quantify, plan and control all business design and analysis related activity on change projects.
* Identify, analyze, manage and monitor relationships with and between stakeholders.
* Manage multiple work streams of project activity.
* Requirements elicitation and documentation, using User Stories, including responsibilities of similar deliverables of fellow BA team members.
* End-to-end requirements management and traceability, both functional and non-functional.

**Some Of Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Has ability to investigate, analyze, visualize, articulate and solve complex problems and concepts and make disciplined decisions based on available information.
* Can identify and explores opportunities for service and business improvement.
* Practitioner of agile methodology and how to apply the agile mindset to all aspects of their work.
* Has ability to identify and pinpoint business opportunities to allow organizations to perform more effectively.
* Exposure to toolsets across Requirements documentation, Configuration Management and Quality assurance.
* Experience in Bookkeeping, Accounting, General Ledger and periodic Deposit and Loans interest calculation processes.
* Experience in Tools that are used for Capturing Requirements in Agile(Jira, Rally etc.) and Confluence.
* Ability to understand the requirements and communicate /disseminate the same effectively to multiple stakeholders.
* Previous experience on projects having Liquidity Management implementations.
* Experience in large scale product implementation including integration various upstream and downstream applications in Bank’s estate using various communication protocols.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The location of the role is Pune, IN
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To collaborate with product owners and other technical teams involved in the product development process and utilise their knowledge of the bank’s technologies to enact the vision defined in the product roadmap.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Provision of subject matter expertise to support the collaboration between the product owner and the technical side of product development.
* Support the development and implementation of the product strategy and vision defined in the product roadmap and communicate them with the relevant stakeholders and the development team.
* Collaboration with internal stakeholders to gather and prioritise product requirements and features based on business value and feasibility that are well defined, measurable and secure.
* Development and implementation of assessments to ensure continuous testing and improvement of product quality and performance.
* Monitoring of product performance to identify opportunities for optimisation that meets the banks performance standards.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improve product development and delivery.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Director_SCDL
jobs.description:
Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning (SCDL), Pune, is one of India’s largest and most reputed standalone autonomous distance learning institutions, established in 2001. Over the past two decades, SCDL has empowered more than 10 lakh learners across India and over 30 countries through flexible, industry-relevant programs. The institute offers a wide portfolio of postgraduate diplomas, diplomas and certificate programs across Management, IT, Banking and emerging domains, catering to both fresh graduates and working professionals. With a strong focus on technology-enabled learning and blended pedagogy, SCDL continues to be a pioneer in accessible, career-oriented education.

**🔹 Role: Director – Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning (SCDL), Pune**

As part of its growth and expansion strategy, SCDL is seeking a visionary, tech-savvy and business-driven leader from an EdTech / Digital Learning ecosystem to lead and scale its Open and Distance Learning initiatives.

**🔹 Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum 12–18 years of experience, preferably with significant exposure to:
* EdTech companies / Online learning platforms
* Distance / Open / Digital education institutions
* Proven experience in business development, revenue generation and scaling operations
* Demonstrated leadership in driving digital transformation and EdTech initiatives
* Strong understanding of student lifecycle, learner engagement and retention strategies
* Experience in managing large teams and multi-functional operations

**🔹 Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in management / Ed-Tech/ Education from a recognized university
* Ph.D. Management, B. Ed, M. Ed (preferred)

* Strong EdTech orientation with business acumen

* Entrepreneurial leader with ability to build and scale new verticals
* Strong industry network and partnership orientation
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment

**🔹 Key Responsibilities**

1. **Strategic Leadership, Growth & Digital Transformation**

* Develop and execute a long-term strategy for Open, Distance & Online (ODL) education with strong EdTech integration

* Leverage data analytics for decision-making, learner insights and performance tracking
* Collaborate with product, tech and academic teams to build next-gen digital learning journeys

**3. Business Development & Industry Partnerships**

* Drive operational excellence through automation, process optimization, and digital workflows
* Monitor KPIs across business growth, learner success, and operational efficiency

**5. Academic Innovation & Quality Assurance**

* Drive future-ready curriculum aligned with industry demand and digital economy needs
* Promote instructional design excellence, blended learning models, and digital pedagogy
* Ensure compliance with UGC (ODL & Online) and AICTE regulations
* Lead continuous improvement through learning analytics, feedback systems, and outcome measurement
* Foster faculty development in online teaching, digital tools, and content innovation

**6. Leadership & Organizational Impact**

* Provide visionary leadership at institutional level, aligning academic, technology, and business goals

* Demonstrate ability to scale organizations, manage change, and drive transformation initiatives

**We're Hiring: AVP – FLDG & Strategic Lending Partnerships**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Compensation:**
₹18–24 LPA + performance-linked incentives

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About the Role**

KGIL Fintech Solutions is looking for an experienced lending professional to establish and lead our First Loss Default Guarantee (FLDG/DLG) business vertical.

The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying and onboarding lending partners, structuring commercially viable FLDG arrangements, managing portfolio performance, building operational processes and scaling the business independently.

We are looking for someone with strong relationships across banks, NBFCs, fintech companies and lending institutions, combined with practical experience in credit risk, lending operations and portfolio management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. FLDG Business Development**

* Establish and independently scale the FLDG business vertical.
* Identify banks and NBFCs interested in eligible DLG-supported lending arrangements.
* Develop new lending products and commercial opportunities.
* Negotiate partnership agreements and commercial structures.
* Build a sustainable and profitable lending portfolio.

**2. Strategic Lending Partnerships**

* Establish relationships with senior decision-makers across banks and NBFCs.
* Maintain relationships with existing lending institutions.
* Identify additional opportunities in digital lending, loan distribution and co-lending arrangements where applicable.
* Build a diversified lender network.
* Support business continuity across lending partnership channels when required.

**3. End-to-End FLDG Operations**

* Coordinate partner onboarding, underwriting criteria and credit policies.
* Oversee loan sourcing, disbursement coordination and portfolio monitoring.
* Work with regulated lending partners on approved DLG structures.
* Monitor portfolio performance, delinquency, defaults and guarantee utilisation.
* Coordinate reconciliation, claims, collections reporting and settlements with relevant teams.
* Develop operational SOPs and reporting dashboards.

**4. Risk & Portfolio Management**

* Analyse portfolio-level credit risk and profitability.
* Track delinquency buckets, vintage performance and loss trends.
* Recommend appropriate risk controls and portfolio eligibility criteria.
* Coordinate with lending partners' credit and risk teams.
* Ensure the business operates within approved risk limits.

**5. Team Building**

* Recruit and lead a dedicated FLDG business team.
* Build capabilities in alliances, lending operations and portfolio MIS.
* Establish department-level targets and reporting systems.
* Work with internal Technology, Product, Finance and Compliance teams.

**6. Regulatory & Commercial Governance**

* Ensure FLDG arrangements comply with applicable RBI digital lending requirements.
* Coordinate agreement execution with Legal and Compliance.
* Maintain complete portfolio records, lender reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure clear accountability for guarantees, commercial obligations and portfolio performance.

**Candidate Requirements**

* 10–15 years of experience in NBFCs, banks, fintech or digital lending.
* Direct experience managing FLDG/DLG arrangements or credit-risk-sharing programmes.
* Strong existing relationships with banks and NBFCs.
* Knowledge of unsecured personal loans, business loans and digital lending.
* Understanding of credit underwriting, portfolio risk, collections and lending operations.
* Proven experience negotiating commercial lending partnerships.
* Ability to independently establish and manage a business vertical.
* Strong leadership, analytical and execution capabilities.

**Preferred Background**

Candidates currently working as AVP, VP, Business Head, Lending Partnerships Head, FLDG Head or Credit Partnerships Head in an NBFC, bank, fintech or lending platform.

**Our expectation:**
An entrepreneurial business leader who can establish a new lending vertical, generate sustainable revenue, manage risk and build a strong team from the ground up.

jobs.title: Oracle Fusion Payables (AP) Functional Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title: Oracle Fusion Payables (AP) Functional Analyst

**Client:** eClerx  
**Employment Type:** Contract-to-Hire (C2H)  
  
**Locations:** Mumbai, Pune, Gurugram & Chandigarh

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables Functional Analyst with strong hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Financials, particularly the Accounts Payable (AP) module and end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.

The candidate should have experience in functional configuration, implementation, production support, business requirement gathering, invoice processing, payment configuration, approval workflows, accounting, integrations, testing, and quarterly Oracle updates.

The ideal candidate should have worked on at least 2 full-cycle Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations or major support engagements and be capable of independently managing functional workstreams.

Key Responsibilities

* Configure and support Oracle Fusion Cloud Payables, including Business Units, Payables Options, Invoice Options, Invoice Types, Payment Terms, Distribution Sets, Tax, Withholding Tax, Holds, Releases, Payment Methods and Payment Process Profiles.
* Manage the complete Invoice-to-Pay lifecycle, including invoice creation, validation, approvals, payment processing and accounting.
* Work on invoice capture through manual entry, spreadsheet uploads, IDR (Intelligent Document Recognition) and e-invoicing.
* Configure invoice approval workflows using BPM and approval rules.
* Configure 2-way, 3-way and 4-way matching with Procurement, including matching tolerances and exception handling.
* Configure and troubleshoot Subledger Accounting (SLA) rules, accounting distributions and integration with General Ledger (GL).
* Support integration touchpoints with Procurement, Cash Management and Fixed Assets.
* Manage AP period-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliation, uninvoiced receipts and accounting validations.

jobs.description:
**About ModMed**

At ModMed®, we are transforming healthcare through technology. Our mission is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, specialty-specific software solutions that simplify clinical and administrative workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enable better patient care.

Our solutions combine deep healthcare expertise with modern technology to address the complex challenges faced by medical practices. We are a global team of innovators, engineers, product leaders, and healthcare professionals passionate about making a meaningful difference in healthcare.

Join us and help shape the future of healthcare technology!

**About Our Practice Management Product**

ModMed's Practice Management solutions help healthcare practices streamline their administrative, operational, and financial workflows. From scheduling and patient registration to billing, claims management, and revenue cycle operations, our technology helps practices operate more efficiently and manage the business of healthcare.

We continuously evolve our products by leveraging modern technologies, intelligent automation, and AI-driven capabilities to simplify complex workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve financial and operational outcomes for healthcare providers.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on, people-first
**Manager – Product Management**
to lead and develop a team of Product Owners responsible for our Practice Management product portfolio.

This role combines people leadership, product execution, customer engagement, and AI-driven product innovation. You will be responsible for building a high-performing Product Owner team, establishing strong product discovery and requirements practices, and ensuring initiatives deliver measurable value to customers and the business.

A key focus will be defining and validating requirements for AI-powered features and intelligent automation, translating complex healthcare and financial workflows into clear product specifications, and partnering closely with Engineering, Product, and business stakeholders to bring these capabilities to market.

You will own outcomes across the product lifecycle, from problem discovery and prioritisation through development, customer validation, release, and adoption.

**What You'll Do**

**Product & People Leadership**

* Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Product Owners.
* Establish clear ownership, accountability, performance expectations, and development plans across the team.
* Coach Product Owners on product discovery, requirements definition, prioritisation, stakeholder management, and execution.
* Allocate initiatives based on business priorities, team capacity, and individual strengths.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

**Product Strategy & Initiative Ownership**

* Drive execution of the Practice Management product roadmap in alignment with business objectives and customer needs.
* Ensure every initiative has a clearly defined problem statement, expected business outcome, scope, success criteria, and ownership.
* Balance competing priorities and make informed decisions on resource allocation and initiative sequencing.
* Maintain visibility into product progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Ensure initiatives move efficiently from discovery through development, release, and customer adoption.

**AI-Driven Product Requirements & Automation**

* Establish standards for defining, analysing, documenting, and validating requirements for AI-driven features and intelligent automation.
* Translate complex business logic, operational workflows, and automation triggers into clear functional specifications.
* Ensure requirements include detailed workflows, business rules, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and expected system behaviour.
* Partner with Engineering and AI teams to validate technical feasibility, model accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
* Drive appropriate validation of AI-generated outputs, including accuracy, consistency, and compliance considerations.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency.

**Data-Driven Decision Making & Product Prioritisation**

* Leverage product analytics, operational data, and customer insights to identify workflow inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Use data to prioritise automation initiatives that reduce manual effort, improve productivity, and deliver measurable financial outcomes for customers.
* Define and track product success metrics, including feature adoption, workflow efficiency, time saved, automation rates, and financial impact.
* Use SQL for data validation, root-cause analysis, and investigation of product and operational issues.
* Establish a metrics-driven approach to product prioritisation and continuous improvement.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Architecture, AI, and business stakeholders to drive successful product outcomes.
* Work with technical teams to address complex workflows, business rules, edge cases, scalability, and system dependencies.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical implementation, and intended business outcomes.
* Communicate product decisions, priorities, and trade-offs effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bring together cross-functional teams to resolve challenges and maintain momentum across initiatives.

**Customer Engagement & Release Management**

* Lead customer discovery sessions, product demonstrations, and feedback discussions to understand real-world challenges.
* Oversee alpha and beta programs to validate new capabilities and incorporate customer feedback into product decisions.
* Ensure product functionality meets customer expectations and delivers the intended operational and financial value.
* Drive release readiness, ensuring product documentation, training materials, and communication plans are in place before general availability.
* Monitor feature adoption and customer feedback post-release to identify opportunities for further improvement.

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or related product leadership roles.
* At least 2 years of experience leading and developing Product Owners or Product Managers.
* Strong experience working in SaaS or cloud-based product environments.
* Deep understanding of healthcare technology, Practice Management, medical billing, and revenue cycle management workflows.
* Proven experience owning product initiatives from discovery and requirements definition through development, release, and adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop product talent while managing multiple initiatives.

**Product & AI Capabilities**

* Strong ability to identify the problem worth solving, define the desired outcomes, and translate business needs into actionable product requirements.
* Expertise in developing high-quality functional specifications, workflow diagrams, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
* Practical understanding of AI-driven products, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Ability to evaluate AI capabilities and limitations and establish appropriate validation approaches for accuracy, reliability, and compliance.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in SQL for data validation and problem investigation.
* Experience defining product KPIs and measuring adoption, operational efficiency, and business impact.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and empower Product Owners to take ownership of product outcomes.
* Strong prioritisation and decision-making skill

jobs.title: AVP / GM - Accounts & Finance
jobs.description:
**Nature of Role:** Strategic and Operational Leadership

**1. ROLE OBJECTIVE**

We are looking for a highly experienced, commercially oriented and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) with strong expertise in Trade Finance, Banking, Treasury, Working Capital Management and International Trade Financing.

The company is engaged in domestic and international trading of commodities and products such as Coal, Speciality Chemicals and other allied products.

The CFO will be responsible for managing the organization's complete financial operations, with particular emphasis on arranging and optimizing banking facilities, structuring trade finance transactions, managing Letters of Credit, Bank Guarantees, Buyers' Credit, Suppliers' Credit and other fund-based and non-fund-based facilities.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in developing strong banking relationships, enhancing existing credit limits, arranging additional funding facilities, reducing financing costs and ensuring adequate liquidity to support business expansion.

The CFO will work closely with the CEO, Group CFO and business leadership team, acting as a strategic business partner while ensuring strong financial discipline, effective risk management and robust financial controls.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. TRADE FINANCE & BANKING RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY**

This is the most critical requirement of the position.

* Independently manage relationships with banks, financial institutions and other financing partners.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with senior banking officials and credit teams.
* Arrange, negotiate and enhance existing fund-based and non-fund-based banking facilities.
* Manage multiple banking arrangements and consortium banking relationships, wherever applicable.
* Structure appropriate banking facilities to support domestic and international commodity trading.
* Negotiate competitive interest rates, LC commissions, BG charges, processing fees, collateral requirements and other banking terms.
* Identify new banking partners and alternative financing sources to support business growth.
* Ensure optimal utilization of sanctioned banking limits.
* Lead annual bank limit renewals, credit reviews, documentation and enhancement proposals.
* Prepare and present financial projections, business plans, CMA data, stock statements and other information required by banks.

**B. LETTER OF CREDIT (LC) MANAGEMENT**

* Extensive hands-on experience in opening, negotiating and managing Import LCs, Inland LCs and Export LCs, as applicable.
* Strong understanding of Sight LCs, Usance LCs, Deferred Payment LCs and Back-to-Back LCs.
* Manage LC amendments, extensions, negotiations, retirement and devolvement.
* Negotiate LC tenor, payment terms, commission and banking charges.
* Ensure proper monitoring of LC utilization and outstanding exposure.
* Optimize LC limits to support high-volume trading transactions.
* Ensure coordination with suppliers, customers, banks and logistics teams for timely execution of LC transactions.

**C. BUYERS' CREDIT & SUPPLIERS' CREDIT**

* Strong practical experience in arranging and managing Buyers' Credit for international imports.
* Evaluate and structure cost-effective Buyers' Credit arrangements.
* Negotiate financing tenure, interest rates, currency, margins and other commercial terms.
* Evaluate the cost-benefit of Buyers' Credit against alternative financing arrangements.
* Manage Suppliers' Credit and other permitted trade financing structures.
* Coordinate with domestic and international banks for financing arrangements.
* Ensure timely repayments, documentation and regulatory compliance.
* Monitor overall trade finance costs and their impact on transaction profitability.

**D. BANK GUARANTEES & NON-FUND-BASED FACILITIES**

* Arrange and manage various types of Bank Guarantees, including Performance Guarantees, Financial Guarantees, Advance Payment Guarantees and other contractual guarantees.
* Negotiate BG commission, margin requirements, collateral and validity periods.
* Monitor outstanding BG exposure, expiry dates, renewals and timely release.
* Optimize utilization of non-fund-based banking limits.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and compliance with contractual and banking requirements.

**E. WORKING CAPITAL & TREASURY MANAGEMENT**

* Take complete ownership of the organization's working capital and liquidity management.
* Develop effective cash flow forecasting and fund planning mechanisms.
* Optimize receivables, payables, inventory and cash conversion cycles.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Executive** to independently manage the day-to-day accounting, payments, taxation and statutory compliance activities of our company.

**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.

* Asks for opinions of others.

* Participates in formal and informal gatherings to meet new people and develop new relationships.

**Inspires and Motivates Others to High Performance**

* Brings enthusiasm to the team.

* Gets to know others in the team and what is important to them.

* Observes behaviours and models self after others.

* Leads by example by performing at high levels.

**Focus on Results**

**Drives for Results**

* Works hard to achieve objectives.

* Stays focused on key commitments.

* Looks to overcome obstacles or barriers to performing.

* Works with others to achieve joint goals.
  

**Requirements:** -

**Suggested minimum years of PM experience:** 4-6 years

**Critical Experiences**

* Recognised as full owner of a technical onboarding, ingestion, or comparable technical-liaison feature area.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, and priorities, and to work with engineers, content providers, publishers, or negotiation teams to modify or maintain a product and identify technology challenges.

* Hands-on experience applying AI tools in product management work, such as specification writing, analysis, or prototyping.

jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

62988

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

19 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

27 November 2026

If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

  

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role **Head of Business Technology Intelligence**.

  

**The Opportunity**

  

Data and Analytics Professionals at HSBC have responsibility for executing our HSBC Data Strategy. Their responsibilities are threefold:

  

* Recognising data as an asset to HSBC by managing Data Risk and ensuring we are compliant with our Data standards and policies;

* Using analytics and data science to unlock the value of our data; and

* Implementing and maintaining our Data Technologies. Data and Analytics Professionals are geographically dispersed and aligned to the Global Businesses / Global Functions or regions.

**What you will do:**

  

As an influential and visionary servant leader, you’ll lead and empower delivery teams to execute the Group Business and Technology Data Strategy and roadmap. You’ll provide direct and indirect leadership, fostering innovation across the organisation through agile ways of working and effective agile leadership.

  

Leading by example, you’ll enable teams to deliver high-quality technology, data products and services that meet customer and business requirements. You’ll help create an environment where people can succeed, collaborate effectively and deliver measurable value at pace.

  

The Head of Data Group Chief Information Office is accountable for the strategic design, implementation, governance, and ongoing management of the end-to-end enterprise data model across Group Chief Information Office. The role ensures that data is structured, governed, trusted, and managed as a strategic asset, enabling effective decision-making, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and technology transformation.

  

The role leads the development and execution of the organisation's data architecture, data quality, lineage, metadata, and data management capabilities, establishing robust controls and standards across the technology estate while driving adoption and accountability throughout the organisation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Enterprise Data Model Ownership:

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end enterprise data model.
* Establish a strategic target-state data architecture aligned to business, technology, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure consistency, standardisation, and reuse of data assets across platforms, functions, and technology domains.
* Govern data model design decisions and oversee implementation across programmes and change initiatives.

Data Management and Governance:

* Drive adoption of data management best practices across all technology teams.
* Ensure alignment between data strategy, architecture standards, and delivery programmes.
* Identify, assess, and actively manage data-related risks across the technology estate.
* Establish appropriate controls to ensure integrity, accuracy, completeness, and traceability of data.
* Support regulatory, audit, and risk management requirements through effective data governance and management practices.
* Ensure remediation plans are implemented and tracked where control weaknesses are identified.
  

**What you will need to succeed in the role:**

  

* Director-level leadership experience in Data & Analytics, preferably in Banking or Financial services
* Proven experience defining and executing an Enterprise Data Strategy, roadmap and target operating model aligned with business, technology, risk and regulatory objectives.
* Strong expertise in Enterprise Data Management, data architecture and data modelling, including ownership of end-to-end enterprise data models and target-state architecture.
* Extensive experience in data governance, data risk and controls, including data quality, lineage, ownership, audit, regulatory requirements and remediation.
* Strong technical knowledge of SQL, Python, BigQuery and GCP (Google Cloud Platform), with experience overseeing data extraction, transformation, integration and cloud-based data platforms.
* Proven Agile Project Management and leading geographically distributed, multidisciplinary teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering measurable value at pace within a regulated environment.
* Experience delivering data analysis, data mining, data wrangling and data delivery, producing trusted, reusable and scalable data products for business, operational, risk and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC.**

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

**People & Talent**  
• Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
  
• Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  
• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**  
• Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  
• Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  
• Contribute to delivering ‘effective governance’ by actively challenging Treasury / Business / Risk counterparts; and willingness to work with the Prudential Regulatory Authority in an open and cooperative manner.

**Key stakeholders/Committees**  
• Global Treasurer

• Regional & Country Treasury teams
  
• Business stakeholders in CCIB, CPBB and SC Ventures

• Rating Agencies, Investors
  
• Regulators
  
• GALCO

• Digital Asset Risk Committee (DRC – attending as permanent invitee)

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Lead and oversee end-to-end Consumer Banking Operations across servicing, maintenance, ancillary processing, lending operations, card operations, wealth operations, mortgage and home finance operations, staff lending, file management, and liability and clearance letter activities.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Product based in United Arab Emirates.**
We are looking for a hands-on product leader to take ownership of an established, revenue-generating digital marketplace connecting content creators with their audiences.
  
  
In this strategic leadership role, you will define the product vision, shape the roadmap, and drive initiatives that improve customer experience and business performance.
  
  
You will focus on key B2C growth metrics, including conversion, retention, and monetization, while ensuring platform stability and operational excellence.
  
  
Working closely with Engineering, Growth, Commercial, BI, and other cross-functional teams, you will turn customer insights and data into impactful product decisions.
  
  
You will also explore opportunities to leverage AI to enhance product performance, customer experience, and internal workflows.
  
  
With significant autonomy and ownership, you will help guide the evolution of a high-volume transactional platform where payments, trust, safety, and compliance are essential.
  
  
This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on an established digital product while collaborating with a diverse, international team.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Define and own the product strategy, vision, priorities, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with customer needs and broader business objectives.
* Drive B2C growth by identifying and implementing opportunities to improve conversion rates, customer retention, monetization, and the overall experience for creators and their audiences.
* Establish clear success metrics, monitor product performance, and use data-driven insights to continuously optimize outcomes.
* Lead product delivery in close collaboration with Engineering, translating strategic priorities into clear requirements, actionable plans, and achievable milestones.
* Identify dependencies, address delivery blockers, and improve visibility, accountability, and predictability across product and engineering execution.
