Job description:

Job Description – Business Development Manager (Field Sales)

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years  
**Job Location:** Mumbai (Open to candidates across Mumbai and nearby locations)  
**Salary:** ₹40,000 – ₹50,000 per month (based on experience and interview)  
**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Only  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field-Based Role

About the Role

We are looking for dynamic and target-driven Business Development Managers to drive business growth by connecting with founders, business owners, entrepreneurs and decision-makers. The role involves field sales, client acquisition, relationship building and converting qualified prospects into customers.

**Note:** This is a field-based role, not an office-based job. Candidates are not required to visit the office every day. You will manage your daily field activities, client meetings and follow-ups independently.

Key Responsibilities

* Meet business owners, founders, directors and decision-makers through daily field visits.
* Generate leads through market visits, networking, references and follow-ups.
* Identify businesses that require funding-readiness support.
* Explain the services, programme fees, deliverables and terms transparently.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying clients.
* Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline.
* Maintain daily records of leads, client visits, follow-ups and conversions in the CRM.
* Submit daily sales and activity reports.
* Coordinate with the internal team after successful client onboarding.

Target Audience

You will primarily connect with:

* Manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers.
* Traders and exporters.
* Retail and restaurant businesses.
* Clinics, laboratories and healthcare businesses.
* Education businesses.
* D2C and e-commerce brands.
* Technology startups and entrepreneurs.
* Logistics, textile and other business sectors.

Candidate Requirements

* 2–8 years of experience in target-based sales.
* Experience in Banking, NBFC, Loans, Credit Cards, Insurance, Financial Products or B2B Field Sales preferred.
* Proven track record of achieving monthly sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.
* Comfortable with daily field visits and meeting business owners.
* Self-driven, proactive and capable of independently managing sales activities.
* Honest and transparent approach towards client acquisition.
* Immediate joiners only.

Monthly Targets

* **During Probation (First 3 Months):** 5 verified paid clients per month.
* **After Confirmation:** 10 verified paid clients per month.

A client is counted only after the agreement is signed, payment is received and settled, and onboarding is completed.

Salary & Incentives

**Monthly Salary Package: ₹40,000 – ₹50,000**

Incentive structure:

* 0–4 verified paid clients: No incentive.
* 5–9 verified paid clients: ₹20,000 incentive.
* 10 or more verified paid clients: ₹40,000 incentive.

Salary consists of base wages and a target-linked component, as specified in the written offer.

**Travel Allowance:**

* During probation: ₹3/km for bike and ₹2/km for scooty, based on field kilometres recorded in the CRM.
* After probation: ₹3,000 per month.

Training & Joining Process

* 7-day online training programme before employment.
* Training starts: 1 December 2026.
* Certification is mandatory.
* Shortlisted candidates will complete joining formalities on 7 December 2026.
* Certified candidates who complete training and join will receive a training completion bonus equivalent to 7 days of their monthly salary package, along with

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience you have in field sales ?
* How many years of experience you have in NBFC?
* Can you work from Pune?
* Please mention your current CTC
* Please mention your expected CTC
* Please mention your notice period?

Work Location: In person

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.6 trillion and operations worldwide, and its Legal Department provides specialized legal support aligned to the firm's lines of business and corporate staff areas. Asset & Wealth Management is one of the largest asset and wealth managers in the world, serving institutional and retail clients through Asset Management and high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients through the Private Bank. The business offers global investment management across equities, fixed income, real estate, hedge funds, private equity, and liquidity, and provides trust and estate, banking, brokerage, and retirement services. The Legal Department is seeking an experienced lawyer to support cross-border efforts, focusing on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of asset and wealth management products and services, and helping document and communicate related legal and regulatory requirements.

This role is based in Mumbai, India, at the J.P. Morgan Mumbai Corporate Centre, and functionally reports to:

* A Managing Director and Associate General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United States
* An Executive Director and Assistant General Counsel for Asset & Wealth Management in the United Kingdom
* A local Asset & Wealth Management Legal supervisor in Mumbai

Job summary:

As an Associate Legal Counsel within Asset & Wealth Management Legal, you will support cross-border efforts with a primary focus on reviewing and analyzing legal opinions related to the cross-border provision of products and services. You will help drive documentation of cross-border laws and regulations and communicate related requirements to business stakeholders. You will partner with lawyers, compliance partners, business stakeholders, and external counsel to maintain clear, current, and usable guidance for the business.

Job responsibilities:

* Conduct the first review of new or updated legal opinions from external counsel and new or revised draft rules for the business to provide products and services on a cross-border basis, and facilitate periodic and ad hoc updates of existing materials based on legal or regulatory changes or business developments
* Draft summaries of updates to facilitate the review-and-approval process via an internal workflow tool
* Engage with external counsel, Asset & Wealth Management lawyers, Compliance, and business stakeholders to obtain and resolve feedback on updates
* Field stakeholders' basic queries concerning the materials and fact-specific queries
* Advise as the Legal Department's first point of contact on potential issues relating to cross-border materials
* Provide regular feedback to business stakeholders and cross-border forums on pending reviews
* Conduct additional research and assist on special projects as needed
* Create and enhance audit-ready processes in a highly regulated environment, including through the use of technology

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Demonstrate excellent English writing and communication skills
* Hold a law degree
* Be in compliance, prior to commencement of employment, with all relevant licensing requirements, including the requirements of the jurisdiction where the role will be located
* Be sufficiently well qualified to interpret and summarize external legal advice and articulate clear “rules of the road” for the business
* Operate as a self-starter who works collaboratively in a high-performing team, takes ownership of responsibilities and projects, and is results-oriented and flexible
* Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, complex business environment and maintain communication with attorneys regarding project status and estimated completion timelines
* Demonstrate competence with Microsoft Office products, including Microsoft Excel, and the use of large language models and artificial intelligence
* Successfully complete a conflicts of interest clearance review prior to commencement of employment (applicable to all Legal Department roles)

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:

* Master of Laws (LLM) preferred
* 2–4 years of experience in financial services law
* Experience instructing and interacting with external counsel directly
* Experience working across jurisdictions and time zones

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

With large, global operations, the Legal team tackles complex issues and helps shape the regulations that affect the businesses. The group is organized into practice groups that align with the lines of business and corporate staff areas, which encourages collaboration on legal, regulatory and business developments as they arise.

**About Us**

Our client continuum spans from Mass Retail to Affluent, including high-net worth clients served by our Private Bank. We leverage digital banking channels with a human touch to provide clients with differentiated products and services such as deposits, payments, financing, wealth management and personalised advice. We also support small business clients with their business banking needs.

**Business**

* Revenue management

* Portfolio management

* Drive platform usage, client penetration efforts.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Financial Controller – Entrance Control Middle East is responsible for leading the finance function, ensuring financial integrity, regulatory compliance, effective financial planning, and sustainable business performance. The role acts as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director and leadership team, providing financial insights to support commercial decisions, profitability, operational efficiency, and business growth. The position has overall responsibility for financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow and working capital management, tax compliance, financial controls, risk management, audit coordination, and the development of robust finance processes across the region. The role requires a combination of strategic financial leadership, strong technical accounting expertise, commercial acumen, and an in-depth understanding of UAE financial and tax regulations. It also requires close collaboration with global finance teams, business unit leaders, sales, service, operations, procurement, and other relevant stakeholders.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Main Tasks (key accountabilities, deliveries, what is the role expected to do).**

* Lead the finance function and act as a strategic business partner to management.
* Align financial plans, budgets, and targets with regional business objectives.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing and reporting.
* Ensure accurate financial statements, management accounts, and financial reconciliations.
* Ensure compliance with IFRS, group accounting policies, and local statutory requirements.
* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts, and long-term financial planning.
* Analyse financial performance, variances, risks, and opportunities to support decision-making.
* Monitor revenue, gross margins, project profitability, and overall business performance.
* Review pricing proposals, tenders, customer contracts, and commercial business cases.
* Manage cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization.
* Monitor receivables, overdue payments, credit risks, and debt collection performance.
* Ensure compliance with UAE VAT, Corporate Tax, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.
* Establish and monitor financial controls, approval processes, and risk mitigation measures.
* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and fixed asset accounting.
* Drive finance process improvements, automation, and effective ERP utilization, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Prepare financial dashboards, management reports, and business performance insights.
* Lead, coach, and develop the regional finance team to achieve operational excellence.
* Collaborate with sales, service, operations, procurement, HR, and global finance teams.
* Ensure accurate intercompany accounting, reconciliations, and compliance with transfer pricing requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, reduce costs, and optimize resource utilization.
Monitor changes in UAE tax laws and implement necessary compliance and process updates.  

**Main KPI’s / Metrics that the role has an impact on**

* Financial Performance: Monitor revenue, gross margin, operating profit, EBITDA (where applicable), and achievement against budget.
* Financial Reporting: Ensure accurate and timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.
* Closing and Reconciliation: Complete month-end closing on time, ensure balance sheet reconciliations, and resolve outstanding items.
* Budgeting and Forecasting: Maintain forecast accuracy, ensure budget adherence, and deliver high-quality financial analysis.
* Cash Flow and Working Capital: Improve cash flow forecasting, monitor overdue receivables and debtor days, optimise working capital, and manage bad debt exposure.
* Tax and Statutory Compliance: Ensure timely and accurate VAT and Corporate Tax filings, statutory submissions, and tax payments.
* Internal Controls and Audit: Minimise audit findings, close corrective actions, strengthen internal controls, and ensure compliance with group policies.
* Commercial Finance: Improve gross margins, control costs, support pricing decisions, and monitor the profitability of key customers, contracts, and projects.
* Process Improvement: Drive automation, reduce manual reporting, improve process efficiency, and enhance reporting timelines.
* Team Development: Enhance team performance, develop capabilities, support succession planning, and improve stakeholder satisfaction.

**Minimum Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, ACA, CPA, CIMA, or an equivalent recognized accounting qualification is strongly preferred. • Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role, with at least 10 years of overall experience in Finance & Accounting (F&A).
* Demonstrated experience managing financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, tax compliance, internal controls, and statutory audits.
* Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical experience applying accounting standards in a multinational or international business environment.
* Practical knowledge of UAE VAT, UAE Corporate Tax, statutory reporting, and applicable local compliance requirements.
* Experience working with regional or multinational finance teams and reporting to group or headquarters finance functions.
* Experience in commercial finance, business partnering, profitability analysis, and working capital management.
* Proven experience with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365, and advanced Excel.
* Fluent written and spoken English. Arabic is an advantage.

**Essential Criteria: Qualifications, Experience, Skills, Competencies Financial and Technical Expertise**

* Strong technical accounting knowledge, with the ability to oversee complex accounting matters and ensure accurate financial reporting.
* In-depth understanding of budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling, management reporting, and performance analysis.

* Commercially minded, with the ability to challenge assumptions and support profitable business decisions.
* Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to balance financial control and compliance with business growth and operational priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within tight deadlines. Governance and Integrity.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and discretion when handling confidential financial information.
* Strong understanding of internal controls, delegation of authority, risk mitigation, and financial governance.
* Ability to identify control weaknesses, investigate discrepancies, and drive corrective actions. Systems and Communication

**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
The Product Control GBS is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Treasury Product Control (PC) and Valuation Control (VC) including Balance Sheet Substantiation controllership. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Treasury Product and Valuation Control, working closely with Technical Accounting, Treasury, Markets, IRRBB, Liquidity, Capital, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class accounting solutions across the Group.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Processes**

* Manage a team covering treasury product categories and regions. (Asset classes: Securities and MM products, Funding, Funds Transfer Pricing, Capital, Hedge Accounting etc.)
* Monitor and implement business model assessments and hedge accounting processes based on IAS 39 and IFRS 9 for new and existing strategies
* Ensure appropriate controls and reviews are maintained for Daily P&L production, core reconciliations, month end close and balance sheet substantiation.
* Ensure the teams are performing timely lockdown of daily and monthly P&L.
* Should be able to substantiate daily and monthly adjustments held in P&L and control accounts.
* Review monthly balance sheet, with substantiation and potential financial exposure.
* Review various reconciliation reports, management packs and adhoc reports.
* Review of month end journals for accrual, provision and true up.
* Take responsibility for the quality of work submitted and ensure that the highest standards are maintained.
* Ensure adherence to SLA's, KPI's , Internal metrics & Finance wide policies.
* Identify/ manage risk and control breakdowns.
* Develop & maintain effective and standard processes. Maintain KOP's/DI's.
* Support change project initiatives and conduct User Acceptance Testing for enhancements to current systems or migration to new system.

**Risk Management**

* Support effective compliance by embedding an effective Operational Risk Framework (ORF) within the PC-VC process universe to ensure all areas manage operational risks in a proactive, risk based and disciplined manner.
* Support functioning of day-to-day controls, by performing periodic assessment and monitoring activities (CST & KCI) as well as timely identification, escalation, and resolution of risk issues
* Support and monitor compliance with Operational Risk policies, procedures, and applicable regulations within PCVC and advice wherever changes are required.
* To actively support exercising of direct Risk Control Ownership / Process ownership for Operational Risk to ensure risks of processing failure are being actively owned and resolved on an end-to-end basis

**Governance and Stakeholder management**

* Regular face off with Traders, Product Control Management, Regional finance team and various internal stakeholders within GFS.
* Act as a point of reference for team members and internal clients.
* Manage relationship with internal stakeholders, take regular feedback, anticipate and understand issues and escalate appropriately for timely resolution
* Manage strong relationship with support teams (IT, Operations and Risk) and bring synergies by interacting and integrating with cross functional teams.

**Qualifications**

* MBA, CA, CFA, ACCA with a minimum of 10+ years experience (post qualification) in a financial service industry with at least 2+ years of People Management experience.
* Strong leadership skills and ability to manage teams
* Control mindset and ability to identify and mitigate and control gaps
* Good understanding of financial market products
* Ability to develop, implement and maintain effective and standard operational processes.
* Excellent people and resource management skills.
* Excellent Interpersonal skills. Should be able to communicate at all levels.
* Strong planning, negotiation and analytical skills.
* Excellent business writing and verbal English communication skills
* Ready to travel & work in shifts.

**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.

jobs.title: VP - Data & Analytics Tech Lead (KDB) - Equity Technology
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Innovation Hub Overview**
Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. We’re scaling toward an elite team of 500 engineers while maintaining the agility, ownership, and meritocratic spirit that defines Jefferies. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
  
  
**IT Equities Technology**
Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed & OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front-office workflows end-to-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
  
  
Operating in a 24x7 follow-the-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C++/C#, cloud, modern visualization, low-latency messaging, and in-memory data stores.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Global Equities Data & Analytics team is seeking a Tech Lead in Pune to lead technology delivery, development and production support for the Global Equities Data & Analytics Platform.
  
  
The platform provides real-time and historical market data and analytics services to more than 10 global trading desks, including Cash Equities, Listed and OTC Derivatives, Electronic Trading, Algo Trading, Index Rebalance, ETFs, Delta One, Central Risk Book and Securities Finance.
  
  
The VP Tech Lead will oversee the India development and support team, working closely with global stakeholders across Hong Kong, London and New York. The role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, leadership capability, capital markets knowledge and experience working with large-scale financial datasets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the Pune-based development and support team for the Global Equities Data & Analytics Platform.
* Partner closely with global technology teams across Hong Kong, London, New York and other locations.
* Own delivery of key platform components across real-time and historical market data.
* Support and enhance large-scale low-latency data platforms used by global trading desks.
* Lead onboarding of historical datasets, including large-scale historical tick data and vendor datasets such as Barra, MSCI and other market/reference data sources.
* Design and implement robust, scalable and reusable software components.
* Implement functionality based on defined APIs and platform architecture.
* Develop and maintain library-grade software used across global applications.
* Drive clean, efficient and maintainable coding practices.
* Review technical designs and ensure alignment with global platform standards.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to AVP and Associate developers/support analysts.
* Collaborate with QA, DevOps, production support and global development teams.
* Improve data quality, platform reliability, performance and operational resilience.
* Participate in production support coverage across Asia, EMEA and partial US time zones.
* Contribute to cloud development initiatives involving Python, Iceberg, Parquet and related technologies.
* Write and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and support guides.
* Bring critical thinking and new ideas to improve platform design, analytics and operational processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience working with large financial datasets, including market data, order/execution data, positions data and/or reference data.
* 6+ years of hands-on KDB+/Q experience.
* Strong experience working in Unix/Linux environments.
* Strong programming experience in Python, preferably with cloud data technologies such as Iceberg and Parquet.
* Java experience is preferred.
* Experience designing and supporting real-time and historical data platforms.
* Strong understanding of large-scale financial database design and data management.
* Experience building scalable, efficient and high-quality software solutions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact confidently with global developers, QA teams, production support teams and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced front-office technology environment.
* Ability to learn new technologies and business domains quickly.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies.

**Highly Valued Skills**

* Capital markets experience across Equities, Derivatives, ETFs, Index, Delta One, Algo Trading or Electronic Trading.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with high-performance messaging, in-memory databases and distributed systems.
* Proven delivery track record in a global financial services technology environment.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead end-to-end delivery.
* Ability to mentor team members and promote engineering best practices.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
  
  
At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

jobs.title: IT Business Lead Analyst - Vice President
jobs.description:
Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.
  
  
The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.
* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.
* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.
* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.
* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.

**Knowledge/Experience:**

* 10-15 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.
* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.
* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.
* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk
* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.
* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.
* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).
* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.
* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.
* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.
* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.
* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*
**Competencies:**

* Excellent verbal and written English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.
* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.
* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.
* Strong organization skills.

jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.

* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. jobs.title: Business Senior Analyst - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Citi, the world leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and a presence in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions worldwide. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Citi enables clients to achieve their strategic financial objectives by providing them with cutting-edge ideas, best-in-class products and solutions, and unparalleled access to capital and liquidity.

  
  

The Derivatives Credit Risk Technology Team is responsible for delivering Counterparty Credit Risk Management software solutions to Citi’s Risk organization which manages Citi’s exposure to financial institutions, governments and corporates that trade with Citi. The team builds and maintains software used to compute metrics that help mitigate Citi’s exposure to counterparty default. These include computation of optimal Margin Allocation for Portfolios and Trades, Haircut for Security and Cash Collateral, Trade and Collateral Liquidity, Collateral Concentration Levels and Wrong Way Risk, amongst others.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
  

* Liaise with stakeholders across the Risk and Front Office Technology, Counterparty Risk Management, Finance and Front Office business organizations, and external Market Regulators to assemble business requirements for Counterparty Risk Technology projects.

* Manage expectations of various stakeholder groups and help negotiate solutions to complex problems.

* Project manage complex Counterparty Credit Risk projects end to end. Accurately record, maintain, and report Program/Project management tracking data such as milestones via Citi’s internal project tracking systems.

* Help assemble/manage detailed documentation covering Counterparty Risk calculations and other processing, to be used to discuss technology implementation details with the Business users and Market Regulators in various countries/regions. Create flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations when appropriate.

* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.

* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology teams for System, User and Impact testing.

* Understand, analyse, and explain counterparty mark-to-future exposures on Derivatives books to users. Investigate Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA and related calculations for internal risk management and BASEL regulatory capital reporting based on the exposure profiles generated by the systems.

* Ability to trace changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and or legal agreements.

* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to demonstrate and analyse risk calculations.
  

  

**Knowledge/Experience:**

  
  

* 8-12 years related experience in Business Analysis and Project Management in Capital Markets domain.

* SDLC awareness including knowledge of quality issues in software development.

* Excellent understanding of the mechanics and life cycle of derivatives products, including Options, Futures, Forwards and Swaps. Knowledge of Securities Financing Transactions (SFT) products an advantage.

* Excellent understanding of Counterparty Credit Risk

* Potential Future Exposure, Margin (ISDA MNA and CSA), Collateral Haircut, Liquidity and Period of Risk, Settlement Risk.

* Understanding of Basel III/IV and any other relevant Risk Regulations and measures including PSE, RWA, EAD.

* Knowledge of Market Risk an advantage including Credit Value Adjustment (CVA).

* Extensive project management experience, including co-ordination across remote global teams.

* Where required supervise day-to-day staff management issues, work allocation but especially mentoring/coaching.

* Data Analysis capabilities (Database or Spreadsheet), with extensive experience using Excel required.
  

  

**Education:**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience. Master's degree an advantage.

* Graduate in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) or Finance disciplines.

* FRM/CFA or other Financial mathematics degree or certification is an advantage.

*Exceptional candidates who do not meet these criteria may be considered for the role provided they have the necessary skills and experience.*

  
  

**Competencies:**

  
  

* Excellent verbal and written English.

* Ability to collaborate effectively in a large global team.

* Ability to take ownership and proactively follow up on issues.

* Ability to work well under pressure, to agreed and often challenging deadlines.

* Strong organization skills.

jobs.title: Data Information Manager - Assistant Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

**Assistant Vice President (IC) - Data\Information Management** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. AIM's objective is to generate actionable intelligence for business leaders. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

  
  

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS programming for data extraction, manipulation and validations. Guide and mentor junior members in team in this area.
* Use of data warehousing concepts, ETL processes, and experience working with Business Intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI). To act as SME in this area and go-to person for the team.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Automate current process to remove manual effort
* Develop workflows and automation logic using SAS, SQL, Workflow tools
* Conduct in-depth analyses of current operational processes to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
* Support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for them to be innovative and productive at work
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Technical Skills: Expertise in data management principles, SQL, SAS , Python programming for data extraction and manipulation, and database management systems. Including Tableau, and other BI tools.

* Strong coding expertise in SAS & SQL, Autosys package.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.
* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Summary:**

The **Assistant Vice President (IC) - Specialized Analytics** is a developing professional role within the QATV team. This role applies specialized expertise in machine learning, statistical modeling, data science, and advanced AI technologies (including Generative AI and Agentic AI) to revolutionize how regulatory testing is executed, analyzed, and governed.

The Data Science Analyst will partner with QATV testing and reporting teams to identify high-impact opportunities for automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent reporting. Key responsibilities include applying AI/ML techniques to detect complex data anomalies, automating test narrative generation, predicting testing cycle risks, and optimizing testing sprint capacity and resource allocation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* **Predictive Defect & Risk Modeling:** Build predictive analytics and forecasting models to project test execution cycle times, identify recurring defect patterns, and anticipate regulatory reporting risks before filing deadlines.
* **Testing Intelligence & Metrics:** Analyze historical test execution data to uncover systemic data quality trends, derive actionable quality scores, and provide data-driven recommendations to strengthen internal control frameworks.

* **Automated Narrative Generation:** Design, build, and deploy Generative AI solutions (using LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architectures) to automate the drafting of complex, audit-ready narrative test summaries and executive readouts.
* **Agentic AI & Workflow Automation:** Experiment with and develop Agentic AI workflows (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) to automate multi-step validation checks, intelligent test result consolidation, and autonomous exception routing.
* **AI Evaluation & Guardrails:** Establish robust benchmarking tools, validation frameworks, and guardrails to evaluate the accuracy, hallucination risks, consistency, and performance of deployed AI/GenAI models.

* **Resource & Capacity Modeling:** Develop quantitative models and optimization algorithms to enhance sprint capacity planning, workload balancing, and skill-to-task allocation across multi-phase testing cycles.
* **Sprint Analytics & Tracking:** Build automated intelligence pipelines and interactive dashboards (Power BI / Tableau) to track sprint velocity, defect burn-down rates, and milestone adherence in real time.
* **Automated Test Script Generation:** Leverage Generative AI and LLM-powered pipelines to automate the creation, synthesis, and maintenance of standardized regulatory test scripts, validation rules.

* **Control, Risk & Governance:** Ensure all data science and AI applications comply with Citi Model Risk Management (MRM), Responsible AI guidelines, and data governance policies. Appropriately assess risk when developing solutions, ensuring transparent escalation and adherence to all supervisory standards.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in QATV by managing expectations and ensuring alignment on project goals and deliverables. Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders timely manner
* **Team Player & Mentor:** Provide technical leadership and guidance to junior team members. Mentor and coach team members on best practices in data analysis, reporting, and data infrastructure management

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 8+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Programming & ML Frameworks: Strong programming skills in Python with proficiency in data science and ML libraries (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Transformers).

* Generative AI & LLMs: Hands-on experience developing GenAI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Chroma, Milvus), and API integration.

* Agentic Frameworks & MLOps: Practical exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or AutoGen, along with foundational knowledge of MLOps and model deployment pipelines.

* Data Engineering & SQL: Advanced SQL skills with experience querying, manipulating, and transforming large datasets from relational databases and testing data marts (e.g., Oracle, Snowflake, PostgreSQL).

jobs.title: Corporate Credit Underwriter - Senior Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.

Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise.

Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

ICM Underwriters manage a portfolio of relationships, being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with Business and Risk.

**In this role, you’re expected to:**

Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

* Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos, and senior approval forums

* Detailed review of financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis performed by junior resources

* Review and approval of Credit Approval Memos (CAM) packages

* Partner with Front Office on structuring and production of term sheet for new transactions

* Facilitate relationships with key clients in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions

* Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives / projects as required

**Risk Management Experience:**

* Senior credit approval authority covering large and complex underwritings, capital commitments, derivatives with multi-industry experience
* Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
* Ability to understand capital markets products and complex financing and product structures
* Ability to provide strategic insights and strong sensitivity to macro and regulatory issues
* Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with banking and product organizations

**Client Relationships / Business Partnership:**

* Proven ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
* Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
* Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments geographies and other risk functions
* Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships
* Proven track record of partnering with global peers in leveraging and implementation of best practices

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

* 12+ years risk/risk-related credit work experience in banking/financial institutions
* Proven ability to effectively engage with regulators and internal control functions including Internal Audit and Fundamental Credit Risk as well as with external audit
* Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
* Ability to see the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
* Can make decisions under pressure and short timeline
* Excellent verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills.
* Excellent presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
  
  
Are you ready to make a significant impact in the world of trading services? At JPMorganChase, we offer an exciting opportunity for career growth and development as a Trading Services Manager. Join us to leverage your skills in automation and data analysis and be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.  
  
As a Trading Services Manager within JPMorganChase, you will be a key player in our team, leveraging your deep knowledge of trade activities and market products to ensure seamless order execution and settlement. Your role will involve managing a diverse team, interpreting customer needs, and identifying trends to generate innovative solutions. You will be responsible for end-to-end trade processing control, monitoring asset and cash levels, and driving continuous improvement in our operating platform. Your advanced understanding of automation technologies and data literacy will be crucial in optimizing our systems and making data-driven decisions. As a recognized expert in your field, you will use your strong presentation skills and influence to communicate insights, manage internal stakeholders, and lead your team through change. Your work will have a wide-ranging impact on our operations, financial management, and service delivery, contributing to the overall success of our firm.

* Oversee the end-to-end trade processing control, ensuring accurate order entry, trade execution, and settlement in line with operational policies and precedents.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the India Demat Team within India International Wealth and Premier Banking as Assistant Vice President – Demat Operations.

  

**Role Purpose**

  

The role holder will manage end-to-end depository participant operations within a regulated bank environment, encompassing demat account opening and servicing, settlement monitoring, reconciliations, income and DP charge controls, and regulatory reporting. The role will ensure accurate and timely execution in accordance with applicable SEBI requirements, NSDL/CDSL rules and bye-laws, PMLA, and HSBC policies and operating procedures.

  

The incumbent will drive operational efficiency and customer service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services, maintain robust risk and control standards, manage audit and regulatory review requirements, and implement regulatory and system changes within prescribed timelines.

  

**Principal Accountabilities**

* + Oversee demat account opening, modification, servicing and closure, including verification of client documentation and KYC/AML requirements, periodic account reviews, and corporate demat requests.
  + Ensure accurate and timely processing of dematerialisation and rematerialisation requests (DRF/RRF), Delivery Instruction Slips (DIS), pledge, un-pledge and invocation requests, and off-market and inter-depository transfers.
  + Monitor settlement cycles and ensure timely reconciliation with depositories and clearing corporations.
  + Oversee daily, weekly and monthly reconciliations of client holdings, DP balances, suspense accounts and control accounts; investigate and resolve reconciliation breaks.
  + Manage provisioning of income entries and reconciliation of DP charges in coordination with Finance/Accounts.
  + Prepare and submit regulatory and depository reports within prescribed timelines and maintain accurate MIS for management review and compliance oversight.

**Customers / Stakeholders**

  

* + Manage DP-related customer queries, grievances and escalations in coordination with branches, relationship and service teams, ensuring timely resolution.
  + Liaise with NSDL/CDSL, registrars and transfer agents (RTAs), Finance/Accounts, Compliance and other internal stakeholders to resolve servicing and operational matters.
  + Drive customer-centric improvements in turnaround time and service quality across retail and corporate/institutional DP services.
  + Act as the principal contact for Demat operational and regulatory matters across Operations, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Risk, Finance, Treasury, the business and relevant depositories.
  + Coordinate responses to regulatory queries, inspections, internal and external audits, and compliance reviews.
  + Drive cross-functional actions independently, secure clear ownership and deliver within agreed timelines.
  + Provide concise management reporting on key operational risks, regulatory actions, exceptions and outstanding deliverables.
  + Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability and strong collaboration across first- and second-line stakeholders.

* **Leadership and Teamwork**
  

* + Demonstrate ownership and accountability for assigned DP operations and coordinate with stakeholders to meet operational, regulatory and audit deadlines.
  + Work collaboratively with branches, service teams, Compliance, Finance and Technology on regulatory implementation, escalations and process changes.

* **Operational Effectiveness & Control**
  

* Conduct periodic process and control reviews to identify operational and regulatory risks.
* Own audit and inspection observations, agree remediation plans and ensure timely, evidenced closure.
* Monitor implementation of regulatory and product changes and confirm that required controls operate effectively.
* Proactively identify and escalate material operational, regulatory, conduct or control risks.
* Regulatory and business deliverables completed within prescribed timelines.
* Timely and sustainable closure of audit, inspection, compliance and control actions.
* Accuracy and completeness of regulatory trackers, governance records, evidence and management information.
* Reduction in repeat exceptions, overdue actions and material control gaps.
* Effective implementation of regulatory, product and process changes with appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign-off.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and effective escalation of material risks.
* Identify opportunities for automation and digitisation to reduce manual intervention and operational errors.
* Track new and revised regulatory and depository circulars and implement required process and control changes within defined timelines.
* Identify operational risks and ensure adherence to maker-checker controls, segregation of duties, standard operating procedures and HSBC operational risk frameworks.
* Monitor exceptions, failed transactions and reconciliation breaks, ensuring timely resolution and escalation of control issues.
* Strengthen controls over DIS usage, fraud prevention and unauthorised transactions, and maintain adherence to applicable KYC/AML, PMLA and depository requirements.
* Manage internal and concurrent audits, compliance inspections and regulatory reviews relating to DP operations; ensure closure of observations within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards and ensure timely implementation of actions arising from audits and regulatory reviews.
  

This specialist role requiring independent judgement, strong execution discipline and the ability to influence senior and cross-functional stakeholders. The role holder will operate within approved product programmes, HSBC policies, procedures and governance standards, escalating matters outside delegated authority or risk appetite.

The role holder will maintain HSBC internal control standards, comply with relevant Group and local policies and procedures, and ensure timely implementation and closure of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, Compliance or Risk.

  

**Role requirements / Educational Qualifications /Certification / Experience:**

  

* Graduate or postgraduate qualification, with relevant experience in banking or financial services, preferably across Liabilities, Banking Operations, Product Management and/or Demat/DP Operations
* 4–10 years of experience in DP operations, custody operations or capital markets operations within a bank, brokerage or financial institution, with hands-on experience of NSDL/

jobs.description:
**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Drive the development of the FAB Asset Management product range across all asset classes and product types, grounded in market analysis, client demand and competitive positioning.
* Own product ideation and design - investment proposition, target segment, vehicle and share class design, fee structure and commercial positioning - with legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation executed by the relevant departments.
* Own product pricing and economics, including fee grids, margins, distribution economics and profitability, ensuring products are competitive in the market and commercially viable for FAB AM.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
