jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - HAL
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
**About SC Ventures**
**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**
**About HAL**
**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**
**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**
**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.
* Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.
* Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.
* Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).
* Lead, coach and develop the marketing team, working as one team with sales, product and partnerships to hit shared growth targets.

**Business**

* Own B2B lead generation for HAL: build a predictable pipeline of qualified sellers, buyers and SMEs needing finance (e.g. trade finance, working capital, invoice discounting), and ensure smooth handover to the commercial team.
* Agree with the sales team on the ideal customer profile, lead qualification criteria, and a shared process for lead handover and follow-up.
* Drive seller and buyer acquisition for the marketplace launch, and support activation campaigns so that new users start trading on the platform.
* Partner with banks, logistics, payments and other strategic partners on co-marketing campaigns and joint lead generation.
* Manage the marketing budget with discipline, tracking cost per lead and return on spend and moving budget to the best-performing channels.

**Processes**
**Lead Generation & Performance Marketing**

* Plan, launch and optimise paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and regional platforms, owning cost per lead, conversion rates and return on ad spend.
* Continuously experiment with new acquisition channels, such as WhatsApp campaigns, outbound email sequences, account-based marketing for high-value accounts, partner referrals and B2B directories.
* Build landing pages, lead forms and email and WhatsApp nurture journeys that turn interest into qualified leads.
* Set up and manage the core marketing tools (e.g. CRM and marketing automation such as HubSpot) and tracking so every lead can be traced back to its source.
* Grow HAL's organic visibility through SEO and content, including in AI-assisted search.

**Events & Field Marketing**

* Plan and deliver HAL's events programme: launch events, SME workshops, roundtables, webinars and networking sessions.
* Represent HAL at relevant trade shows and industry events across the UAE, making sure every event produces qualified leads with clear follow-up.
* Build relationships with chambers of commerce, trade associations, free zones and SME programmes to reach SMEs at scale.

**Thought Leadership, Content & PR**

* Build a thought leadership programme that positions HAL and its leaders as trusted voices on SME growth, B2B trade and trade finance in the UAE.
* Manage leadership's LinkedIn presence and secure speaking slots, panels and media interviews.
* Create content that educates and converts, such as articles, guides, case studies, newsletters, short videos and webinars, in English and Arabic where needed.
* Manage PR and media relations for launches and milestones, working with agencies where needed.

**Brand & Sales Enablement**
  
  

+ Establish HAL's brand positioning, key messages and visual identity, and keep them consistent across all touchpoints.
+ Create sales materials, such as pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies, that help the commercial team convert leads.
+ Gather customer and market insights (feedback, competitor moves, win/loss reasons) to sharpen messaging and targeting.

**Risk Management**

* Continuously evaluate agency roster to ensure that right agencies are onboarded while accommodating within the budget requirements

**Governance**

* Ensure compliance with all SCB and venture governance frameworks.
* Manage the function within budgetary constraints, seeking operational efficiencies

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Internal: CEO, CCO, COO, Head of digital commerce, Head of Financial Services, Head of partnerships.
* External: Relevant external regulator

**Other Responsibilities**

* Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in the business and SC Ventures;
* Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures.

**Skills And Experience**

* Marketing
* Branding
* Marketing Channels
* Planning : Tactical & Strategic
* Marketing Strategy & Positioning
* Brand Management

**Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of marketing experience, including at least 3 years in B2B demand generation or growth marketing.
* Highly commercially driven, with a proven track record of generating B2B leads and pipeline and a clear link to revenue (e.g. lead volume, cost per lead, conversion, revenue impact).
* Strong startup or scale-up background, with experience building marketing from the ground up in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.
* Experimental minds

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance,

jobs.title: Owner
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
Sekila Finance LLC is a Dubai-based boutique advisory firm specializing in structured trade and commodity finance across Africa–Asia trade corridors. The firm supports producers, processors, traders, and investors by unlocking working capital, optimizing supply-chain funding, and structuring bankable transactions in complex emerging markets. With deep expertise in agri-commodities, edible oils, fertilizers, and soft commodities, Sekila Finance designs solutions such as pre-export finance, inventory and receivables facilities, and offtake-linked funding. The firm collaborates with banks, development finance institutions, private credit funds, insurers, and industry partners to deliver scalable, compliant, and risk-mitigated financing. Its focus is on moving transactions efficiently from concept to execution, enabling sustainable growth where trade and opportunity intersect.
  
**Role Description**
The Owner role at Sekila Finance LLC is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru, responsible for leading the firm’s local operations and strategic initiatives. Day-to-day responsibilities include originating and structuring trade and commodity finance transactions, building and managing relationships with clients, banks, investors, and industry partners, and overseeing deal execution from initial assessment through documentation and closing. The role involves supervising risk analysis, compliance checks, and financial modeling to ensure transactions are viable, aligned with regulatory requirements, and supportive of sustainable growth. The Owner will guide business development efforts, set performance targets, and mentor team members to maintain high service standards and market credibility. This position also requires active participation in market research, industry events, and stakeholder engagement to expand the firm’s footprint in key trade corridors.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in structured trade and commodity finance, including experience with pre-export finance, inventory and receivables facilities, and offtake-linked funding.
* Proven ability in client relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and partnership building with banks, DFIs, private credit funds, and industry participants.
* Experience in agri-commodities, edible oils, fertilizers, and soft commodities, with solid understanding of supply chains and trade flows across emerging markets.
* Advanced skills in financial analysis, risk assessment, transaction structuring, and negotiation of commercial and legal terms.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including team management, strategic planning, and operational oversight in a finance or advisory environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex structures clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications in trade finance or risk management are an advantage.
* Comfort working in an on-site setting in Bengaluru, with readiness for regional travel as required to support transactions and client engagements.

jobs.title: Financial Crime Operations Executive Manager
jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress, make better financial decisions, and achieve their goals. Every day, our people use technology, data, and innovation to create better experiences and outcomes for our customers.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Business & Team:**
Economic Crime Services - Financial Crime Operations
  
  
Financial Crime Operations plays a critical role in protecting our customers, the financial system and society from economic crime. We bring together operational expertise, risk-based decision-making, data, technology and strong partnerships to detect, investigate and respond to financial crime threats.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As Executive Manager, Financial Crime Operations, you will provide strategic and operational leadership for a significant portfolio supporting CommBank’s Australian operations from India.
  
  
You will be accountable for delivering safe, sustainable and high-quality operational outcomes across one or more financial crime disciplines. These may include Transaction Monitoring, Enhanced Customer Due Diligence, Customer and Payment Screening, fraud-related investigations, remediation, Suspicious Matter Report preparation, specialised risk queues, Quality and Performance, or other enabling capabilities.
  
  
You will lead through a period of significant regulatory, technological and operational change. Working closely with Financial Crime Operations, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Strategy and Performance, Technology and Transformation teams, you will ensure effective detection, investigation, escalation and mitigation of financial crime risk.
  
  
The role requires an enterprise leader who can balance customer, risk, people and performance outcomes while building a future-ready operation.
  
  
The existing role profile also establishes responsibility for Australian financial crime operations, close collaboration across Operations, Risk, Compliance, Quality and Technology, and leadership of the India-based team.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
General Manager, Financial Crime Operations, CBA India
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Strategic and operational leadership**

* Lead the strategy and execution of a large and complex Financial Crime Operations portfolio.
* Translate enterprise and Economic Crime Services priorities into clear operational plans, measures and accountabilities.
* Deliver agreed service, quality, productivity, customer and risk outcomes.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational capacity, queue health, demand, productivity, ageing, service levels and emerging risks.
* Ensure the operating model remains sustainable, scalable and aligned to changing business and regulatory requirements.
* Provide clear, timely and evidence-based reporting to senior leadership and governance forums.
* Make sound decisions across competing priorities, balancing immediate operational requirements with long-term strategic outcomes.
* Support operational resilience and continuity through effective workforce, succession and contingency planning.
* The current FCO operating model includes Transaction Monitoring, CDD/KYC, screening and focused risk queues, Performance and Enabling capabilities, and Quality Assurance, with a future-state focus on rationalised leadership spans and increased work complexity.

**Financial crime risk and governance**

* Promote strong risk ownership and ensure financial crime risks are identified, assessed, escalated and managed within applicable frameworks.
* Maintain effective oversight of operational controls, incidents, issues, quality results, audit actions and remediation commitments.
* Ensure operations comply with relevant policies, procedures, regulatory obligations and agreed risk appetite.
* Oversee complex investigations and escalations, ensuring decisions are appropriately evidenced, documented and governed.
* Partner with Compliance, Risk and Quality teams to interpret requirements and implement them consistently across operations.
* Champion a proactive risk culture where colleagues feel safe and accountable to identify concerns, challenge decisions and raise emerging risks.
* Ensure changes to processes, controls, detection approaches and operational procedures are assessed and implemented through appropriate governance.
* FCO governance includes oversight of operational risks, queue performance, process changes, detection-rule changes, policy application, issues and incidents, and the prioritisation and implementation of change.

**Transformation, simplification and technology**

* Lead the successful operational implementation of strategic change, including new processes, platforms, analytical models and risk-based detection and investigation approaches.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve controls, remove duplication and increase operational efficiency.
* Use data and insights to improve decision-making, workforce deployment, quality and customer outcomes.
* Champion responsible adoption of automation, artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to improve financial crime detection and operational effectiveness.
* Ensure new technology and process changes are supported by appropriate operational readiness, capability, controls and governance.
* Build a culture of curiosity, experimentation and continuous improvement while maintaining effective risk management.

**Stakeholder engagement**

* Act as a senior FCO representative and trusted partner between the India-based operation and Australian business, operations, risk and compliance teams.
* Build strong, transparent and constructive relationships with senior stakeholders across Economic Crime Services, Financial Crime Compliance, Risk, Quality Assurance, Technology, Transformation, Workforce and Human Resources.
* Surface risks, dependencies and trade-offs early and provide practical recommendations to support decisions.
* Influence outcomes across organisational boundaries without relying solely on formal authority.
* Promote a whole-of-organisation mindset and ensure that local delivery decisions support broader enterprise outcomes.
* Represent the portfolio in senior operational, risk, governance and transformation forums as required.

**People and culture leadership**

* Lead and inspire a large, diverse workforce through a clear sense of purpose and shared accountability.
* Build a strong leadership team with clear responsibilities, effective spans of control and robust succession plans.
* Attract, develop and retain high-quality financial crime and operations talent.
* Coach senior leaders to strengthen strategic thinking, risk ownership, commercial judgement and people leadership.
* Set clear performance expectations and ensure fair, consistent and timely performance and development conversations.
* Build capability through targeted learning, cross-skilling, leadership development and career pathways.
* Foster an inclusive and psychologically safe environment where diverse perspectives are welcomed.
* Role-model the organisation’s values and leadership principles, including care, courage and commitment.
* Strengthen engagement, wellbeing and connection across teams while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

**Success measures**
Success in the role will be demonstrated through:
  
  

* Sustainable achievement of service, quality, productivity and customer outcomes.
* Effective management of operational and financial crime risks.
* Timely identification, escalation and closure of incidents, issues and control gaps.
* Strong audit, assurance and regulatory outcomes.
* Successful implementation and embedding of strategic change.
* Improved process efficiency, simplification and use of technology.
* Strong colleague engagement, capability and lead

**Job Summary**
The role supports the timely and accurate forecasting of ~900 nostro accounts across 10 centres, spanning intragroup accounts, 3rd party agents and central banks (totalling ~$500bn in managed liquidity per day). This is done in close partnership with funding and trading desks across Treasury and FX, and requires regular engagements with other teams across the bank. Finally, the role involves oversight for the banks throughput and intraday liquidity management at central banks. This footprint will expand as we onboard another 33 centres spanning ~1000 nostros and central banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Be responsible and accountable for real time nostro management processes:**

* Team management / oversight to ensure the successful delivery of day-to-day forecasting, intraday liquidity (IDL) and cash management functions.
* Calculation and provision of funding forecasts to Treasury Markets and FX desks in line with agreed cutoffs on an intraday basis. Provision of root cause analysis on key funding drivers and forecast swings.
* Intraday liquidity monitoring and management of the firm’s central bank accounts
* Proactive management of payment scheduling systems to ensure the firm’s throughput requirements as well as time critical payments are met
* Drive strategies linked to forecasting and IDL related optimization
* Connect with global transformational programmes to ensure seamless operations
* Partner with the TS MT to further enhance and build on the teams Target Operating Model.
* Be a key business partner and support contact to Treasury Markets to ensure effective real time funding and liquidity management decision-making.
* Oversee cash management processes to manage IDL and funding
* Oversee real time forecasting and IDL related KRIs / dashboards for close monitoring and escalation on an intraday basis,
* Provision of Nostro MI in terms of next day balance reporting / explanations, monthly cost management, balance trends / root causes

**Risk Management**

**Governance**

* Comply with all the group standards, policies, procedures and guidelines as applicable and values of the Bank at all times.
* Adhere to Group Code of Conduct at all times.
* Ensure compliance to the group’s risk management framework as applicable.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* Treasury, Financial Markets, Country Financial Markets Operations, Group Financial Markets Operations, Finance, Country CIO

* Good verbal & written English communication
* Excellent analytical capabilities
* Proficient in PC skills, particularly MS Office
* Strong people management skills.
* Strong leadership qualities and interpersonal skills
* Prioritization and Delegation of activities
* Problem solving / Trouble shooting skills
* Ability to identify, mitigate and eliminate risks in processes.
* Expert knowledge of forecasting, IDL and cash management functions and processes (funding driver and variance explains, payment scheduling/throughput, cash sweeps)
* Strong knowledge of Central Bank, Nostros, Vostros
* Good knowledge in IDL and related areas - systems and processes linked to IDL management and optimization, peak usage, stress metrics and associated HQLA buffers
* Good knowledge in front to back flows, particularly related to payments and settlements across asset classes is useful
* Good knowledge of MT / ISO payment and statement related messages (PACS, CAMT, MT9x, MT5x)

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 10 years relevant experience in any Banking operations

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

jobs.title: Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintech's, payment enablers and governments.
  
  
VCA-X is VCA's global delivery capability, designed to scale high-value solutions across Regions through multidisciplinary teams, common delivery standards, AI-enabled assets, and continuous learning from delivery. Working in partnership with Regional teams and Practice Areas, VCA-X enables consistent, efficient, and scalable delivery while maintaining client and market relevance.
  
  
Specialist & Consulting Delivery is a core pillar of the VCA-X operating model. It provides the specialist expertise, consulting delivery capacity, consulting leadership, and quality oversight required to ensure VCA-X delivers credible, consistent, and client-ready outputs.
  
  
The role operates within one of three core delivery leadership pillars within VCA-X, alongside Program Management and Data & Analytics Delivery. It will form part of the VCA-X Extended Leadership Team, and report directly to the Senior Director and Head of Specialist & Consulting Delivery, VCA-X.
  
  
**What a Director, Consulting Delivery, VCA-X Does At Visa**
The Director, Consulting Delivery will lead the consulting delivery team within VCA-X and will be responsible for ensuring consulting resources are effectively deployed, developed, and supported across the portfolio. They will be responsible for ensuring that the consulting delivery team delivers credible, consistent and client-ready outputs across engagements.
  
  
This leader will ensure VCA-X engagements have the consulting capacity, expertise, and leadership required to deliver high-quality client outcomes. Working closely with Practice Areas and Regional VCA teams, the Director will operationalize methodologies, be responsible for consulting capability, and establish the standards required for scalable consulting delivery excellence.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities Of The Role Include**
Specialist & Consulting Organization Leadership
  
  

* Build and manage a flexible consulting delivery pool that can be deployed across priority use cases, Regions, and multidisciplinary engagement teams.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing specialist and consulting talent.
* Partner with Program Management to forecast consulting resource needs and ensure sufficient consulting delivery capacity to support engagement demand.
* Foster a culture of intellectual rigor, collaboration, learning, and client impact.

Consulting Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Ensure engagements are staffed with the appropriate consulting capabilities and delivery support required to achieve engagement objectives.
* Provide oversight for complex, high-impact, or strategically important engagements.
* Lead deployment of consulting delivery resources across the VCA-X portfolio, balancing expertise, capacity, development opportunities, and delivery priorities.
* Coach teams in structured problem solving, insight development, recommendation formulation, and executive communication.
* Serve as an advisor and first escalation point for delivery teams.

Delivery Quality & Client Readiness
  
  

* Establish delivery standards, quality expectations, and review processes across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Ensure outputs are commercially relevant, supported by sound specialist judgement, and appropriate to client and market context.
* Drive continuous improvements in delivery quality, consistency, and effectiveness.
* Partner with Regional VCA teams to ensure outputs support successful client engagement.

Practice Area Partnership & Methodology Enablement
  
  

* Partner with Practice Areas to operationalize established methodologies into scalable delivery approaches.
* Lead validation of new use cases and delivery approaches before they are scaled broadly across the VCA-X portfolio.
* Capture delivery feedback and provide structured input to methodology evolution and improvement.

Expertise Development & Continuous Learning
  
  

* Define the specialist expertise and consulting capabilities required across the portfolio.
* Establish learning pathways and leadership development approaches.
* Capture specialist, consulting and quality learnings from engagements and translate them into improved methodologies, delivery approaches, training and reusable assets.
* Partner with Analytics and Engineering teams to strengthen multidisciplinary delivery.

Why this is important to Visa
  
  
Scaling VCA-X is central to VCA's strategy for expanding delivery capacity, accelerating execution, and creating greater impact for clients globally.
  
  
The ability to scale delivery successfully depends not only on capacity but on maintaining the quality, expertise, and consulting rigor that clients expect from VCA.
  
  
This role is critical to ensuring that VCA-X delivers consistent, high-quality outputs while building the specialist and consulting capability required to support future growth. The Director will play a key role in strengthening delivery excellence, accelerating learning, and increasing the impact of VCA across Regions.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 12 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA)

**What You Will Need**

* 15+ years of experience in consulting, advisory services, professional services, specialist delivery, or related fields.
* Demonstrated success leading complex client engagements and ensuring executive-level quality standards.
* Strong consulting toolkit including structured problem solving, analytical reasoning, synthesis, storylining, and recommendation development.
* Experience scaling consulting organizations across multiple markets or regions.
* Ability to translate methodologies into repeatable and scalable delivery approaches.
* Executive presence and strong stakeholder-management skills.
* Proven ability to recruit, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and build partnerships across matrixed organizations.
* Strong academic credentials with an undergraduate or advanced degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* What will also help:
* Expertise in one or more VCA domains such as portfolio optimization, risk, or digital.
* Experience operating within global consulting, managed-services, or professional-services organizations.
* Knowledge of payments, financial services, or adjacent industries.
* Experience building new capabilities, operating models, or delivery organizations from the ground up.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

jobs.title: Regional Head, MENA
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Alpha Ladder Group is a Singapore-headquartered financial services group operating across regulated capital markets, digital asset services, wealth management, cross-border payments and asset tokenization.

Through our regulated entities and technology infrastructure, we provide institutional and corporate clients with innovative financial solutions spanning traditional finance and digital assets. Our ecosystem combines regulated financial services with advanced payment and digital asset infrastructure to support clients across global markets.

As we expand our presence in the Middle East and Africa, we are seeking an experienced regional leader to establish and scale our business across the MENA region.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a commercially driven, well-connected and entrepreneurial
**Regional Head, MENA**
to spearhead our business growth and market expansion across the Middle East and North Africa.

The ideal candidate is an established country or regional business leader from a payment institution, digital asset company or financial institution, with a strong commercial background, an extensive network of corporate and institutional clients, and established relationships with local banks.

This is a hands-on commercial leadership role with direct accountability for client acquisition, revenue generation, strategic partnerships and regional business expansion across our cross-border payments, OTC trading and wealth management businesses.

Candidates with a transaction banking background, particularly in cross-border payments, cash management, FX and treasury solutions, are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Regional Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute the regional commercial strategy, with direct accountability for revenue growth, client acquisition and market expansion.
* Leverage established corporate and institutional client relationships to originate new business and accelerate revenue generation.
* Drive business development across cross-border payments, FX, OTC trading, digital assets and wealth management solutions.
* Build a strong sales pipeline, convert commercial opportunities into revenue and achieve agreed business targets.
* Identify new market opportunities, client segments and business expansion opportunities across the MENA region.

2.
**Client Origination & Strategic Partnerships**

* Leverage an established regional network to acquire and develop high-value corporate and institutional clients.
* Establish and strengthen strategic relationships with local banks, financial institutions, payment service providers and other ecosystem partners.
* Develop banking and payment partnerships to support regional business expansion and enhance payment, liquidity and settlement capabilities.
* Understand clients' cross-border payment, FX, treasury, liquidity and digital asset needs, and work with internal teams to deliver tailored financial solutions.
* Lead strategic commercial negotiations and build sustainable, long-term client and partner relationships.

3.
**Regional Business Leadership**

* Build and scale the regional business from the ground up, establishing local commercial capabilities and developing a high-performing business development team.
* Take ownership of regional business performance, revenue targets and sustainable commercial growth.
* Work closely with global Product, Operations, Compliance, Finance and Technology teams to drive business execution and deliver client solutions.
* Provide market intelligence, competitive insights and strategic recommendations to support the Group's regional expansion.
* Represent the company in the regional financial services and digital asset ecosystem, strengthening its market presence and industry relationships.

4.
**Regulatory & Business Governance**

* Serve as the designated local business leader for our VARA-regulated entity, subject to applicable regulatory requirements and approvals.
* Ensure regional business activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and governance standards.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal and Risk teams to support licensing requirements, ongoing regulatory obligations and effective business controls.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* At least 10 years of experience in payments, digital assets, banking, fintech or related financial services, with substantial experience in commercial leadership and business development.
* Proven experience as a Country Head, Regional Head, Country Manager, Head of Commercial, Head of Business Development, or in an equivalent senior commercial leadership role within the UAE or broader MENA region.
* Strong and established network of corporate and institutional clients, with a demonstrated ability to leverage existing relationships to originate business and generate revenue.
* Established relationships with local banks, financial institutions and payment ecosystem partners.
* Proven track record of business development, client acquisition, revenue generation and strategic partnership development.
* Prior experience in transaction banking, particularly cross-border payments, cash management, FX and treasury solutions, is highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the regional payments, financial services and/or digital asset ecosystem.
* Entrepreneurial and hands-on mindset, with the ability to build and scale a regional business in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Arabic is an advantage.
* Ability to meet applicable regulatory fit-and-proper requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within a VARA-regulated digital asset business or a financial institution operating in the UAE.
* Existing relationships with UAE banks, regional financial institutions, family offices and institutional investors.
* Experience in OTC trading, digital asset liquidity, cross-border payments or wealth management distribution.
* Prior experience establishing or scaling a regional business in the Middle East.
* Familiarity with UAE financial services regulations and the broader MENA regulatory landscape.

**What We Offer**

* An opportunity to lead and build a regional business in one of the world's fastest-growing financial markets.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
* The opportunity to shape the Group's MENA expansion across digital assets, payments and wealth management.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial and internationally connected working environment.
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

jobs.title: Director – Precious Metals Sales
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Organization Unit Purpose**

The Precious Metals business originates, structures and delivers physical and financial precious metals solutions for the Bank’s corporate, institutional, commercial and wealth clients. The unit connects client coverage with trading, structuring, operations, legal, credit and compliance capabilities to build a scalable, well-controlled and profitable bullion franchise across the UAE and ENBDs network markets.

**Job Purpose**

The Director – Precious Metals Sales is responsible for originating and growing precious metals revenue by developing client relationships and delivering solutions across physical bullion, price-risk management, financing and investment products. The role leads opportunity identification, solution design and transaction execution while ensuring suitability, documentation, conduct, operational readiness and risk requirements are fully satisfied.

The job holder will contribute to the strategic development of the Bank’s precious metals franchise, deepen wallet share across existing relationships, acquire new-to-bank flows, and position the Bank as a trusted regional liquidity, financing and physical bullion partner.

**Job Content**

**Sales strategy and revenue delivery:**
Develop and execute a client and product sales plan to achieve annual revenue, volume, profitability and franchise objectives. Maintain a disciplined pipeline, identify white-space opportunities and convert prospects into recurring business.

**Client origination and relationship management:**
Build senior relationships with banks, refiners, bullion traders, jewellery groups, retailers, family offices, sovereign-linked entities and large corporates. Lead account planning with relationship teams and coordinate multi-product engagement.

**Physical bullion solutions:**
Originate and execute outright sales and purchases of allocated or unallocated gold and silver, minted and investment products, consignment, deferred-payment structures, import/export flows, custody and vault-related solutions, subject to approved product and risk frameworks.

**Hedging and investment solutions:**
Advise clients on precious metals price-risk management and investment requirements using approved spot, forward, swap, option and structured solutions. Translate market views into suitable, executable ideas without compromising conduct or suitability standards.

**Financing and balance-sheet solutions:**
Partner with structuring, credit and relationship teams on gold loans, bullion repo, inventory or transit financing, collateralised structures and other approved precious metals financing solutions.

**End-to-end transaction leadership:**
Coordinate pricing, credit, documentation, KYC, sanctions screening, logistics, insurance, settlement, vaulting and post-trade follow-up. Escalate execution risks early and ensure responsibilities are clearly assigned.

**Market intelligence and franchise development:**
Monitor precious metals markets, regional physical premiums, competitor activity, regulation, refining and supply-chain developments. Provide actionable intelligence to clients and management and support new product, corridor and partnership development.

**Governance, risk and controls:**
Operate within approved mandates and policies covering market, credit, legal, operational, conduct, financial-crime and reputational risk. Maintain complete records and ensure transactions meet relevant internal approvals and regulatory requirements.

**Cross-functional collaboration and leadership:**
Work closely with trading, structuring, research, operations, finance, legal, compliance, credit and coverage teams. Share product knowledge, support joint client meetings, coach junior team members and strengthen a collaborative sales culture.

Achieve financial targets

Originate profitable client flows, manage the opportunity pipeline and deliver an appropriate mix of recurring and strategic transactions.

Expand client franchise

Build account plans, conduct regular senior client engagement and create cross-sell opportunities with coverage teams.

Deliver execution excellence

Lead transactions from idea through settlement, align internal stakeholders and resolve issues promptly.

Build strategic capability

Identify market gaps, support product development and establish scalable routes to market across priority jurisdictions.

Maintain strong controls

Ensure suitability, approvals, documentation, KYC, sanctions, credit and operational controls are completed before execution.

Strengthening team and connectivity

Share market and product expertise, support junior colleagues and improve coordination across sales, trading and support functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, engineering or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
* CFA, FRM or relevant treasury/commodities qualifications.

**Experiences**

Minimum 10 years of relevant banking, precious metals experience, including a strong record in client-facing sales and revenue generation. Experience with physical bullion and/or precious metals derivatives is required.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of gold and silver markets, physical supply chains, spot/forward/swap pricing, hedging, financing and settlement conventions.
* Understanding of vaulting, logistics, custody and refining ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to originate opportunities, build senior relationships, negotiate commercial terms, manage a pipeline and convert complex requirements into executable solutions.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Client centricity and trusted-adviser mindset
* Commercial judgement and revenue orientation
* Precious metals market expertise
* Strategic thinking and market development
* Negotiation and influencing
* Execution discipline and attention to detail
* Risk awareness, integrity and control ownership
* Collaboration, leadership and talent development

There’s never been a better time to join Emirates NBD.

We’re one of the region’s most recognizable brands. We’re banking innovation leaders. We’re growing across both the UAE and our global offices. We offer a huge range of professional development opportunities to accelerate your career. It also goes without saying that we provide extremely competitive rewards, benefits and perks too, like our flexible work policy so you can work from home whenever it suits.

**Head of M&A**

Location: Dubai, UAE · Permanent

Our client, a banking group in the UAE, is hiring a senior M&A banker to build and lead a new advisory franchise within its Investment Banking business. This is a franchise-building role for an entrepreneurial dealmaker who can both originate and execute.

**Purpose of the role**

To originate, win and execute M&A and private capital advisory mandates across the bank’s client base. You’ll turn existing financing relationships into broader advisory relationships and build a sustainable, leading regional M&A franchise. The role needs strong transaction execution together with a commercial, proactive approach to origination and client development.

**Key accountabilities**

* Origination and franchise building: proactively find M&A and strategic advisory opportunities across the bank’s client base, and originate new mandates with relationship managers and sector teams.
* Trusted adviser: build senior relationships with shareholders, boards and management teams, and position the bank beyond its traditional financing role as an adviser on acquisitions, disposals, capital raising and strategy.
* M&A execution: lead sell-side and buy-side transactions end to end. This covers transaction strategy, valuation, process design, marketing materials, due diligence, negotiations and closing.
* Equity story and positioning: develop compelling equity and investment narratives for clients and assets, combining rigorous financial analysis with a clear view of strategic positioning, growth prospects and value creation.
* Buyer and investor access: identify, approach and build credibility with strategic buyers, financial sponsors, sovereign investors, family offices and other institutional investors, both in the region and internationally.
* Private capital: originate and execute private capital raising mandates, including growth equity, minority investments and other strategic capital solutions.
* Cross-bank collaboration and growth: bring the bank’s full capabilities and relationships to clients, build a sustainable pipeline of mandates, and grow Investment Banking revenues and the bank’s market profile.

**Experience and qualifications**

* About 15+ years of high-quality M&A or investment banking advisory experience, ideally at a leading investment bank or advisory platform.
* A demonstrable track record of executing complex sell-side and buy-side transactions.
* Proven origination capability, with the ability to find opportunities, win mandates and build a business, not only execute.
* Credibility and executive presence with shareholders, CEOs, CFOs, boards and sophisticated investors, plus experience handling critical negotiations with the C-suite, financial sponsors and other stakeholders in an M&A process.

**Knowledge and skills**

M&A technical and execution expertise; valuation and financial analysis; equity story development and investment positioning; origination and business development; senior client and board-level relationship management; negotiation; process design and deal management; private capital and growth equity structuring; investor and buyer coverage; commercial judgement; cross-functional collaboration; an entrepreneurial, franchise-building mindset.
