jobs.title: Financial Advisory Job Opportunities (Manager, Associate Director, Director & Managing Director)
jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

jobs.title: Enterprise PMO Lead in Abu Dhabi
jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------

Andersen is hiring an Enterprise PMO Lead in Abu Dhabi for a transformation program focused on governance, operations improvement, and business process optimization.

The customer is a leading publicly listed financial services company in the Middle East, operating under strict regulatory supervision and combining a strong financial foundation with a modern trading infrastructure. The organization focuses on innovation, sustainable growth, and regional market leadership, acting as a key liquidity provider for major listed enterprises and supporting the stability of a national stock exchange. It also develops advanced mobile investment solutions and actively invests in social and healthcare initiatives as part of its corporate responsibility strategy.

The project is focused on a strategic back-office transformation program aimed at improving governance, coordination, and operational processes. It includes stakeholder and vendor management, program oversight, and supporting implementation activities to ensure effective delivery and alignment across business and technology teams.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Setting up and managing the PMO governance structure for the back-office transformation program.
* Maintaining the master program plan, milestones, RAID log, decision log, dependency tracker, and governance calendar.
* Defining reporting cadence, escalation routes, steering committee structure, and program controls.
* Ensuring all parties are clear on ownership, deadlines, deliverables, risks, and required decisions.
* Working closely with the CFO, CTO, business heads, Andersen, KGiSL, and other stakeholders.
* Preparing executive-level status reports, steering committee packs, dashboards, and decision papers.
* Translating complex program activity into clear, concise updates for senior leadership.
* Ensuring open risks, delays, blockers, and decisions are escalated early and properly documented.
* Coordinating the overall back-office transformation roadmap.
* Tracking progress across requirements, due diligence, implementation planning, testing, migration, cutover, training, and go-live readiness.
* Ensuring business, technology, legal, compliance, finance, and vendor workstreams remain aligned.
* Supporting business readiness and ensuring implementation activity stays connected to Al Ramz’s operating priorities.
* Coordinating the due diligence process related to the acquisition or transfer of back-office code from KGiSL.
* Organizing inputs from business, technology, legal, finance, compliance, Andersen, and KGiSL.
* Tracking document requests, open questions, workshops, findings, risks, actions, and decisions.
* Ensuring due diligence outcomes are converted into clear recommendations, action plans, and implementation implications.
* Coordinating across Al Ramz, Andersen, KGiSL, and other third-party vendors.
* Tracking vendor deliverables, dependencies, open actions, risks, and unresolved decisions.
* Ensuring vendor commitments are clear, measurable, and properly followed up.
* Escalating gaps, delays, unclear ownership, or weak delivery discipline when needed.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Experience in Enterprise PMO, Program Management, Transformation Governance, or Strategic Program Delivery for 4+ years.
* Strong experience in PMO methodology, governance, program controls, and executive reporting
* Experience working in financial services, capital markets, brokerage, banking, fintech, investment platforms, or similar regulated environments
* Experience coordinating complex business and technology transformation programs
* Strong stakeholder management across senior leadership, business, IT, finance, legal, compliance, and vendors
* Experience preparing steering committee materials, executive dashboards, decision papers, and program status reports
* Experience managing multi-vendor environments
* Financial services transformation exposure
* Ability to simplify complex topics for CFO / CTO-level stakeholders
* Ability to drive accountability across multiple parties
* Level of English – Upper-Intermediate or above.

**Reasons to join us**

* Andersen cooperates with such companies as Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, AstraZeneca, BNP Paribas, Allianz, Ryanair, TUI, Verivox, Media Markt, etc..

* The most important thing that we value in our employees is a commitment to continuous learning. The company supports them in this and gives them access to the best educational platforms, seminars, and practices. In addition, for over 19 years, Andersen has assembled a huge knowledge base and established a robust resource management institution.
* We have been strengthening our expertise since 2007. During this time, we have formed excellent teams with streamlined processes, where you can learn something new from your colleagues every day and enjoy your work.
* We are a cool young team of like-minded people communicating informally.
* You'll have a stable and competitive salary and an extensive benefits package.
* At Andersen, we have many different ways to grow. You can improve as a specialist or a manager, and all your activities will be decently rewarded.

Join us!

jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Role Description:**

This role is responsible for the ongoing monthly testing of the Quality Assurance program for all Wealth clients records in UAE. The Post Execution Quality process is a key risk indicator that is reported to the regulators monthly. The PEQ process is reviewed numerous times a year by Regulators, Internal Audit and Compliance Testing to ensure adherence to regulatory and Citi-wide policies and standards. This role is responsible to test the Post Execution Quality accuracy to ensure all KYC Quality reporting is in line with our regulatory commitments to the OCC. This role is responsible for independently testing each PEQ analyst and report all findings to the Head of Wealth KYC Quality for effective oversight of personnel.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

This role is critical in identifying any quality deficiencies immediately, raise self-identified issues for proper oversight and execution on the correction action plans in a timely manner. Without this role and process, KYC could introduce significant risks related to regulatory and internal audit findings for insufficient KYC program and controls. These results would lead to significant remediation population, remediation populations, procedures changes or even MRA (Matters Requiring Attention) if identified by a regulator.

Partner with internal units to ensure adequate due diligence process is carried out for customer accounts and documentation reviews.

Ensure all information and documentation comply with local regulation and Citi standards.

Ensure all AML risks are mitigated based on local regulation and internal procedural requirements.

Review all screening activities and making sure all true, false, and potential matches are dispositioned correctly including sanctions related activities, if applicable.

Update and review forms according to local regulation requirements and work with Compliance to expedite documentation reviews, providing clarification as needed.

Appropriately assess and verify CIP requirements based on internal and global requirements.

Strong understanding of wealth holding vehicles which includes the various structures, legality, and documentation for each type of entity.

Participate and assist with the organization of weekly meetings and calls to discuss “Sustainability and Remediation” population.

Appropriately assessing risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation
jobs.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of experience in leading GenAI and tech transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/ADGenAIOct26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers
  
  
Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex, race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Transformation (India)
jobs.description:
Osfin.ai is a fast-growing transaction intelligence platform for Financial Services firms globally. Osfin.ai helps Financial Services firms automate payments and ledger reconciliation, disputes and chargebacks management, payouts automation, and more. Osfin.ai's customers have been able to transform their 100+ complex and resource-intensive FinOps processes smoothly.
  
  
**Who Is an Ideal Fit for Us?**
As Osfin scales, we are building a bench of enterprise-level subject-matter experts who can lead transformation and modernisation for large organisations and help us enter new finance domains. This is a high-ownership, client-facing role for someone who combines deep domain authority with a strong instinct for AI & automation and the commercial sense to turn expertise into product and growth.
  
  
**What Will You Get to Work On?**
As Director, Enterprise Transformation at Osfin.ai, you will look after:
  
  

* Transformation Roadmap: Define and own the enterprise transformation roadmap across finance, operations and technology.
* Process & Operating Model Redesign: Redesign end-to-end processes (Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash) and the operating model to improve speed, scale and control.
* ERP & Platform Modernisation: Lead ERP and enterprise platform modernisation (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite or similar).
* Automation & AI: Identify and deliver automation and AI opportunities across accounting and finance operations.
* Programme Governance: Set up programme governance, KPIs and value-realisation tracking, and report progress to executive leadership.
* Investment & Delivery Management: Prioritise investments and manage budgets, capacity and cross-functional delivery.
* Controls & Compliance: Strengthen internal controls, audit readiness and compliance (SOX, Ind AS/IFRS).
* Executive Partnership: Partner with the CFO, CTO, Legal, Risk and Procurement to align strategy with execution.
* Team Leadership: Build, mentor and lead high-performing teams.
* Executive relationship leader partnering with COO, CTO, business executives, Legal, Risk, Technology, and Operations to develop transformation strategies, modernize operating models, and deliver enterprise technology, AI, and process optimization initiatives aligned to firm priorities.
* Lead enterprise portfolios spanning digital transformation, business process management (BPM), risk & compliance, automation, AI enablement, contracting, and operational transformation, driving investment prioritization, executive decision-making, and measurable business outcomes across global teams.
* Build trusted partnerships across Executive Leadership, Engineering, Tech, Governance, Procurement, Legal, and business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technology roadmaps and cross-functional delivery plans.
* Responsible for driving governance, portfolio management, and executive reporting for complex, multi-million-dollar transformation initiatives, establishing KPIs, value realization metrics, and leading capacity management to improve transparency and accelerate decision-making.

**What Do We Expect From You?**

* Core Experience: 10+ years in enterprise transformation, finance/accounting transformation or ERP modernisation.

* Delivery Track Record: Track record of delivering large transformation or automation programmes with measurable results (cost savings, cycle-time reduction).

* Location: Based in Bengaluru.

*Good-to-Have*

* Qualifications: CA / CPA / CISA / MBA.
* Regulated Exposure: Exposure to GRC, SOX, and regulated industries.
* AI Transformation: Experience with AI/GenAI-led process transformation.

* A clear transformation roadmap approved by leadership.
* Two to three high-impact automation or modernisation programmes delivered.
* Governance and KPI framework running with regular executive reporting.
* Visible gains in cycle time, cost, or control quality.

**Why Join Us?**

* Shape how Osfin works and scales, alongside the founders and senior leadership.
* Work with a high-calibre team of industry experts and solve complex problems at scale.
* Build capabilities that serve leading customers across banking, fintech, e-commerce, and other industries.
* Drive the next phase of platform and operational development, with significant ownership and impact.

Location: Bengaluru

Immediate joiners preferred (up to 30 days considered)

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Executive Director**
- Transition Solution Design & Execution Lead, Finance Managed Services
  
  
**Portfolio**
Finance Managed Services
  
  
**Primary focus**
Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilization assurance and transition innovation

India GDS Location
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Finance Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

+ Engage credibly with CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers and process owners on financial close, reporting, compliance, working capital and service-performance outcomes.
+ Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
+ Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
+ Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
+ Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* Transition solution design & execution assurance

+ Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
+ Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
+ Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
+ Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
+ Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* Functional authority and innovation

+ Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
+ Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
+ Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
+ Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities

+ Evaluate finance-specific trade-offs involving control effectiveness, close stability, reporting accuracy, working-capital impact, service cost, standardisation and regulatory exposure.
+ Determine whether process, data and control readiness is sufficient to proceed with migration, parallel run, cutover and operational acceptance.
+ Solve novel, ambiguous and enterprise-scale transition problems for which established precedents may not exist.
+ Make or recommend high-consequence decisions on transition design, sequencing, risk treatment, governance and readiness within delegated authority.
+ Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.

* Maintain strong financial and operational controls across interchange reconciliation, network fees, routing, reporting, exceptions, adjustments, and other activities affecting merchant or corporate financial positions.

* Drive a scalable operating model that provides resiliency, knowledge transfer, cross-training, and appropriate site redundancy while maintaining consistent operational standards across locations.
* Manage operational risk by proactively identifying process breaks, control gaps, financial exposure, network or compliance concerns, data-quality issues, and emerging trends and ensuring appropriate remediation and escalation.
* Support audit and control activities, maintaining strong documentation, process adherence, evidence management, and sustainable controls.
* Partner across the organization with Product, Technology, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Network Relations, Account Management, and other business partners to resolve complex issues and deliver strategic objectives.
* Provide leadership for client, merchant, and business escalations, ensuring complex Payment Acceptance issues are researched thoroughly, root causes are understood, and sustainable corrective actions are implemented.
* Develop organizational talent and succession, strengthening leadership capability and Payment Acceptance subject-matter expertise while building clear development paths for associates, analysts, supervisors, and managers.
* Create an accountability-driven culture where leaders and associates demonstrate ownership, sound judgment, follow-through, continuous learning, and commitment to client and business outcomes.

**What You Need To Have**

* Demonstrated experience in business analysis, Payment Acceptance, payment operations, network reporting, fee oversight, merchant compliance, or a related field, ideally within financial services.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, validate data integrity, and resolve discrepancies.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex network requirements into clear business requirements and operational direction.
* Proven ability to lead multiple projects and priorities simultaneously with strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge of payment networks, merchant compliance requirements, network fees, reporting processes, and industry regulations.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, reporting tools, and Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, and Excel macros.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues, assess business impact and risk, and coordinate solutions with payment networks and internal teams.
* Ability to work effectively across payment networks, lines of business, and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience leading Paymen

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

The role combines transformation leadership, business architecture, programme delivery, AI-enabled innovation and stakeholder management to help VOIS achieve its long-term growth and performance ambitions.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

jobs.title: Director-Technology Controls Testing Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

**Profile Summary:**

The Technology Controls Team Lead leads the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team and the EMEA Technology Internal Control Testing Programme.

The role is responsible for the risk-based assessment of technology controls, including control design and operating effectiveness testing, evidence quality, issue identification, remediation monitoring and management reporting. The role also develops data-led, automated and continuous control-assurance capabilities.

Working across EMEA Technology, the role partners with control owners, Technology leadership and relevant oversight and assurance functions to strengthen the technology control environment while maintaining clear accountability across the three lines of defense.

**Technology Controls Framework and Testing:**

* Own and maintain the EMEA Technology Controls Testing Framework.
* Lead the Technology Internal Control Testing Programme, including methodology, planning, scope, approval, execution, quality assurance and reporting.
* Develop a risk-based testing plan using RCSA results, process mapping, risk appetite measures, incidents, control failures, audit findings, regulatory priorities and material technology changes.
* Prioritize controls associated with Critical and High inherent risks, while including Moderate-rated controls where justified by risk concentration, limited assurance coverage, control failures or emerging risk.
* Maintain a technology testing inventory covering control ownership, risk linkage, testing frequency, previous results, existing assurance coverage and open issues.
* Lead control walkthroughs and assessments of control design and operating effectiveness.
* Define testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Ensure conclusions are supported by complete, reliable and traceable evidence.
* Coordinate with IT Risk Assurance lead on SOX, Compliance, Head Office and other assurance programmes to minimize unnecessary duplication.
* Continuously improve testing methodology, guidance, templates and supporting tools.

**Issues and Remediation:**

* Ensure control deficiencies, self-identified issues, risk acceptances and treatment plans are consistently identified, recorded and escalated.
* Challenge control ownership, testing conclusions, remediation plans and proposed issue closure.
* Ensure remediation actions have clear owners and target dates.
* Monitor remediation through to closure and arrange validation or retesting where required.
* Identify recurring or systemic control weaknesses requiring coordinated remediation.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue actions and risk appetite breaches through the appropriate governance channels.

**Audit and Regulatory Readiness:**

* Coordinate Technology responses to internal audit, external audit, SOX and regulatory assurance activity.
* Maintain a coordinated view of assurance activity, findings, evidence requests, management responses and remediation commitments.
* Improve the quality and timeliness of evidence, walkthroughs and management responses.
* Maintain a reusable regional evidence base to support assurance activity.
* Ensure recurring audit and regulatory themes inform the control framework, testing plan and remediation priorities.
* Support senior-management and regulatory briefings on material technology control matters.

**Reporting and Governance:**

* Own management information covering technology control testing delivery, control effectiveness, issues, remediation, risk acceptances and recurring themes.
* Provide concise, accurate and decision-oriented reporting to Technology leadership and relevant governance forums.
* Act as the central escalation and prioritisation point for Technology control-testing matters.
* Represent the Chief Technology Controls Team at relevant committees and working groups.
* Ensure material control weaknesses and risks are escalated promptly and transparently.

**Data, Tools and Continuous Assurance:**

* Own the Technology Controls testing toolset, workflows, dashboards and analytics capability.
* Ensure testing plans, evidence, samples, conclusions, issues and remediation records are accurately maintained in approved repositories.
* Establish standards for evidence quality, naming, ownership, version control, retention, permissions and audit traceability.
* Lead evidence coordination and quality review with process and control owners.
* Develop automated monitoring and continuous control-testing capabilities where supported by reliable data and repeatable testing logic.
* Define appropriate governance for automated testing, including data quality, access, change control, exception handling and periodic validation.
* Explore the responsible use of AI to support evidence review, control mapping, testing preparation, exception identification, thematic analysis and reporting.
* Ensure that automation and AI retain appropriate governance, validation and human oversight.

**Leadership and People Management:**

* Lead and develop the India-based Chief Technology Controls Team, initially comprising three VP-level control resources.
* Set team priorities and allocate coverage according to risk, assurance requirements and business demand.
* Lead implementation of the target operating model.
* Establish clear objectives, accountabilities and quality expectations.
* Build team capability through training, coaching and knowledge management.
* Promote a constructive, evidence-led risk and control culture.
* Provide broader local Technology Management or Operations oversight only where formally assigned.

**Decision Authority (Within delegated authority, the role may):**

* Approve the proposed testing plan and material scope changes before governance submission.
* Determine testing methods, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and quality standards.
* Require additional evidence, expanded testing or retesting.
* Escalate material control failures, overdue remediation and inadequate risk acceptance.
* Prioritise team activity and allocate testing resources.
* Recommend control improvements and automation opportunities.
  ***Control owners remain accountable for operating their controls and remediating identified weaknesses. Risk acceptance remains subject to approval under the applicable risk-management framework.***

**Experience and Skills:**

* Significant experience in technology risk, technology controls, IT audit, cyber risk or a related discipline within regulated financial services.
* Experience leading a technology control-testing or management-assurance programme.
* Strong knowledge of control design and operating effectiveness testing, including walkthroughs, evidence assessment, sampling, reperformance and issue validation.
* Experience of RCSA, risk appetite, issue management, risk acceptance and governance reporting.
* Broad understanding of material technology risks and controls.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews or SOX activity.
* Proven leadership of senior risk or control professionals.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to challenge constructively and explain complex control matters to senior management.
* Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions and multicultural teams.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* Strategic thinking and planni

jobs.title: Associate Director/Director - GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation

jobs.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $115 billion in investment capital as of September 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for a GenAI Business Strategy & Transformation Lead to anchor the DESIS GenAI-for-Business ("GAIBiz") effort. Depending on the candidate’s location preference, the position is open for either of our Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram offices in India. This person will be responsible for translating the firm's GenAI strategy into tangible adoption and measurable outcomes across the DESIS environment, working in close partnership with the strategy and transformation core based in the firm's global offices. This is a role largely built around execution and adoption. The strategy setting and transformation agenda is driven centrally; the mandate here is to land that agenda well within DESIS, shaping it for the local context, driving uptake, and delivering results on the ground. There will be real opportunities to influence direction and expand scope over time, but a candidate who thrives will be one who is energized by making things happen, not solely by setting up the agenda. This role will offer a good mix of strategy formulation and hands on delivery experience, tilting more towards later.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will drive GenAI adoption across DESIS by moving initiatives from pilot to production use; conceptualizing and executing novel ways to increase adoption; and owning the associated logistics and change-management scaffolding (enablement, incentives, communications, feedback loops) needed to turn well-designed programs into genuine, sustained uptake. You will partner with the global strategy and transformation core, acting as the DESIS anchor for firmwide GenAI strategy, ensuring initiatives are contextualized, sequenced, and executed effectively in and for the DESIS environment. You will engage credibly with technical teams, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering and data teams, understanding architecture, model capabilities, and tradeoffs well enough to challenge, prioritize, and unblock. You will embed risk, compliance, and data governance, ensuring GenAI initiatives meet the firm's standards for data protection, model risk, regulatory expectations, and responsible-AI practice from the outset, not as an afterthought. Finally, you will measure and communicate impact by defining the metrics that matter, tracking adoption and value realization, and reporting progress clearly to senior stakeholders across DESIS and the global firm.
  
  
**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* 15 or more years of experience in leading GenAI and tech transformation, including recent hands-on leadership of Generative AI initiatives
* Sound instincts on when to buy, when to build, and when a middle path serves best, with the commercial sense to weigh cost, speed, and control (Strategic and commercial judgment)
* A demonstrated track record of driving uptake, not just designing programs. Evidence of moving organizations from intent to embedded behavior (Change management and adoption)
* Deep enough understanding of GenAI and modern data/ML systems to engage engineers credibly and make informed trade-offs. You need not be a builder, but you must be conversant (Technical literacy)
* Experience in or adjacent to market finance, hedge funds, or investment management, with enough fluency to earn the trust of demanding stakeholders (Domain credibility)
* Practical familiarity with the risk, regulatory, and data-governance considerations that shape how AI can responsibly be deployed in a financial-services setting (Risk, compliance and data governance)
* Pragmatic and outcome-obsessed approach, with a high tolerance for ambiguity and rapid change. Ability to influence without authority across a distributed, matrixed organization, and comfort in operating primarily in a delivery-focused capacity within a globally driven agenda (Temperament and influencing skills)
* Creativity, critical thinking with excellent written and verbal communication skills and an entrepreneurial mindset to take on challenging, high-impact projects

jobs.description:

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.description:
**About Data Axle**

Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission-critical data services to its global customers, powered by its proprietary cloud-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.  
  
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for an experienced and strategic Senior Director - Finance to lead the finance function, oversee financial operations, and drive financial governance across the organization.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in managing financial reporting, accounting, controllership, taxation, audit, and regulatory compliance, with strong expertise in both Indian Accounting Standards (IGAAP / Ind AS) and US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

This role will serve as a strategic finance partner to senior leadership and global stakeholders, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with global finance policies and business objectives.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Financial Reporting & Controllership**

* Lead end-to-end financial reporting, accounting, and controllership functions.
* Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements under both IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP.
* Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing processes.
* Manage financial consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and reporting.
* Ensure consistency between local statutory reporting and US GAAP reporting requirements.
* Establish robust internal financial controls, accounting policies, and governance frameworks.

* **US GAAP & IGAAP Compliance**

* Provide technical accounting guidance on complex accounting matters under US GAAP and IGAAP / Ind AS.
* Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, statutory requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
* Manage accounting differences between Indian and US reporting frameworks, including revenue recognition, leases, fixed assets, provisions, and foreign currency transactions.
* Coordinate with global finance teams to ensure alignment of accounting practices and reporting standards.
* Drive implementation of changes in accounting standards and assess their business impact.

* **Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and performance management.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support strategic business decisions.
* Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Develop financial models, business forecasts, and scenario analyses.
* Partner with business leaders to identify cost optimization and profitability improvement opportunities.

* **Audit, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Lead statutory, internal, and external audit processes.
* Manage coordination with external auditors, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities.
* Oversee direct and indirect taxation, including corporate tax, GST, transfer pricing, and other applicable compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to Indian statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support US audit and tax reporting requirements in coordination with global finance teams.

* **Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee treasury operations, working capital, liquidity, and cash flow management.
* Develop strategies for efficient cash utilization and financial risk management.
* Monitor foreign exchange exposure and implement appropriate risk mitigation measures.
* Manage banking relationships and financing arrangements.

* **Global Finance Stakeholder Management**

* Act as a key finance business partner to US-based leadership and global finance teams.
* Drive standardization of financial processes, reporting frameworks, and controls across geographies.
* Present financial performance, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
* Ensure effective coordination between India finance operations and US corporate finance.

* **Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance and accounting team.
* Build a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and digital transformation across finance operations.
* Establish KPIs and performance metrics for the finance function.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 15+ years of post-qualification experience (PQE) in Finance and Accounting, including significant experience in senior finance leadership roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in both **IGAAP / Ind AS and US GAAP**.
* Proven experience managing financial reporting and controllership for multinational organizations or US-headquartered companies.
* Strong understanding of US GAAP technical accounting, financial consolidation, and statutory reporting.
* Experience managing global finance stakeholders and cross-border financial operations.
* Strong exposure to financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, treasury, and audit management.
* Experience leading large finance teams and managing complex financial operations.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

The platform hosts a growing portfolio of AI solutions across practice lines and is architected from day one to support future client access optionality as the firm's AI offering matures.

The Head of Platform reports to the CTO and is the principal hands-on solution architect of the AI Platform. The Head of Platform designs the platform architecture, produces Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and provides the technical depth that enables the firm's AI-enabled service model. The role builds and operates a multi-tenant, cloud-native platform that hosts, scales and governs firm's AI product portfolio and simultaneously architects the Enterprise Data Vault, the firm's proprietary data moat built from anonymized, indexed engagement data across mandates. Build and operationalise the platform and data vault as per roadmap timelines.

The Head of Platform operates within architectural guardrails set by the CTO, with autonomy over reversible engineering decisions and a defined escalation path for irreversible architectural choices. If you are a hands-on architect and have built platforms that power AI products at scale and want to build and operate one of the most ambitious AI platform builds in middle-market advisory, this is the right role for you.

* Work with Head of IT / Infra / Security to embed security-by-design and jointly own SOC 2 Type II technical controls at the application and data layer

* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

* Security-first design with SOC 2 Type II technical controls ownership at application and data layer, ADR track record reviewed at CXO or board level

Own the revenue cycle, cash and controls for UK healthcare organisations, lead the receivables and payables teams, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). A senior role in Dubai with real ownership.

About Salvone

Salvone Technology Solutions FZCO is a Dubai technology consultancy that delivers end to end transformation for organisations in healthcare, hospitality and other highly regulated industries. We have deep roots in UK health and social care and a growing presence across the Middle East and Asia.

Our healthcare clients include mental health hospitals, residential and nursing care, supported living, children's services and specialist complex care. In hospitality and F&B, we support multi-location brands with ERP, supply chain and workforce systems built to scale. We own the full journey, from discovery to optimisation, and design every solution around how our clients really operate.

The role

We are hiring a Financial Controller to own the revenue cycle and day-to-day finance operations for the UK healthcare organisations our Finance Healthcare team supports. You will be accountable for cash, billing integrity and financial controls across receivables, payables and banking, lead the teams that deliver them, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). It is a senior role with real ownership in a function that is building to a corporate standard.

Director, Finance (Healthcare)

- Revenue cycle: own it end to end for the UK healthcare entities, from funding and contracts to cash, with full accountability for results.

- Leadership: lead and develop the receivables and payables functions, and set their standards, priorities and performance rhythm.

- Billing integrity: run billing as a controlled monthly close in Odoo, with every variance explained and leakage fixed at source.

- Cash and working capital: improve cash conversion and the aged debt profile, and handle escalated disputes with NHS bodies, ICBs and Local Authorities.

- Controls: own the control environment across receivables, payables and banking, to an audit-ready standard.

- Reporting: give the Director, Finance (Healthcare) a clear, timely view of cash, risk and the decisions needed.

- Deputy: act for the Director, Finance (Healthcare) within delegated authority.

What you bring

- Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA).

- 6 to 8 years in finance, including at least 2 years leading a team.

- Proven ownership of a revenue cycle or receivables function in a multi-entity business, with measurable impact on cash.

- Strong control and close discipline; comfortable leading audit work.

- Advanced ERP capability (Odoo preferred), including process and reporting design.

- Senior stakeholder presence: credible with senior stakeholders, funders and banks.

Nice to have

Experience:

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. **Job Description**

**Associate Manager**
to own end-to-end account management for our key Health Insurance partners. In this role, you will act as the strategic bridge between our organization and partner insurers. You will be responsible for line-of-business (LOB) growth, product/plan integrations, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) delivery, day-to-day operations, and partner account profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account & Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned health insurance partners.

* Conduct regular performance reviews (Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews) with insurer leadership to track targets and resolve operational bottlenecks.

* Work with cross-functional teams (Growth, Marketing, Operations) to run targeted campaigns and drive premium volumes.

* Drive end-to-end onboarding and integration of new health insurance products and plan variants onto the platform.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure seamless API integrations, user journeys, policy issue workflows, and UI/UX flows.
* Regularly audit live insurance products for feature accuracy, pricing precision, and regulatory/underwriting updates.
* Account Profitability & Portfolio Management
* Monitor and manage unit economics, commission structures, loss ratios, and partner margins to ensure account profitability.
* Analyze portfolio performance across parameters like persistency, renewal rates, claim settlement rates, and ticket sizes.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payouts, and exclusive product offerings with insurance partners alongside senior management.

* Streamline operations between partner underwriters and internal operations to minimize drop-offs and improve turn-around times (TAT).
