* Product Efficiency: On-time product integration, zero feature/pricing discrepancies, and optimized conversion funnels.
* Operational SLA: Turn-around time (TAT) for policy issuance, endorsement resolution, and claim escalations.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Commerce, or related fields (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in insurance operations, account management, or category management in an Insurtech, Broker, Web Aggregator, or Health Insurance company.

* Technical & Data Skills: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, or reporting tools (Tableau/PowerBI) to track daily issuance metrics, funnel drops, and operational dashboards.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Strong execution ability, detail-oriented mindset, and effective negotiation skills when liaising with insurer operations desks.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Qualitia is a world-leading technology product company and a pioneer in scriptless, AI-native test automation. For over 15 years, we have helped some of the world's most demanding organizations ship software faster and with confidence. This includes top global banks, leading insurance companies, and stock exchanges. Our flagship product, Qualitia Boson, is the world's first AI-native, self-healing test automation solution purpose-built for Salesforce. Boson eliminates the pain of script maintenance, enables one-click test generation, and empowers teams to move at the speed of business. We are headquartered in Pune, India, and we are on a mission to change how the world thinks about quality.

**About the Role**

Enterprise Software Quality is no longer a back-office concern, it’s a boardroom priority. CIOs, CTOs, and CDOs are under pressure to release faster, reduce risk, and modernize QA using AI. Qualitia sits right at this intersection, used by top six banks in India. We are looking for a battle tested Enterprise Software Sales Leader preferrable with experience in sales of CRM, SaaS product and who knows how to navigate complex buying groups, speak the language of BFSI executives, and consistently close high-value ($1M+) deals.

**Responsibilities**

* **Revenue & Growth:**
  Own and grow 7 to 10 strategic enterprise accounts within BFSI sector. Drive end-to-end sales cycles, from executive discovery and value positioning to negotiation and closure. Identify multiple salesforce projects across the account which can contribute to building healthy sales pipeline.
* **Executive Engagement & Consultative Selling:**
  Understand and translate complex enterprise pain points into clear business outcomes such as cost reduction, release velocity, and quality at scale. Build trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite and senior technology leaders. Position Qualitia as a strategic partner for AI-driven QA, risk mitigation, and faster time-to-market.

**Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of enterprise B2B software sales experience.
* Ability to work with a sense of urgency and quick turnaround time.
* Deep exposure to BFSI verticals with strong understanding of their business units, regulatory nuances, and technology landscapes.
* Proven success in closing $1M+ ACV enterprise deals with large account or strategic customers.

**Required Skills**

* Experience in sales of CRM and SaaS products.
* Ability to navigate complex buying groups.
* Strong communication skills to engage with BFSI executives.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in enterprise software sales.
* Understanding of AI-driven QA solutions.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Payments & Banking GTM and Business Growth
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
Synechron is seeking a market-facing Solution Architect with strong Payments and Banking expertise to drive new business, account growth, strategic consulting, and solution-led engagements. The role combines domain knowledge, enterprise architecture, client advisory, executive engagement, and business development.
  
  
**Software Requirements**
**Required:**

* Enterprise and solution architecture tools
* API, integration, and cloud platforms
* CRM and opportunity-management tools
* Proposal, estimation, presentation, and documentation tools
* Payment processing and banking technology platforms
* Architecture diagramming and business case tools

**Preferred:**

* Cloud platforms, API gateways, microservices, event streaming, containers, and observability tools
* Data analytics and reporting platforms
* Enterprise architecture frameworks

**Overall Responsibilities**

* Lead consulting and solution architecture engagements across Payments and Banking.
* Drive new-logo acquisition, account farming, opportunity identification, and revenue growth.
* Develop go-to-market strategies, client propositions, solution roadmaps, and business cases.
* Design enterprise solutions covering payments, cloud, APIs, integration, modernization, data, security, and operations.
* Lead executive discussions and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
* Support proposals, RFPs, estimates, commercial models, and solution governance.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, product, and domain teams.
* Track payment industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies.
* Develop thought leadership, reusable solution assets, and industry perspectives.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, security, resilience, compliance, cost, and sustainability.

**Technical Skills**

* Programming and Architecture: Essential: Understanding of APIs, integration, microservices, event-driven architecture, software lifecycles, and enterprise architecture. Preferred: Java, Python, SQL, and code-level design review experience.
* Payments and Banking: Essential: Issuing, acquiring, switching, processing, settlement, reconciliation, digital banking, and payment transformation. Preferred: Open banking, instant payments, digital wallets, embedded finance, and real-time payments.
* Cloud and Infrastructure: Essential: Cloud adoption, migration, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, security, and cost management. Preferred: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, containers, Kubernetes, serverless, and infrastructure automation.
* Data Management: Essential: Data flows, transaction data, customer data, reporting, reconciliation, governance, privacy, and data quality. Preferred: Real-time processing, analytics, data modernization, and regulatory reporting.
* Tools and Methodologies: Essential: Agile, consulting, discovery workshops, architecture governance, estimation, proposal development, business cases, and executive presentations. Preferred: Account planning, competitive analysis, sales pursuits, and partner-led opportunities.
* Security and Compliance: Essential: Secure APIs, identity and access management, encryption, data protection, payment security, audit, and operational resilience. Preferred: Tokenization, fraud controls, customer authentication, and payment security standards.

**Experience Requirements**

* 12–15+ years of experience in Banking, Payments, Consulting, Solution Architecture, or related fields.
* Strong expertise in payment ecosystems and transformation initiatives.
* Proven experience in client-facing consulting, advisory, or architecture roles.
* Demonstrated success in new-logo acquisition, account expansion, opportunity shaping, and revenue growth.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders and global banking and payments clients.
* Experience designing enterprise solutions involving cloud, APIs, integration, modernization, security, and data.
* Experience in regulated industries is preferred.
* Equivalent professional experience demonstrating domain, architecture, consulting, and commercial expertise may be considered.

**Day-to-Day Activities**

* Meet clients and senior stakeholders to understand business priorities and challenges.
* Lead discovery workshops and assess business and technology environments.
* Develop target architectures, solution roadmaps, proposals, and business cases.
* Identify and qualify new opportunities across target accounts.
* Support account planning, pipeline reviews, RFPs, and proposal governance.
* Prepare executive presentations, solution demonstrations, and industry points of view.
* Collaborate with sales, delivery, engineering, finance, legal, and domain teams.
* Review estimates, risks, dependencies, scope, commercial assumptions, and delivery feasibility.
* Make recommendations on architecture, investment, solution scope, and delivery approach.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Enterprise architecture, cloud, payments, banking, security, or project management certifications are preferred.
* Completion of Synechron security, compliance, conduct, and role-specific training is required.
* Ongoing learning in payments, banking regulations, cloud, security, and financial technology is expected.

**Professional Competencies**

* Structured problem-solving and sound commercial judgment.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence decisions.
* Adaptability to changing markets, regulations, and client priorities.
* Innovation focused on measurable business value.
* Effective management of multiple opportunities, proposals, and client engagements.
* Ability to balance growth objectives with security, compliance, delivery feasibility, and sustainability.

***S***

Diversity & Inclusion are fundamental to our culture, and Synechron is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. We strongly believe that a diverse workforce helps build stronger, successful businesses as a global company. We encourage applicants from across diverse backgrounds, race, ethnicities, religion, age, marital status, gender, sexual orientations, or disabilities to apply. We empower our global workforce by offering flexible workplace arrangements, mentoring, internal mobility, learning and development programs, and more.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Treasures Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
jobs.description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across 600 branches across the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS Treasures clients having a total relationship value => INR 30 lakhs through “need-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Acquire and upgrade quality Treasures clients in the branch location areas
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retentionand growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.

**Job Duties:**

* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of the elite Treasures Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 10 M
* Ensure timely portfolio review by jointly engaging with Wealth / Investment / Insurance specialist with clients.
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Provide feedback on market, competition and products, suggest innovations & ideas for continuous product and service improvements.
* Keep attuned to the current economic and financial markets to be current and proficient to ensure effective engagement with the elite segment of Treasures customers.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG Relationship Manager peer groups and colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist at branches to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through team work
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent wealth management provider in India.
* Organize exclusive lifestyle, sports , music and such other elite engagement events and activities for prospect generation , entrench existing relationship and reinforce the DBS brand in the Private Wealth management space

**Requirements**

* Sound understanding of financial planning and wealth management products in India
* In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage

**Education / Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate / Post Graduate with MBA in relevant field

**Core Competencies**

* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Self-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior.
* Focused on developing image and good will of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities.
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines.
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities.

**Technical Competencies**

* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with clients.

**Work Relationship**

* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share.
* Close interaction with Treasures Elite Team Leader, City / Cluster Head, Branch Service and Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge development of self and explore potential in existing book through joint engagement with clients.

**Mandatory Training**

* GCAP (Group Customer Acceptance Policy)
* BCAP (Business Customer Acceptance Policy)
* AML (Anti Money Laundering) and KYC Guidelines
* PIP (Personal Investment Policy)
* ORM (Operational Risk Management)
* Information Security Policy

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviors**

* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity.

**Location:**
Pune-DBIL
  
  
**Job:**
Relationship Management
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time

jobs.title: Strategic Account Director (ID # 912)
jobs.description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales ales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets, specifically renewal rates and net revenue retention (NRR) metrics

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

jobs.title: Director Relationship Manager (FI)
jobs.description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* Familiarity with Middle East, GCC and global markets, reflecting cross-border client engagement and product delivery
* Arabic language skills (spoken and written) are an advantage, supporting engagement with regional clients and senior stakeholders
* Strong knowledge of credit, risk, capital markets or regulatory workflows—and the ability to translate GCC regulatory requirements (such as those of the local Central Banks or Capital Monetary Authorities) into Moody’s solutions
* Working knowledge of Moody’s capabilities across KYC and customer onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, commercial and corporate lending, private credit and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to position them to risk, compliance, credit and technology stakeholders
* Exceptional C-level relationship-building, consultative selling and contract negotiation skills, complemented by independent thought leadership and advisory sales expertise. Demonstrates the ability to generate impactful ideas for clients, influencing outcomes at the highest level
* Demonstrates a strong track record in building and leading high-performing sales teams, with a focus on cross-functional collaboration. Applies strategic planning, pipeline management and disciplined execution to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets
* Excellent communication—listening, presenting and writing—and the confidence to influence senior external and internal stakeholders
* High initiative, resilience and the ability to work independently while fostering teamwork in a matrix environment

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, applied finance, economics or a related field (post graduate finance or risk qualification advantageous)

**Responsibilities**

* Own and expand relationships with the GCC’s Tier 1 banks and a broad spectrum of institutional clients—including central banks, banks, sovereign wealth funds, insurance, asset managers —engaging board and C-suite stakeholders and setting multi-year account strategies aligned to client priorities
* Retain and grow revenue by cross-selling and up-selling the full Moody’s Analytics suite, leveraging advisory sales and innovative solutions across KYC and onboarding, supplier and third-party risk, lending and credit origination, private credit, AI-enabled solutions, credit, ESG, AML, regulatory reporting, data and analytics

jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Account Management Specialist
jobs.description:
**Department:**
Merchant Business
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**
UAE
  
  
**Description**
**About Tabby:**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 20 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 40,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $14 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and now has an implied valuation of $4.5 billion.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Account Management Specialist manages a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving long-term growth, retention, and product adoption across accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor, the specialist is responsible for developing account strategies, identifying revenue opportunities, and delivering data-driven recommendations that maximize merchant performance and business outcomes.
  
  
This role requires strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and stakeholder management skills. The Account Management Specialist is expected to operate independently, lead strategic merchant conversations, influence decision-making, and drive the adoption of Tabby's full product suite. The role also plays a key part in cross-functional initiatives, process improvements, and strategic projects that support broader business objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Strategic Account Management:**

* Own and manage a portfolio of strategic and enterprise merchants, driving retention, growth, and long-term partnership success.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and act as a trusted advisor to merchants.
* Develop and execute account growth plans aligned with merchant objectives and Tabby's commercial strategy.

**Revenue Growth & Product Expansion:**

* Drive revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and expansion of Tabby's products and services.
* Identify opportunities to increase product penetration across the portfolio, including new and existing solutions.
* Lead commercial discussions and proactively position relevant products based on merchant needs and performance insights.
* Own pipeline generation within the portfolio and track expansion opportunities through to execution.

**Data Analytics & Portfolio Optimization:**

* Analyze merchant performance, transaction trends, conversion metrics, and product adoption to identify growth opportunities and risks.
* Translate complex datasets into actionable recommendations that improve merchant performance and revenue contribution.
* Conduct portfolio reviews, business reviews, and strategic performance discussions with merchants.
* Build dashboards, reports, and presentations to support data-driven decision-making.

**Strategic Projects & Business Initiatives:**

* Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives, product launches, operational improvements, and merchant experience enhancements.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation and scalability initiatives across the business.
* Partner with leadership and cross-functional teams on high-impact commercial and operational projects.

**Merchant Success & Problem Resolution:**

* Proactively identify merchant challenges and business risks before they impact performance.
* Take ownership of complex merchant escalations and coordinate stakeholders to drive timely resolution.
* Ensure merchants receive strategic recommendations and solutions that support continued growth.

**Cross-Functional Leadership:**

* Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Operations, Risk, Finance, and Tech teams to deliver merchant solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Act as the primary point of coordination for strategic merchant initiatives requiring cross-functional involvement.
* Influence internal stakeholders and drive alignment to achieve successful merchant outcomes.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3-5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, Business Development, or a similar client-facing role.
* Proven experience independently managing enterprise or strategic accounts.
* Strong commercial mindset with demonstrated success in driving revenue growth, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Advanced analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Experience conducting portfolio reviews, business reviews, and presenting performance insights to senior stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Technical teams.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and experience with Tableau, Power BI, or similar analytics tools.
* Experience within fintech, payments, BNPL, e-commerce, or technology industries is preferred.

Job Benefits
  
  

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well at times that suit you and your team.
* A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* You should be comfortable with the idea that the quality of your work will influence the shape of your career.
* Participation in the company’s employee stock options program.
* Health Insurance.
* Flexi Perks: a monetary benefit to spend on what matters most to you — health, well-being, education, or professional development.

jobs.title: Customer Success Business Partner, UAE & Emerging
Account Director, Private Sector (MEA & Turkey)
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.
  
  
TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.
  
  
TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across MEAT. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a large greenfield territory plus the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**

* Open new private sector accounts across the MEAT region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.
* Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.
* Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.
* Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.
* Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.
* Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in MEAT, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.
* A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.
* Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.
* Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.
* Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.
* Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.
* Fluent English, other relevant languages including Arabic, Turkish, French a bonus
* Based in Dubai and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

**About The Team**

* TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.
* The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.
* The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.
* You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

**Learn About TRM Speed In This Position**

* Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.
* When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.
* Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

**Team Operating Rhythms**

* Distributed, not distant: the team works across Gulf time, and occasional US calls on complex deals.
* Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.
* Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.
* Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

**Required Online And Collaboration Hours**

* Schedule: Core hours overlapping Gulf Time, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

**Application Instructions**
If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
  
  
Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
  
  
If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.
  
  
**Interviewing with TRM**
Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
  
  

* Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.
* Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.
* First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.
* Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.
* References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.
* Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.
* Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.
  
  
**AI Fluency at TRM**
AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
  
  
We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
  
  
At TRM, AI Fluency Means You Are Among The Top 10 Percent Of Operators In Your Function In How You Apply AI To
  
  

* Accelerate repeatable workflows
* Structure and solve problems
* Improve output quality
* Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.
  
  
**Life at TRM**
We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
  
  
TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
  
  
Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
  
  
**At TRM, You Should Expect**

* Priorities and targets to change quickly
* Operating with a high degree of ambiguity
* A high level of personal ownership and accountability
* Close collaboration across teams and functions
* Frequent, high-touch communication
* Creati

The
**Sales Director / Manager – Africa**
is responsible for driving
**revenue growth, market expansion, and strategic client acquisition**
across the region. The role owns the
**end‑to‑end sales lifecycle**
, including pipeline development, strategic account management, complex deal structuring, and executive‑level stakeholder engagement, while working closely with
**delivery, product, marketing, and partner ecosystems**
to ensure sustainable growth and customer success
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Regional Revenue & Growth Ownership**

* Drive new logo acquisition and expansion of existing strategic accounts across banking, wealth management, asset management, and capital markets.

* Strengthen regional market credibility through alliances and industry presence.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning**

* Provide structured feedback into product, pricing, and regional solution strategies.
* Position differentiated value propositions against global and regional competitors.

**Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Forecast accuracy and deal governance compliance
* Average deal size and margin quality
* Partner‑sourced revenue contribution
* Client satisfaction and long‑term account sustainability

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Minimum of 15 years of proven sales experience in the banking, wealth management, or financial technology (fintech) industry, with a track record of exceeding sales targets, especially in the Middle Eastern region.
* Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of the banking, wealth management, and financial services landscape, including regulations, technology trends, and challenges faced by financial institutions.
* Sales Skills: Demonstrated ability to sell complex software solutions to senior executives, with expertise in consultative and solution-based selling methodologies.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts in a clear, concise, and persuasive manner.
* Relationship Management: Proven ability to build, nurture, and maintain strong client relationships, with a customer-centric approach to sales.
* Leadership: Ability to work independently and collaborate with a team, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and mentor junior team members.
* Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field. MBA or relevant certifications in sales or financial services is a plus.
* Technical Proficiency: Comfortable using CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.), Microsoft Office Suite, and other sales and presentation tools. Familiarity with banking and wealth management software is advantageous.
* Proficiency in English. French & Arabic language would be an added advantage.

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
**Institutional**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
At
**Associate Directo**
**r**
level, the role is responsible for the identification, assessment, management, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end product, platform and client lifecycle. The incumbent will help strengthen the control environment for Transaction Banking products and digital capabilities, support product design and change execution, contribute to client implementation and delivery risk management, regulatory readiness and incident learnings, and escalate material matters as appropriate.
  
  
This role is responsible for helping manage non-financial risk across Transaction Banking products, including Payments and Cash Management, Trade and Digital Payments. The role acts as a trusted risk partner to product, sales, implementation, operations, technology and digital delivery stakeholders, providing practical risk advice and execution support to enable safe, sustainable and customer-focused growth.
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type: Permanent
  
  
Role Location: Bengaluru
  
  
Work Hours: 7AM to 4PM**
**What will your day look like?**
As an
**Associate Director Institutional NFR GCC Transaction Banking**
, you will:
  
  

* Act as a trusted non-financial risk partner to Transaction Banking product and digital businesses, providing practical guidance on product strategy, client solutions, commercialisation, platform delivery and change initiatives
* Provide analysis, advice and constructive challenge on product and digital risk profiles, control effectiveness, customer outcomes and risk in change across Payments and Cash Management, Trade, Digital Payments, client channels, connectivity solutions and related Transaction Banking capabilities
* Support the identification, assessment, monitoring and reporting of material non-financial risks across the end-to-end Transaction Banking product and platform lifecycle, including operational, compliance, technology, cyber, data, fraud, third-party, conduct, financial crime and resilience risks
* Contribute to uplift in product, platform and channel controls, risk indicators, governance, documentation and management information to strengthen transparency, ownership and control effectiveness
* Support quality and timely completion of risk assessments, control assurance, issues management, incident response and remediation activities relevant to Transaction Banking products, platforms and digital capabilities
* Provide risk input and execution support for new product development, product enhancements, platform changes, digital payment capabilities, client implementations, trade and cash management solutions and strategic initiatives impacting Transaction Banking
* Support strong product and digital governance through quality forum papers, issue transparency, escalation and decision support for relevant stakeholders
* Partner with Product, Operations, Technology, Digital, Implementation, Compliance, Legal, Financial Crime, 2LOD Risk and Internal Audit stakeholders to support aligned and effective non-financial risk outcomes
* Help embed strong first-line risk ownership and awareness across Transaction Banking product and digital teams by promoting practical, customer-focused and commercially aware risk management

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* 15+ years of expertise in Transaction Banking, with strong knowledge of products and client solutions
* Strong experience in transaction banking, with sound understanding of Payments and Cash Management, Trade and/or Digital Payments products, platforms, client journeys, servicing models and the end-to-end product lifecycle
* Strong knowledge of non-financial risk management within a large and complex financial services environment, including governance, risk assessment, controls, issues and incident management, risk reporting and risk in change
* Demonstrated knowledge of key risk exposures relevant to Transaction Banking products and digital channels, including operational resilience, technology and cyber dependencies, data, fraud, third-party risk, financial crime, conduct risk, regulatory compliance and customer outcome risks.
* Demonstrated ability to provide credible advice and constructive challenge to product, digital, operations and technology stakeholders on product risk, platform controls, control design and risk in change, escalating material matters where appropriate
* Experience supporting new product approvals, product changes, digital platform enhancements, client implementation risk assessments and governance processes in a controlled banking environment
* Strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across business and control teams, simplify complex risk matters, and provide clear recommendations that support effective and sustainable risk outcomes
* Knowledge of domestic and cross-border payment rails, cash management structures, trade finance products, digital payment capabilities, client connectivity solutions, APIs and emerging payment industry standards
* Knowledge of digital risk and control frameworks, payment security, fraud prevention, operational resilience, and regulatory requirements, with experience supporting audit, compliance, and non-financial risk management activities within banking and Transaction Banking environments
* Experience using risk data and governance reporting to identify emerging risks, support decision-making, and drive timely actions
* Exposure to global Transaction Banking environments and familiarity with risk systems, governance frameworks, and control improvement initiative

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number
**121384**

jobs.title: Temenos - SME Business analyst
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced T24 Technical Lead / Solution Architect to drive the end-to-end technical delivery of a core banking implementation. The role will be responsible for owning T24 application development, solution design, customisation, configuration, integration, and production readiness.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, core banking architecture, system integrations, and end-to-end implementation delivery, including at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, solution architects, system integrators, and technology teams to ensure the solution aligns with banking requirements, regulatory standards, and approved architectural principles.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application and Development Ownership

* Take ownership of the T24 application build and customisation from project commencement until production go-live.
* Lead and govern the T24 design and development teams, interface teams, and system integrator developers, ensuring alignment with programme scope, plans, milestones, deliverables, risks, and testing from a technology standpoint.
* Establish quality standards for IRDs, IDDs, and FSD documents covering the incumbent bank's products, services, and configurations.
* Own end-to-end delivery governance across all phases and report progress to senior management and steering committees.

2. Solution Design and Architecture

* Coordinate and participate in detailed functional and technical deep-dive sessions with system integrators to validate architecture, scope, IRDs, IDDs, and FSDs against the bank's requirements.
* Lead design discussions with solution designers and bank stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions follow event-driven architecture principles and approved architectural patterns.
* Drive Low-Level Design (LLD) discussions covering T24 Chart of Accounts, customer and account structures, product setup, accounting entries, interfaces with SAS systems, and operational workflows.
* Conduct operational workshops with Finance, Compliance, Risk, Fraud, and Operations teams to finalise process flows and technology integrations.

3. Implementation and Configuration

* Oversee T24 environment setup, parameterisation, configuration, and development of standard and customised functionalities.
* Govern bank-specific configurations and Egypt-specific customisations, ensuring they are justified, documented, and upgrade-safe.
* Oversee DIT, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and Close of Business (COB) readiness.
* Drive cutover activities and ensure production readiness.

4. Integration and Middleware

* Own the T24 integration design with other system integrators and downstream applications, including DMS, Kafka, Camunda, Kong, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Oversee Kafka event streaming and real-time messaging of T24 customer, account, and transaction events to SAS systems.
* Govern Camunda workflow orchestration for non-STP case handling, ensuring case outcomes are appropriately posted back to T24.
* Oversee Kong API Gateway integration, including API security and traffic management for T24 APIs.
* Ensure CRM integration supports non-STP workflows and customer interactions.
* Govern SAS system integrations covering customer and account data feeds, transaction screening, fraud checks, and posting of approved outcomes, including restrictions, blocks, and status changes, into T24 following Risk and Compliance clearance.

5. Regulatory and Compliance Alignment

* Ensure T24 configuration, General Ledger, and regulatory reporting meet Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) regulations.
* Ensure compliance with Egyptian AML/CFT requirements, data residency, and information security expectations.
* Apply relevant GCC and international banking compliance practices, including FATF recommendations and OFAC/EU sanctions requirements, while adapting them to the Egyptian regulatory context.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, and technology-related evidence requests.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Engage and align senior business and technology stakeholders as required.
* Present project status, risks, dependencies, and action points clearly to executive leadership and steering committees.

Role Requirements and Qualifications

* Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in Temenos T24 application development, including at least one complete implementation from design to production go-live.
* Strong technical knowledge of T24 modules, architecture, configuration, customisation, Chart of Accounts, General Ledger, multi-currency processing, and core banking operations.
* Hands-on experience with T24 development tools and frameworks, including OFS, IRIS, REST/SOAP APIs, event and message frameworks, MQ, local routines, enquiries, COB configuration, and TAFJ.
* Strong understanding of core banking processes covering customers, accounts, deposits, payments, accounting, and day-end operations.
* Knowledge of banking integrations involving Kafka, Camunda, Kong, DMS, CRM, AML/KYC, Sanctions, FRM, and Data Lake.
* Understanding of AML/CFT, transaction monitoring, customer risk assessment, CDD/EDD, sanctions screening, and fraud management.
* Familiarity with Egyptian banking regulations, CBE reporting requirements, and data residency expectations.
* Experience in technical delivery governance, system integrator coordination, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in large-scale core banking transformation programmes.
* Exposure to Egyptian banking implementations and CBE regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of GCC banking compliance frameworks and regulatory expectations.

Lead Consultant / Senior Consultant / Consultant – Banking CRM (AI)

At Finacle Consulting Group, we are embedding AI across a next-generation banking CRM spanning sales, service and marketing, guided by one principle: intelligence in every workflow, accountability in every decision. * Design AI solutions by translating business problems and customer journeys into functional and technical requirements.

Bangalore, Pune, Mumbai, Gurgaon, Chennai, Hyderabad and Indore

jobs.description:
Location: Gurugram, Haryāna, India
  
Date Posted: Nov 23, 2026

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

  

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

**At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.  

Key Working Relationships

* Customers and business partners across the assigned region/country.
* Senior Process Associates, Operational Managers, and Team Leads.
* Collections, Credit, Billing, Customer Service, Banking, Treasury, and Master Data teams.
* Internal Controls and Audit teams.
Process Experts and other cross-functional teams.  

Key Performance Indicators

* Cash application timeliness and accuracy.
* Unapplied and unidentified cash ageing.
* AMR processing rate.
* Query resolution time and SLA adherence.
* Productivity and quality.
* Control and audit compliance.
Accuracy and completeness of assigned activities.

* **Visionary:** Focuses on delivering measurable outcomes and high-quality customer service.

* **Catalyst:** Collaborates with colleagues, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement.

* Solid understanding of Machine Learning (ML) techniques and emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in risk management, with practical experience preferred
