jobs.title: Snr Solution Architect, UAE Enterprise
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

Agivant Technologies is a fast-paced, AI-first IT services company helping clients design, build, and scale autonomous solutions by combining deep engineering expertise with modern AI, cloud, and data capabilities. We move quickly, wear multiple hats, and expect our leaders to be builders first.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on, technically strong
**Engineering Director**
to lead our engineering organization from Pune. This is not a pure people-management or project-management role—we want a builder and solutioner who stays close to the technology, architects and troubleshoots alongside the team, and brings real, practical experience with AI systems.

* Personally architect, review, and troubleshoot complex solutions alongside the team rather than delegating every technical decision.
* Apply AI systems (LLM, agentic, and ML-based approaches) to client solutions and internal productivity.
* Set technical direction and standards across development, testing, and cloud administration.

* BFSI domain: strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including an understanding of regulatory, security, and compliance needs.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent across development, testing, support, and cloud administration while building a culture of continuous learning and growth.
* Manage performance, provide regular feedback, and resolve conflicts constructively.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Own the full product development and maintenance lifecycle for client projects and establish a robust quality assurance process.
* Drive adoption of efficient engineering practices such as Agile and DevOps.
* Deliver measurable productivity gains through AI-led tooling and ways of working.
* Improve gross margin through efficient delivery, smart resourcing, and process discipline.

**Client & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Serve as a trusted technical voice for clients by providing regular updates and managing expectations.
* Translate client business objectives into technical roadmaps and hands-on solution designs.
* Proactively identify opportunities to add value through AI-driven and autonomous solutions, new technologies, or process improvements.
* Treat revenue and account growth as a core part of client engagement alongside technical delivery.

  Demonstrated experience managing teams of 30+ members as both a people manager and technical leader.
* **BFSI Domain:**
  Strong background in banking, financial services, or insurance, including knowledge of regulatory, security, and compliance requirements.

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to architect, code, and troubleshoot complex systems.
* Solid grounding in distributed systems, product engineering, or advanced data analytics.
* Strong grasp of Agile, DevOps, QA discipline, and cloud infrastructure.
* Operational and delivery rigor with a disciplined focus on quality, timelines, and gross margin.
* Commercial acumen around revenue, margin, and account growth levers.
* Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and comfort with ambiguity in fast-changing environments.

You will thrive here if you are a hands-on engineering leader with deep technical and AI experience who has led large teams, enjoys building, and feels most energized close to the architecture, code, and client

AI Infrastructure Implementation & Platform Roadmap
  
  

* Own AI infrastructure implementation roadmap across AI Gateway, inference platforms, Kubernetes, vector databases, MCP hosting, agentic workflows and integration services.

Unit Leadership & Operating Model
  
  

* Lead the AI Platform Support Unit as the accountable unit manager for platform operations, reliability, compliance and engineering delivery.
* Manage and guide three AI platform managers responsible for Voice AI & Content AI, Vision AI/Text AI/Custom Models, and Data AI/Agentic AI portfolios.
* Define the unit operating model, role clarity, support framework, governance cadence, escalation model and service ownership structure.
* Build a strong production-first culture covering availability, reliability, security, compliance, automation and continuous improvement.

Uptime, Reliability & Production Governance
  
  

* Own platform availability targets and ensure critical AI services are operated with clear SLAs, SLOs and operational KPIs.

* Review major incidents, approve corrective actions and track closure of permanent fixes across the AI platform landscape.
* Ensure production readiness reviews, operational handover, monitoring and support documentation are completed before go-live.

Resiliency, DR & Capacity Planning
  
  

* Define resiliency strategy for AI platforms, including high availability, failover, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity readiness.

AI Compliance, Risk & Governance
  
  

* Own AI platform compliance governance including SCD, access reviews, audit trails, privileged access, policy adherence and evidence readiness.

* Ensure AI guardrails, DLP controls, data protection checks, access controls and operational safeguards are implemented across platforms.
* Track compliance gaps, audit observations, risk acceptances and remediation actions to closure.

AI FinOps & Commercial Governance
  
  

* Own AI platform cost governance across cloud, GPU, model inference, token usage, API consumption, vector databases, storage and vendor services.

AI Observability & Executive Reporting
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Strong leadership experience in infrastructure, cloud, SRE, DevOps, platform engineering or enterprise technology operations.
* Experience managing managers, multi-disciplinary engineering teams and large-scale production support functions.
* Good understanding of AI platform components including LLMs, AI Gateway, inference platforms, RAG, vector databases, agentic AI, MCP, speech, vision and content AI services.
* Strong knowledge of Kubernetes, cloud platforms, API gateways, IAM, observability, automation, DR, compliance and FinOps practices.
* Ability to work with senior leadership, business teams, security, compliance, architecture, engineering, vendors and audit stakeholders.
* Strong governance, decision-making, stakeholder management, communication and executive reporting skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience operating AI/ML platforms, high-scale digital platforms or regulated enterprise technology platforms.
* Exposure to Azure AI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, vLLM, Triton, Hugging Face, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, vector databases, Kafka, Redis or equivalent technologies.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Events & IPs
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Inc42 is looking for a Sales Manager – Events & IPs to drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across its events, conferences, communities and proprietary intellectual properties.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Own a Revenue Vertical:** Drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across Inc42's flagship events, conferences, communities and proprietary IPs. Take ownership of pipeline creation, client acquisition, deal closure, receivables and account growth.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

### **About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.
* Develop use cases where real-time event triggers drive autonomous agent actions: banking operations and service, airport and airline disruption handling, supply chain and plant operations, citizen service workflows, and public infrastructure monitoring.
* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA
  
  
**Work Location:**
Dubai
  
  
**Job Summary:**
The Director of Technical Implementation, EMEA is responsible for leading and transforming the regional technical delivery organization into a scalable, high-performing, and standardized function. This role centralizes technical leadership across all countries (including UKI, ME, South Africa, Italy, France and DACH), establishing a unified operating model that ensures consistent implementation quality, strong governance, and measurable delivery outcomes across InterSystems EHR and HealthShare solutions.
  
  
The position drives operational efficiency through structured resource management, cross-regional collaboration, and the adoption of shared tools, reusable assets, and standardized processes. It enables the transition from country-based execution to a coordinated EMEA-wide delivery model, improving flexibility, utilization, and responsiveness to project demands.
  
  
In addition, the role plays a critical part in aligning technical delivery with quality objectives, ensuring each country can meet its project targets while benefiting from regional synergies. It is also accountable for embedding AI-driven methodologies, including the evolution of ARIES, into day-to-day delivery practices to enhance predictability, quality, and decision-making.
  
  
Overall, this position is key to improving customer outcomes, strengthening partner ecosystems, and building a future-ready technical implementation capability across EMEA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and unify all Technical Implementation teams across EMEA under a single functional structure, ensuring consistent standards and execution.
* Define and enforce technical implementation best practices, governance, and quality frameworks across all projects.
* Maintain strong alignment with country leadership, ensuring technical delivery supports each country in achieving its annual project targets while applying regional synergies and continuous improvements.
* Drive cross-country collaboration and resource optimization, enabling flexible deployment of technical expertise across the region.
* Own regional technical capacity planning, forecasting, and utilization, leveraging data and AI-driven insights.
* Oversee partner strategy and execution, including onboarding, performance management, and management alignment.
* Embed and scale the AI-powered ARIES methodology across all technical delivery activities.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to delivery quality, efficiency, resource utilization, and partner performance.
* Support country Professional Services Directors in achieving project success, while maintaining strong technical oversight.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives, including reusable assets, automation, and standardization of deliverables.
* Act as a senior stakeholder in customer engagements, supporting critical projects and ensuring delivery excellence.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in technical delivery, implementation, or professional services leadership.
* Proven track record managing large-scale, complex, multi-country implementation programs.
* Strong background in healthcare IT or enterprise software implementation environments.
* Deep understanding of technical architectures, integration, and data platforms.
* Experience with resource management, forecasting, and operational optimization at scale.
* Demonstrated ability to lead organizational transformation and drive standardization.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with partners and external delivery ecosystems.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate vision into execution.
* Ability to travel internationally 60% of the time.

**Education and Training:**

* Relevant University technical Degree
* Proficiency in English

**Key Success Factors:**

* Improved delivery predictability and quality across EMEA
* Increased resource utilization and cross-regional efficiency
* Strong partner performance and optimization
* Effective adoption of AI-driven implementation practices
* Scalable and standardized technical delivery model across EMEA markets

**About InterSystems**
InterSystems, a creative data technology provider, delivers a unified foundation for next-generation applications for healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and supply chain customers in more than 80 countries. Our data platforms solve interoperability, speed, and scalability problems for large organizations around the globe to unlock the power of data and allow people to perceive data in imaginative ways. Established in 1978, InterSystems is committed to excellence through its 24×7 support for customers and partners around the world. Privately held and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, InterSystems has 38 offices in 28 countries worldwide. For more information, please visit
**InterSystems.com**
.
  
  
**AI Disclaimer**
InterSystems may use AI tools for its internal operations including administrative tasks during recruitment (e.g., organizing candidate information). InterSystems’ approach to AI is guided by the InterSystems Responsible AI Guidelines. AI is not used to make or influence hiring decisions. All decisions are made by InterSystems employees.
  
  
Candidates may use AI for CV or interview preparation, provided materials are truthful and reflect their own experience. AI tools and third-party transcription services must not be used during interviews or assessments.
  
  
Please note that the use of wearable technology, including any AI-related tools or other technology-connected devices (such as META or Google smart glasses and/or wearables, and/or any similar devices), is
*strictly prohibited*
during the interview and screening process with InterSystems. Any applicant who requires a wearable device or any type of technology support during the interview process as a reasonable accommodation under the ADA or applicable state or country laws and regulations must contact the InterSystems Human Resources Department
*prior*
to attending or participating in any interview or screening process.

Company:
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94,000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. CGI works with clients through a local relationship model complemented by a global delivery network that helps clients digitally transform their organizations and accelerate results. CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more at cgi.com.
  
  
Position: Director – Product Engineering Capability
  
  
Experience: 20+years
  
  
Category:
  
  
Shift Timing: General Shift
  
  
Location: Chennai
  
  
Position ID: J1126-0178
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.
  
  
As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director – Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio.
  
  
The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products.
  
  
This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.
  
  
Your future duties and responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness
  
  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.
* Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed.

Role & Competency Model
  
  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

Talent Depth & Succession
  
  

* Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions.
* Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines.
* Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements.

Capability Excellence & Communities
  
  

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills
  
  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.
* Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve.

Partnership with Product Engineering
  
  

* Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges.
* Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function.
* Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers.
* Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness.

Capability Measurement
  
  

* Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators.
* Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies.
* Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness.

**Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role**
Must to have skill:
  
  

* Typically 18+ years of experience in enterprise product engineering, software/product organizations, technology consulting or equivalent environments.
* Significant leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-product engineering organization.
* Demonstrated experience building capabilities, practices, CoEs, engineering excellence organizations or cross-product competency models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software/product development across the lifecycle — product definition, architecture, analysis, engineering, quality and production support.
* Demonstrated ability to work across both functional / domain and technology disciplines.
* Experience developing senior specialists, architects, functional leaders, domain experts or engineering leaders.
* Strong track record influencing senior stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Experience driving organizational transformation and establishing new operating models.
* Exposure to enterprise SaaS, cloud modernization, AI-enabled engineering and contemporary product-development practices strongly preferred.
* ERP, government solutions or large mission-critical enterprise-platform experience would be advantageous, but is not mandatory.

Good to have skills:
  
  
The successful candidate should be someone who:
  
  

* thinks several years ahead about capability rather than simply responding to today's staffing needs;
* has enough credibility with Engineering Directors and architects to challenge them constructively;
* equally values functional / domain depth and engineering excellence;
* can create standards without creating bureaucracy;
* develops strong specialist leaders rather than centralizing expertise around themselves;
* is comfortable working through influence in a matrix;
* uses evidence and data to identify capability risks;
* understands that capability development must ultimately translate into better product outcomes.

Infosys Consulting is seeking a Senior Principal to lead cybersecurity advisory within its Technology Transformation practice. This executive-level consulting role will shape market strategy, originate and grow client relationships, and direct complex transformation programs across industries and geographies.

The successful candidate will be a recognized cybersecurity leader with 15+ years of consulting and/or industry experience, including significant experience advising C-suite executives, boards, CISOs, CIOs, CROs, and business leadership. As a
**Senior Principal**

* Own the cybersecurity and AI security consulting agenda for priority sectors, accounts, and regions, translating market shifts into differentiated offerings and executable growth plans.

* Originate, shape, and close large consulting pursuits; lead proposal strategy, commercial models, solution architecture, contract negotiations, and executive presentations.
* Direct complex, multi-workstream transformation programs covering cyber strategy, target operating models, GRC, cloud security, identity, data protection, zero trust, security operations, incident response, and business resilience.
* Define enterprise AI security and responsible AI programs, including AI governance, model and data risk, secure AI engineering, adversarial testing, GenAI threat scenarios, third-party AI risk, and controls aligned to the NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, and emerging regulation.
* Provide executive oversight for delivery quality, benefits realization, financial performance, risk management, and stakeholder alignment across global delivery teams.
* Build and mentor senior consulting teams, develop successors and subject-matter leaders, and foster an inclusive, high-performance culture across regions.
* Develop alliances and joint propositions with major security and cloud technology providers, and guide vendor selection and ecosystem strategy for clients.
* Represent the practice through board briefings, industry forums, publications, analyst engagement, point-of-view development, and reusable intellectual property.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, cybersecurity, business, or a related discipline; an MBA or relevant master's degree is preferred.
* 15+ years of progressive cybersecurity, technology risk, or security consulting experience, including 7+ years in senior leadership roles with responsibility for major accounts, portfolios, practices, or global programs.
* Demonstrated success advising boards and C-suite stakeholders and influencing enterprise investment, risk appetite, operating models, and transformation roadmaps.
* Proven record of originating and leading large, complex consulting engagements and sales pursuits, including commercial accountability, executive negotiation, and delivery governance.

* Strong financial, commercial, stakeholder-management, written communication, and executive presentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA, master's degree, or equivalent advanced qualification.
* Big 4 or comparable global consulting experience, with a strong network and market reputation in cybersecurity.
* Leadership experience across regulated industries such as financial services, energy and utilities, manufacturing, retail, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.

**Architecture and Operations**

**AI Security and Responsible AI**

ISO/IEC 27001 and 22301

NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53, 800-37 and 800-30

COBIT, ITIL and SABSA

Enterprise risk, operating models and board reporting

SOC transformation, detection and response

OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS

Audit, control testing and regulatory remediation

  CISSP plus at least one senior risk, governance, audit, or privacy credential such as CISM, CISA, CRISC, CGEIT, CCSP, CDPSE, or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor. Additional credentials such as SABSA, TOGAF, OSCP, GIAC, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer are advantageous.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

(Pune)
  
  
*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.*
**Company Overview**
At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.
  
  
We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.
  
  
Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**THE OPPORTUNITY**
**Context**
As we continue to grow across EMEA, North America, and APAC, we’re building a Value Engineering (VE) team that partners directly with senior executives to quantify and articulate the business value of digital procurement transformation. The Ivalua Value Engineering (VE) team is a highly strategic, executive-facing unit that partners directly with senior leaders (like CPOs, CFOs, and CIOs) at large global enterprises. They bridge the gap between technology and finance, helping prospective and existing customers quantify and track the hard business impact of digital procurement transformations.
  
  
**Role**
The Value Engineering Lead, Asia Pacific will define, deliver, and scale the value assessment for enterprise and public sector prospects across the Asia-Pacific region (mainly in India, Singapore, Australia and New Zealand, and South-East Asia). You’ll work directly with senior executive stakeholders to model ROI, build transformation roadmaps, and guide executive decisions throughout the buying and adoption journey.
  
  
This role blends consulting, storytelling, and analytical rigor—ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of business impact, technology, and enterprise transformation.
  
  
**What You Will Do With Us**
**Customer Value Engagements**

* Lead value discovery and ROI engagements with executive sponsors (CFO, CPO, CIO) at key prospects and customers.
* Build business cases quantifying the benefits and impact of our solutions.
* Deliver executive presentations demonstrating clear economic justification and transformation outcomes.

**Strategic Influence**

* Partner with Sales, Solution Consulting, Customer Success, Systems Integrators, and other go-to-market teams to shape deals and post-go-live value realization.
* Serve as a trusted advisor in large strategic pursuits, influencing deal structure and commercial approach.
* Represent the Asia-Pacific region in the global value engineering team, contributing to methodologies and playbooks.

**Methodology & Enablement**

* Develop frameworks for opportunity assessment, ROI modeling, and value tracking.
* Coach regional account teams on how to integrate value conversations into every stage of the customer lifecycle.
* Contribute value insights to Ivalua’s procurement thought leadership.

**Leadership & Growth**

* Improve the foundation for the Asia-Pacific Value Engineering function—better processes, new tools including Agentic AI, and more insightful metrics.
* Mentor sales, solution consultants, customer success, and services advisory team members to drive value engineering adoption and customer centricity.
* Collaborate with global peers to maintain a unified approach to value storytelling and measurement.

**YOUR PROFILE**
If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* 10+ years in management consulting, value engineering, or finance roles, ideally at enterprise software / technology vendors or consulting firms.
* Proven experience developing business cases and presenting to senior executives (CFO/CPO/CIO).
* Track record of leading or contributing to digital procurement, supply chain, or finance / operations transformation programs.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS business models and processes, ROI modeling, and value realization.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to model and translate data into compelling executive narratives.
* Excellent communication and storytelling—comfortable leading workshops and presenting to C-suite audiences.
* Self-starter mindset, ability to work in autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in Procurement / Source‑to‑Pay (S2P), finance, or supply chain domains.

**What Happens Next**
If your application fits this specific position’s needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today!
  
  
Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process - from preparation to completion. They're here to support you!
  
  
Our recruitment process is designed to assess your competencies through a series of personalised interviews with internal stakeholders relevant to the role.
  
  
Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on-site with face-to-face meetings.
  
  
**LIFE AT IVALUA**

* Hybrid working model (3 days in the office per week)
* We're a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of product innovation and technology
* Sustainable Growth, Privately Held
* A stable and cash-flow positive Company since 10 years
* Snacks and weekly lunches in the office

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. jobs.description:

Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

**AI leadership expectations**

* Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data.

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls.

The Assistant Director – Treasury will lead core treasury middle-office operations, including reporting, compliance, and risk monitoring, while supporting selected financial planning activities. The role requires strong analytical capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a focus on process automation to enhance hedging effectiveness, economic yield, liquidity management, and capital protection.

  

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Performance & Exposure Reporting: Monitor and report global foreign exchange (FX) exposures and outstanding hedges. Provide timely exposure updates to the Front Office
* MIS & Policy Compliance: Prepare management information system (MIS) dashboards covering FX, investments, and liquidity. Monitor compliance with investment policies and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Monthly & Quarterly Close: Manage monthly close activities for derivative mark-to-market (MTM) valuations and related charges, investments, and borrowings. Lead quarterly close deliverables, including portfolio and economic yield reporting, accounting yield reconciliation, investment register maintenance, other income analysis, and contributions to the Quarterly Treasury Report
* Cross-Functional & Tax Optimization: Support internal requirements related to advance tax, accounting, and EDPMS. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to optimize tax, accounting, and economic outcomes
* Financing, Ratings & Structuring: Support external financing and banking arrangements across entities, as required
* Process Automation: Drive automation of recurring treasury workflows and reporting processes to improve efficiency and consistency

  

**Time Allocation & Additional Scope**

* 75–80% Middle Office: Core treasury reporting, valuations, close processes, exposure monitoring, and compliance.
* 20–25% FP&A and Process Automation: Support financial planning and analysis (FP&A) alignment and process automation, as required.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Education: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Master of Business Administration (MBA).
* Experience: At least 8 years of experience in corporate treasury

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. Success here takes exceptional attention to detail, the willingness to hold peers to a standard, and sound judgment about which calls are yours and which belong to the Project Manager.

**2. Personal Accounting**

* Oversee personal financial planning, expense tracking, investment reporting, and tax preparation for key stakeholders or directors.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in personal records, assets, and liabilities.
* Handle payments, credit card reconciliations, and property-related financial records.

**3. Import & Export Management**

* Prepare and review all documentation related to imports/exports including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and shipping instructions.
* Liaise with customs agents, freight forwarders, and banks for timely clearance and compliance.
* Monitor currency fluctuations and advise on cost impacts.

**4. Financial Reporting & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and MIS reports.
* Analyse variances in budgets vs. actuals and recommend corrective actions.
* Support cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

**5. Vendor and Client Account Management**

* Maintain up-to-date records of receivables and payables.
* Ensure timely invoicing, collections, and vendor payments.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.

**6. Taxation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with **GST, TDS, Income Tax, Customs Duties**, and other local and international tax laws.
* File statutory returns on time and support audits by internal and external authorities.
* Liaise with CA firms, legal advisors, and consultants as required.

**7. Banking & Treasury Operations**

* Handle all bank transactions including fund transfers, FD management, and online banking.
* Maintain strong relationships with banking partners to support financial needs.
* Monitor daily cash positions and support investment decisions.

**8. Internal Controls & Audit Support**

* Implement and maintain robust internal controls over financial transactions.
* Prepare documents and respond to internal, statutory, or external audit requirements.
* Ensure all transactions are properly documented and authorized.

**9. Coordination with Cross-Functional Teams**

* Work closely with logistics, procurement, legal, and sales teams to ensure end-to-end transaction support.
* Provide financial insights and data support for business decisions and planning.

**10. Technology and System Support**

* Use accounting software efficiently for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Recommend and help implement automation or ERP tools for improving financial processes.

**Educational Qualification:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in Finance or any related field.

Lower Parel West, Mumbai 400013
